The rice and beans were absolutely incredible! They were obviously slow-cooked and have been perfecting the recipe for years. The chicken was great, too, and I’m impressed it was juicy and tender when being cooked in such huge batches. Even the coleslaw was great!

Dino’s might not look like that much from the outside, and they only have basic hard-back booths and bar seats, but the food is so good I’d eat it sitting on the sidewalk. It was also only about $15 for a massive portion of food. I definitely want to come back here to try other items in the future.

author: Jon D. Visionary
review_text:
Goodness gracious this place is bomb! Their chicken is the best charbroiled chicken in LA. Seasoned amazingly, and very juicy. The sauce compliments everything and cuts through the greasiness with the tanginess of the vinegar. Now people talk about the chicken with the fries, but the rice plate is what you should be getting. Very well seasoned rice. It just mixes with the beans so well, and makes me drool just thinking about it again 🤤

Their DUI fries are also bomb! Carne asada with pastramiis a dangerous combination. It would leave any big back with their back blown 🤤 The only fries I can put on par would be the pastrami fries from The Hat, but this might have it beat!

The worst thing about this place is how far it is, and the parking. I luckily went on a Monday, and got a spot in the lot, but I’d imagine it would be more difficult on the weekends. Service was quick.

Definitely visiting again after going to get my film developed at Gold Photo. Hopefully that will be soon 🤤

Update: Don’t dine in. No restrooms. The staff is pretty rude. I didn’t notice because I took my food to go last time. Their burgers are delicious too, but take your food to go! Grow your big back from the comfort of your car 😌

To go: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Dine in: ⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: Eddy Bretado
review_text: You have to get the chicken plate with the secret sauce to put on it it is amazing. This place has been there forever, I'm glad the flavors have never changed and the service has always been an excellent if you are in Los Angeles I recommend this place for a quick meal.

author: Eddie Marti
review_text: Dino's hand's down is one of my favorite spot to eat chicken when i visit back home in the L.A.area. I found this place back in my senior year in high school early 2000's, and you know what, the taste, the juiciness, the quantity, the quality, and the deliciousness, is all the same. Love how i can come back and visit and the flavor hasnt changed and its as good as my first time visiting. Keep up the great work. Highly recommend the chicken plate. Which ever way you like. Chicken is life!!!!😋

author: Robert Hinton Jr.
review_text: To me they have some wonderful chicken. I can only speak for me. My wife loves their food, she introduced me to this place. If you come by tell them to put extra juice on your fries and chicken. Man it's just exquisite. To get the full flavor punch you have to mix everything together...get the tortilla, bust it open, put the fries inside, then the chicken and put to cold slaw on top and eat that. To get the full flavor kick. It's really wonderful. Stop by. It's worth it. Now mind you only the shop downtown on Pico. Blvd Don't go to the one in Huntington Park, that location is trash.

author: Shaun Kart
review_text:
Go with what they are known for and you can't go wrong

However they do have good pastrami burgers and their hot dogs are pretty good too

author: Felita Ekwegh
review_text: The reviews I have read don’t give this place credit first of all the red color on the chicken is tandoori style chicken. A pastrami burrito will never have rice in it! Chilli cheese mustard and pickles!

author: Diamond Dae
review_text: It's LA so what can I say about the Atmosphere . I will say that OMG the food looked so delicious on the reviews and when I got there the smells were off the chain.  However the chicken not so good. Which was disappointing.  The smell and look makes you wanna hope there is a piece that tastes like something.  Not even rotisserie. It's was so blah.  Took leftover home and even my son was like this is so bad. Sadly it got tossed in the trash.  It's smelled soooo good and wasn't.  The staff w as friendly.

author: Dawit
review_text:
Dino’s famous chicken and fries was not bad. 🍗
They like to sell the chicken already packed.

I requested fresh chicken and fries, but the cashier kept saying, “Everything is fresh x100” with Spanish swear in whispering “Pinche…”

My chicken was burned hard and tepid..🍟
My fries were not crispy but soggy.

Not enough sauce on fries was disappointing me enough. 🥲

It is a good place to visit once out of curiosity

author: Adrian Y
review_text: Food was good.  Bathrooms not available for me to wash my greasy hands before closing time.  Also, they started cleaning the floor when we're still eating our food and the smell was filled with chlorine.  I also have my infant with me so that's not cool.

author: FINESS917
review_text: I had chicken with rice and beans.   The portion was a lot.  But the flavor was ok.  It was seasoned but tasted like all the season was on the skin of the chicken.  Whatever the season is , it gives off a bit too salty taste.  The chicken itself was grilled fine.

author: Pancho Villa
review_text: The chicken was OK,  the best food were the beans, they had a side of coleslaw which tasted rotten, the 1/2 a chicken look more like pigeon, than a chicken. The person hiding on the other side of the window, was not friendly at all. It literally felt like he was doing me a favor, instead of providing a service. The overall feeling wasn't good. Never coming back.

author: Eric Cervantes
review_text:
Dino's is a chicken spot in the downtown/USC area of Los Angeles. They are open late for hungry college kids and night owls alike.
The chicken appears char broiled with a blend of vinegar, garlic, and various spices to give it a lively flavor.
There are also options to order burgers, burritos, grilled cheeses, and more. Yet, the chicken is what gave Dino's its notoriety.
Order the half chicken, with fries, and extra sauce. You'll get the whole platter swimming in the juices. Fries and all to give it that signature zing.
It's a small area, with no bathroom to use. Be sure to bring some wet naps to clean your hands, but overall, a historical nice sit down for unique flavors.

author: Philip
review_text:
Can't miss with the chicken and fries.  Although the chicken was drier than we prefer the sauce (savory with a slight vinegar finish) the coleslaw  and skinny fries made up for it.

I'm surethere's better chicken in LA but this will do when hungry.

author: B
review_text: I miss the sweet guy who used to work the window. The guy there now is so serious lol. But anyway the food is great as always. Very consistent taste. It’s nice to see the upgrades and outside seating that has been installed. The prices are slowly creeping up like everything else. Last time I came it was $15 a box now it’s about $18 out the door =| but it’s worth it for the craving. I always get the half chicken over fries extra wet. The burgers and other menu items are good too but I come for that ! Very unique flavor that you can’t really get any where else! Very friendly service. Very fast service. Even when there’s a line. Would recommend !

author: Melissa Cortez
review_text: So let me put all yall mamasitas and mamsitos on game tho! This right herrrrrrrr this righhttt herrrr is the prize have you not tasted this delightfulness chicken yet get the chicken with the fries extra juice extra tortillas and dip my boy 😋 workers there are amazing and work hard for this delishness get you a plate ASAP rocky let me know the deal 🥰

author: Abraham Maz
review_text: My favorite hole in the wall chicken spot in LA hands down. Best quality price. Solid plates, you are definitely not leaving hungry. My favorite has to be the famous chicken with fries and sauce. Very unique flavor can’t find anywhere else.  And let’s not forget all the guys who work there, they all deserve medals 👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽

author: Ashley Dean
review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5-Star Review for Dino’s Chicken on Pico! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had the pleasure of trying Dino’s Chicken on Pico, and it was an amazing experience! I ordered the Dino’s chicken plate with chicken fries, and let me tell you, it was absolutely delicious!

The flavors were on point, and the chicken was cooked to perfection - juicy and tender with a mouthwatering crispy exterior. The chicken fries were a unique twist and added an extra level of deliciousness to the meal.

The service was friendly, and the food was served quickly. The overall ambiance of the restaurant was welcoming and made the dining experience enjoyable.

I highly recommend Dino’s Chicken on Pico to anyone looking for some seriously tasty chicken dishes. Whether you’re a fan of classic chicken plates or looking to try something different like the chicken fries, you won’t be disappointed!

Definitely a must-visit spot for all chicken lovers out there. Can’t wait to come back for more!

Keep up the fantastic work, Dino’s Chicken! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Christian Ford
review_text:
I came to Dino’s Famous Chicken & Fries (Pico Blvd location) on a whim after seeing the solid reviews. I was open to trying something new, even though the prices gave me a bit of sticker shock. I asked the cashier if the fries were good and whether they could be made crispy — he said yes, so I went for it.

When the food came out, it was… baffling. The chicken was soaked in juice — not sauce, not marinade, just watery runoff. And the fries? All dumped underneath the chicken, completely soggy and drenched. It was like they had been boiled, not fried.

Maybe that’s a “house style,” but there was no heads-up that the fries would be swimming in chicken runoff. If they had placed the fries on top or on the side, they might have stood a chance. Instead, what I got was a soggy mess.

I politely brought it up to the cashier — the same guy I spoke to earlier — and mentioned the fries were completely soggy because of how the plate was put together. He just shrugged. No apology, no explanation, no offer to make it right. Didn’t even ask to see the problem. I literally said, “Okay, well, I’m not coming back,” in front of a line of other customers, and he didn’t seem to care.

That kind of dismissive attitude is enough to guarantee I won’t be back. It’s one thing to have a unique food style, but it’s another to treat customers like their feedback doesn’t matter.

author: Julia Trinidad
review_text:
Me and my husband live nearby and wanted to come check the restaurant out. We came for dinner and we ordered the chili Verde plate and the shrimp soup. Both were very delicious and worth the price. The employees are very nice and helpful and the restaurant is very lovely. Definitely will be coming back.
The only thing I wish is for you to make a spicy chili Verde!! Thank you!

author: James Campbell
review_text:
A little dim, but very cozy nice decor. The staff are friendly and very helpful. Food is amazing, generous portions.  All the sauces are made from scratch in house. The hot saucy was awesome nice smoky flavor with a good kick. Definitely recommend, this is my new favorite spot fo
r mexican/hispanic food.

author: Matthew Martens
review_text: This was one of the most incredible Mexican restaurants that I have been to. As a Canadian, they made my visit feel like I was a regular by the way they treated me, and the food was absolutely incredible, full of flavor, and the atmosphere was so authentic. On my next trip from Winnipeg I will definitely be sure to visit once again! So thankful for such a great experience!!

author: Cambria Nwosu
review_text: If you are looking for authentic Mexican food with top tier quality, please make the trip here. The food is flavorful and abundant, and the service is top notch. Food came out fresh and didn’t take forever to come out. My family thoroughly enjoyed this.

author: Steve Ortiz
review_text: The restaurant has. Very cozy atmosphere.  The host was excellent and the food was delicious.  I had a carne burrito that was amazing.  The only thing I wasn't thrilled about was I asked the waiter for water and over 30 minutes went by before I had to flag him down to catch is attention.  Other than that this place is a must try.

author: Arvetta Outlaw
review_text: Lunch special was amazing!! Great deals in this economy, the flavour of the food on point, options are plenty. It's great for a quick lunch date or early dinner. My only disdain is the waiter never came to check on us between taking our order and giving us the check. Other than that, perfection!!

author: Shelby Harris
review_text: The most delicious and authentic Mexican cuisine! I had the chicken enchiladas with the red sauce and the chicken was so tasty and favorable. And you cannot beat the price of the food as well! The service is fast and efficient. It is a quaint and cute establishment but all the staff was very friendly and helpful!

author: Meghan O'Rourke
review_text: Incredible food, amazing atmosphere, and service that was truly a 100/10! I went with a group of five, and every single person loved their meal and drinks. Everything we tried was absolutely delicious, and the attention to detail made the whole experience unforgettable. I will definitely be back!

author: tray jackson
review_text: Went for lunch today. Had not been in a few years. Food was great. I had the Colorado burrito. The chips and salsa was good. The margarita was decent. The service was great! It was worth the drive, time and money.

author: MJ
review_text: Food Kool dimly lit. Grand Margarita is pre mixed so if you get one ask for a different liquor then what they use.  Nice service.  I Love this place.

author: Timothy Lu
review_text:
Always a really good time for some Mexican food. Really good value for the amount and quality of food you get. Never have a bad order here and I can recommend everything here without hesitation.

Also, the drinks that they make are pretty strong. Definitely recommend going with the blended margaritas as they tend to be a bit stronger. Decent happy hour deals as well. I would come here for drinks from time to time.

Also the free chips are fire

author: Robert Novic
review_text: Authentic Mexican food with a very homey vibe. Their enchiladas are cheesy and delicious, and the carne asada is tender. The staff are friendly and keep your chips and salsa refilled. Parking is in a small lot out back. A reliable neighborhood favorite

author: Michael Milford
review_text: Yummy food and great atmosphere, walking distance from the USC campus

author: Yerslan Aimakov
review_text: Food is delicious, but a little pricey. Plenty of parking available behind the building.

author: Bernardo Gonzalez
review_text: One of the best Mexican restaurants I’ve been to in the US. Food tasted so fresh. Their sauces are so good. I had the Carne Asada which was splendid. Their beans are also fantastic. The atmosphere is very authentic and peaceful. The restaurant itself is pure art. The minute you walk in, you feel at home. Am so sad that I was only in LA on a trip. But I highly recommend this restaurant. Kudos to the chef and the team for such a great establishment.

author: Michael P (Doctor Mike)
review_text: Have been going here for decades.  Have never had a bad experience or bad meal.  This is one of my favorite Mexican restaurants in the US. Try it if you can!

author: Rosa Garcia
review_text: This restaurant has really great staff. The food is somewhat good. I've tried the appetizer platter and the guac can use some work. Their table salsa varies in taste with the consistency and flavor not being the same. The colossal burrito is stuffed with lettuce and the red sauce can be a bit salty. I would not order that again. Their shredded beef is yummy and tasteful I prefer it over their asada. Great place to eat at, the atmosphere and decoration makes you feel like you've been transported to a beautiful outdoor Pueblo all while sitting inside.

author: Erich Maximo Rodriguez
review_text: This one was a great experience I can comfortably say the service does deserve a 5 star our waiter was on point and attentive treated us like kings just loved it, the food was delicious, good quality, and in large quantity. Also loved the old school Mexican vibe Ambiance, restaurant does get crowd after 5 pm so make sure to make a reservation, There is free parking in the back with a security guard with friendly hospitality. A place where you feel welcomed, Enjoy.

author: Gabby Cruz
review_text: A bit overhyped in my opinion. The food was okay a bit too salty for every one on the table, ordered chicken, beef and shrimp. The meat was overcooked to the point of being chewy. The shrimp was cleaned (de-veined) which I appreciated but overcooked to the pony of  being a bit bitter from how charred it was.  My friend had food spilled on him and the food took very long to get to us. We were content but will not be coming back.

author: O Corpus
review_text: Not sure how this place has 4 start reviews, the fajitas are terrible not sure if that’s how they make them in cali but the food and service was terrible. Texas fajitas way better.

author: Edgar Pineda
review_text: Very good cheese burger & fries. I really enjoyed it. Pepsi refill will cost you 75 cents. Funny.

author: Yerslan Aimakov
review_text: Very nice fast food joint with affordable prices and decent portions. Taste is ok, burgers taste kinda like Burger King, fries are extremely salty though. 1/2 pound cheeseburger combo was $14.52 which is pretty good in today’s economy. Free parking is available.

author: Julie Spathos
review_text: Went for a quick bite but ended up trying more off menu and I didn’t regret it!! What a great restaurant If you’re in this part of town and you gotta try their chicken and salsa and onion rings! Loved everything we tried but those were my favs. They also have orange bang which is a blast from my past! Can’t wait to stop by this gem of a place again soon! Gotta mention their staff also all so fast and friendly! Go try this place out if you’re around.

author: Earthworm Sid
review_text: The grilled chicken here is so delicious with a hint of lime flavor. It is my favorite dish to order here. The buttered bread that comes with each plate of chicken is so addicting. The price for half a piece of chicken plus sides and a drink is super affordable for this day and age!! I totally recommend this place. It’s my favorite when it comes to charbroiled chicken!! 😋😋😋🤤🤤

author: Marcellus Barron
review_text:
I am new to the area. I have been to Olympian Burgers twice now.  The staff is friendly.  They greet you as soon as you enter. The food is very good. Large portions, too. The pastrami sandwich is very good.
I highly recommend this well-established restaurant.

author: Milton Mejía
review_text: Very bad service, the cashiers are always in a bad mood, and they don't pack things properly. Ranch dressing spilled all over my order, I paid extra, and the soda cups are broken; all the soda spilled in my car's cup holder.

author: Felipe Vargas
review_text: Got a cheese burger combo to go and all was really good. I like that the burger patty is the size of the bread!

author: St Francis
review_text:
I love the charbroiled burgers. Olympian has a good breakfast menu and good service too.
They sell a lot of grilled chicken. It's very good. I've been a satisfied customer for about 15 years.
You won't be disappointed. Recently bought a double Cheeseburger at ASTRO Burger for $12.+  It was good.
Olympian uses higher grade quality meat, and the buger is about $10.

author: MOSES NOLASCO
review_text: The place is clean and the cooks are ready to prepare your food as soon as you place your order.  The lady at the cash register is polite and beautiful.  The coffee is a little bit pricey in opinion because is just regular coffee,  anyway; the French toast I ordered were soft, warm and delicious... enjoy it my dear friends.

author: Cesar agusto Urrutia
review_text: The places are clean and  the food is fine .but the only thing is when they give food there no smile 😒 and when u odder it worth  please, owner, look at the camaras, please .....today is Sunday 05/4/25 odder again  and there no smile and we said thank u they don't answer back   owner u need to send someone and see the services she give

author: B Vite
review_text: Reliable local spot for consistently delicious food. No frills. Clean, family place with friendly staff.  I order breakfast burritos for work meetings; always ready on time.

author: Alireza Habibzadeh
review_text: Delicious and smoky. The restrooms are paid though! Even for customers. It’s just a quarter but who has coins these days.

author: enrique mendoza
review_text: Great small family-owned burger place with friendly staff. Food is delicious

author: Joshua Tarabek
review_text: The food was spicy which I like but they didn't have sour cream and that's like a must for my wife. Especially when it's spicy.  But overall the size was good and price wise it was medium priced.

author: Judith Hurtado
review_text: First, did not like that they did not have a kids meal. Second the place was HOT. Third they charge for everything! 25 cents for each ranch, even to use they nasty restroom. Food was decent but not for the price.

author: Victor Pierce Jr
review_text: We actually go to MC BARBER SHOP in this plaza. Reasonable prices & Martha is Excellent!!

author: Michael Stemmeler
review_text: A pretty simple burger and Mexican food joint. You order at the counter, and your number is called up when the food is ready. The steak sandwich with fries was quite tasty, and so we're the French fries.  Lots of locals enjoyed their food, too

author: Angel Saavedra
review_text: The fries were dark brown as if they never change the oil, the onions rings were flavorless and the breading on it fell apart from the onion rings and the breading tasted like if they also use it on shrimp, the buns on the burgers were burnt and a huge piece of tomato took up most of the burger, not a good food experience.

author: Bryan Garcia-Aguilar
review_text: Everything about this place screams authentic old-school burgers. The taste screams, "Amazing!". I'll be coming back to try out the gyros nexts.

author: Elmer Hernandez
review_text:
The young cashier gets mad for any little thing, and I asked for a ln order of toast she wanted to charge me $10
. And she told me go to sleep

author: Sianna Lee
review_text: Thee best Indian resturant in L.A county hands down. Its amazing!!! I told the staff not a lot of spice (i cant take it) and they obliged, the flavor is perfect everything complement each other. I got a Chicken Lunch special its 15.23 with tax but it came with Rice, Chicken, Garlic nann, veggies. They do have vegetarian options as well.

author: ARYAN SINGH PUNDIR
review_text:
WORST Chole Bhature experience of my life!
No flavor, no effort, no quantity — just a sad excuse for a dish.
If this is their idea of North Indian cuisine, it’s an insult to street vendors who actually know how to cook.
Avoid this place like the plague unless you’re into culinary disappointment. 👎🤮

author: Khushi Nakum
review_text: My parents and I stopped by for dinner when I first moved in to USC housing. Now we go for lunch whenever they’re in town to visit. It’s super close to campus, so it’s convenient for students. There’s a large menu and the food is flavorful and well made. The staff are also friendly. Highly recommend!

author: Sohail Gidwani
review_text:
If you are looking for an Indian restaurant near USC, this is the place you can eat from.
I liked the chicken biryani, it was quite good.
Don't try the indo-chinese options, it doesn't even come anywhere near to what you are expecting, at least I didn't like it personally.

author: Nikita Mittal
review_text: "Manas Indian Restaurant in LA is a culinary gem! Exceptional flavors, aromatic spices, and friendly staff create an unforgettable dining experience. Must-try dishes: Butter Chicken & Vegetable Biryani. A delightful taste of India right in the heart of LA!"

author: Erick Sanchez
review_text: Amazing vegetarian option my favorite is the Biryani, definitely is a great place to spend with your friends and family!

author: Chasom was Here
review_text: If you enjoy Indian food as I do very much, this is the place. They have a great selection, met the owners who were so welcoming, and the food was delicious.  If you like Indian food, you will love this place!

author: HninNandar Hlaing
review_text: I recently dined at a restaurant with exceptional staff and outstanding food. The service was impeccable, and the staff went above and beyond to ensure a delightful experience. The menu offered a diverse range of delectable dishes, each prepared with precision and bursting with flavor. The combination of excellent service and delicious cuisine makes this restaurant a must-visit.

author: Prince Shah
review_text: The Indian restaurant provided an exceptional dining experience. The lamb korma I ordered was exquisite, with tender meat and a flavorful, creamy sauce. The service was impeccable, with attentive staff ensuring a pleasant meal. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for delicious Indian cuisine and excellent service.”

author: Cheryl Jackson
review_text: What a great little find! Authentic Indian food that’s absolutely delicious at a very reasonable price. This is a no frills place, so if you’re looking for atmosphere, this is not your jam. But the food is the real star here. Most dishes are offered in mild, medium or hot. Friendly wait staff, too! I’ll definitely will be returning soon, if only for take out.

author: Jacob Ferdman
review_text: Excellent food, authentic flavors and creativity. Linch special is a great deal, Manas special curry is fantastic.

author: Sovit
review_text: Indian Delight impresses with its delicious Indian cuisine and excellent service. The cozy atmosphere, coupled with traditional decor, creates a welcoming dining environment. Highlights include flavorful palak panner and fluffy cheese garlic naan. The attentive staff enhances the experience with their friendly and prompt service. Reasonably priced and generous portions make it a great value. Perfect for both casual meals and special occasions, Indian Delight is a top choice for Indian food lovers.

author: myvi
review_text: Vivi( Vivian) was the best ever. We were at the bar and barntender wasn’t the best but Vivi was best ever . Im coming back because of her

author: Shikhar
review_text: Their daily chicken Thalis were just delicious. The chicken was just cooked perfectly and their vegetarian dish and daal went so well with the rice. The naans were soft and slightly puffy just like the way I like it. Overall the atmosphere was very good too. I watched yje chelsea vs psg Club World Cup match while eating. I really enjoyed my meal and overall experience a lot.

author: Vibhav Deshpande
review_text:
Extremely rude attitude! They refuse service to you for bringing a complaint! I had bought a idli/dosa batter from them which turned out to be expired 7-8 months prior. When I brought the complaint to the lady (probably the owner), she not only refused a refund but refused the service itself to me! She took my shopping cart from me and asked me to get out. When I brought her the expired box to show, she said that she does not want my business and asked me to get out or else she will call the cops!! Let this sync in. She refused service to a customer for bringing a complaint and threatened to call the cops! They can manage to run a business with this kind of attitude because that is the only Indian store in the area and most of the international students have to depend on their service. Extreme lack of business ethics!

Edit :- The owner seems to have replied. Well if you buy fresh, then you should investigate why you had an expired batter instead of refusing service to your customers Lol! But after reading through all the 1 star reviews of your store, the rude behaviour of the lady seems to be a recurring pattern. I would suggest get treated for anger issues instead of shouting at your customers. This will help your business far more than calling your customers 'bogus'.

author: Timothy Teegarden
review_text: I liked this place, would go again. Lunch specials were served on a cute compartmentalized tray.

author: Ab Raham
review_text: Had best experience ever for a store. They were closing and and we ordered food and they had pretty much every option and served food happily

author: Ranjana Bista
review_text: "Fantastic dining experience! The staff at are friendly and attentive, and the food is outstanding. From flavorful curries to aromatic naan, every dish is a culinary delight. Highly recommend!"

author: Jingyang Guo
review_text: chose for my Sunday lunch, and I wasn't expecting too much tbh. The food actually surprised me, the korma tastes great and I literally ate up every rice and every dip of sauce. The wait is relatively long but tolerable. Very likely to comeback in the future

author: James Sawyer Ford
review_text:
The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was full of authentic flavors and perfectly cooked. The staff were incredibly welcoming, attentive, and made us feel right at home.
Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for amazing Indian food and warm hospitality. Will definitely be coming back!

author: 펭돌
review_text: I came across it yesterday for the first time, and overall the food was so neat and delicious. The dumplings you recommended were also delicious. The kindness of the staff made me really happy. It's hard to find good restaurants in LA, but I'll go here often. I'll be there next week as well. Thank you so much staff!

author: J B Eats
review_text: Delicious authentic Indian food here in LA. I definitely recommend if you’re in the area looking for some delicious flavors ! This food is so tasty, enjoyed the chicken masala medium with a garlic naan wich was so good . Side of rice as well. Strawberry smoothy which was great to cool down with. When in the area stop by and check it out !

author: Dipanjan Das
review_text: We are always up for a good plate of Nepalese momos, and this place did not disappoint. Portions are small, and there are 6 momos per plate, so you may need a few plates if you're hungry! The chicken noodles were pretty good as well. We went on a Saturday afternoon and most of the tables were empty. Would definitely visit again if we happen to be in the area.

author: Mitsu Chavda Patel
review_text:
I was craving momos and hence I stumbled upon this place and it was quite an amazing discovery.

Beware of the spice levels though !!

author: Florian rockstroh
review_text: went for the first time after being a long time ago in Nepal and felt good. Momo, the reason I came for been absolutely delicious and we had most likely the best cheese naan I ever had and a lamb khorma on top. All very tasty and prices are like everywhere. Staff is kind and helpful. recommended to give it a try if you haven’t tasted the food or been to the country before.

author: Srinivas Rao
review_text: Good to get the feel of India sitting there...service was good and enjoyed the Indian preparations

author: Scary Eric
review_text: Discovered this fine establishment on google maps  while looking for directions.   Ordered the veggie noodle soup and it was amazing. I’ve never had Himalayan noodles before. The man was fresh and garlicky and went perfectly with the soup. Very charming owners and cute little restaurant. I’ll be back. A lot. .

author: Usman Goni Jabed
review_text: Well, Suddenly I went there for the first time. I liked their Momo item. It’s like 7/10.! I I was in rush, That's why didn’t abled to try different Item. Their price is little bit more than others Indian/Restaurants.(Maybe for the place..-IDK).! Good Luck.

author: Gloria v
review_text: It's on a weird location but wasn't hard to find parking. Other than Indian food, I'm not used to other food they offer and my opinion can only be compared to other Indian restaurants in town. Greeted as soon as we arrived, there wasn't anyone else but a few orders were picked up while we dine.  It's clean and prices are fair, ordered chicken korma and chicken Tikka, one spicy and one not spicy at all. Both ended up being spicy, not unbearable to us but not edible to our toddler. Rice came with order and ordered a Naan as an extra. Only thing I complain about is both curries we're slightly soupier than most places, but taste was still there.

author: Jeff Liwag
review_text: Great, tasty Indian/Nepalese food. We ordered the chicken fried rice, chicken tikka masala, and garlic naan - they were all scrumptious and hit the spot. I asked for medium level spiciness and they nailed it. The garlic naan is made in house, from scratch and it was the most delicious garlic naan (or any naan for that matter) I've ever had. The service is great too. I wish they'd get more customers because they deserve it.

author: Vardaan Tangbe Lama
review_text:
Hands down the best Nepali & Indian restaurant in LA!
I absolutely loved the authentic flavors and delicious food. The warmth and hospitality of the owners made the experience even better-it truly felt like home. Highly recommended for anyone craving real Nepali and Indian taste.

Thank you so much!

author: Keri Carter
review_text: Food and service is great. Got the chicken biryani and chicken tikka masala. Amazing 10/10!

author: Nirmala Adh
review_text: Loved not only the food but also the service! I had to come early & wait for my family, they were very accommodating & made sure I am comfortable. Food (everything I ordered) was tasty, good portion (one item fills you up), reasonably price, prepared pretty quick (within 15 min, meal was served for all 5 people). They went above & beyond to fill our need & served every request with grace. They even offered complimentary rice & salad. Very appreciative of the chef as well as the server.

author: P B
review_text:
The first time I came, pre Covid-19, it was Indian owned, everyone was very welcoming and friendly, and the food tasted authenticly Indian.  It was so great and flavorful!

This time, it was very clearly not Indian owned.  The food and the service was alright but, this was my second time here and the feel and experience was completely different.  Nothing like before!

If I do return, it would be solely based on location and convenience.

author: Vanessa
review_text: The best Indian food and love the garlic nann bread and fried dumplings 🥟 I highly recommend this place if you want something different. So yummy 😋

author: Satish Khadka
review_text: I recently ordered chicken momo from the Himalayan restaurant for takeout. The flavors were delightful and the taste was quite good. However, there were a few letdowns in the experience. Unfortunately, some of the momo pieces were not steamed properly. I noticed flour residue on a few of them, and to make matters worse, some pieces had a rather hard texture. This oversight had a negative impact on my overall meal, as it disrupted the enjoyment of the dish and left my bowl in a bit of a mess. While the taste was promising, the inconsistency in the steaming process was a downside. I hope the restaurant takes note of these concerns and works to ensure a more consistent and satisfying dining experience for its patrons.

author: Harshit Hegde
review_text: The food was good and fresh, but the service was disappointing. When we asked for a box to pack our leftovers, we were only given aluminum foil instead. This made us feel disrespected, and we had to leave the food behind.

author: Sarah Garrison-Taylor
review_text: Great staff! Great food! Lovely atmosphere! Looking forward to the next time I am in the area so I can eat here again.

author: Melvin Morataya
review_text: This place is soooooo goooooddd ...I have a satisfied full warm tummy guys ...I ordered there lentil soup and tandoori chicken was so perfect delicious you'll love this place so relaxing and satisfying

author: S RAJ PRODUCTION - COMMUNITY ACTIVITES
review_text:
Disappointing Experience at Himalayan House

Food Quality
- Ordered Chicken Karahi, but it had a bad smell, making it unpleasant to eat.
- Requested green chili, but was given only a tiny quarter-sized piece after a long wait.

Customer Service
- The employee's attitude was unprofessional, creating a poor impression.
- Slow service and lack of attention to customer requests.

Guest Experience
- Brought my guest expecting a good meal, but one of them experienced vomiting afterward.
- Felt mistreated, especially as someone from India/Nepal, making the visit uncomfortable.

Final Verdict
Based on this visit, I **do not recommend** this restaurant, especially for South Asian guests, as the overall experience was disappointing.

author: Kathy Rodriguez
review_text: This Taco Bell saved my life. I do Uber eats and I work late at night and I was craving Taco Bell and they came through because they’re open 24 hours. Also the worker was super nice

author: 劉品辰
review_text: Food is ok, but there’s just so many strange people appearing in the evening.

author: Eclipse classic
review_text: Way to HOT!!! 🔥 🔥 Hottest jalapeno pepper they could find. I asked the staff and they thought it was funny.

author: andrew O
review_text: Taco Bell employees are well equipped for serving the community with a wide variety of different meals including a delicious late night meal with a healthy environment clean and fresh friendly service

author: Adeife Johnson
review_text: This is my go to taco bell. They often don't have my order despite ordering ahead. Which kind of defeats the purpose. But last time I ordered not only did they not give me the signature ranch dipping sauce, which the app makes you select. But one of the nuggets was an inedible brick, that was way over fried. Do better!

author: Bob Smith
review_text:
It’s pretty good for a Taco Bell. I’ve been here a hundred times or so and I’ve almost never or never had bad experiences.
One time there was a guy eating with a cat on his shoulders. That was cool 👍

author: Conner Smith
review_text: Evening shift deserves some respect tonight! Dining room perfectly clean, food out quickly, and I even had my sauce and drink before the food was done with a mobile order! The guy working tonight was particularly caring, and I appreciated it!

author: Kevin Flores
review_text: Nachos fries with cheese and steak were really good but it was a small portion. 8/10

author: karla linares
review_text: They said there restrooms was not working and I see a worker coming out of the restrooms

author: Shannen Blount
review_text: I was racially profiled by the cashier and the lead staff. If a company has a policy it should be enforced across the board not at the employees discretion. The cashier handed five order to customers without any information, but at my turn she verified that my order was there and insisted on see my order on the app. It is really sad to see other minority practice these same prejudicial practices.

author: Patty Alva
review_text: I stood for 15mins NOBODY greeted nobody said One word to me. They just kept staring a me. It was Online pickup order, the order wasn’t in the pickup area. A guy FINALLY gave me my order. Didnt say a Hello o have a nice Day, NOTHING. Place is DIRTY AND SMELLS HORRIBLE! Get it together TACO BELL.

author: RJ C.
review_text: The staff members are all busy in the kitchen, so you’ll be waiting for a long time to pick up your food. It would be nice to have at least one person attend to the food pick-up people! They made our burrito wrong, so we had to wait 10 mins to get it fixed. Otherwise, it’s like any other Taco Bell.

author: Nikita Mittal
review_text: Taco Bell offers a unique fast-food twist on Mexican favorites. Budget-friendly, it serves up familiar tastes with a modern flair. Though not authentic Mexican cuisine, the brand nails consistency and speed. Perfect for late-night cravings or a quick bite. Some hits, some misses, but always dependable. 🌮🔔

author: Marve Darwin Peter Gutierrez
review_text: ALWAYS Double check your order , every time I order something they swap it to other customers, and sometimes my order is incomplete.

author: Rochelle Flores
review_text: I gave 3 stars on atmosphere, because we had a drive through order. Food was better this time, the last time we ordered, our bean burrito was a sad paste of a bean something. It didn’t taste like beans, it look like it was just a layer of bean paste, and called it a burrito.

author: Ernest Webb
review_text: It's clean but there is no taste except for style lettuce and taco shells . I'm done with this place for ever.

author: 펭돌
review_text: I went here today and bought two combos. The staff here were unfriendly and felt very bad because the coke didn't contain any carbonic acid. It was just sugar water. I don't want to go again. This restaurant needs to check the beverage machine. How can there be no soda coke?

author: PJ
review_text:
7am staff is fabulous and friendly  🤩
"In Store" experience is peaceful; the playlist is calming.
The Coffee Cream is a little weird but I left there a happy camper.

author: Ryan
review_text: They messed up on my friends order, but did give him a voucher for free burrito.. I guess that makes up for it. My order was fine. And taco bell always delivers..

author: Lu Bu
review_text: Im removing my 5 star review for removing the fiesta veggie burrito. Change the price if needed- why remove it entirely.. need more vegetarian options - such as the fiesta veggie burrito… I’ll change it back to 5 stars if you bring it back, thank you

author: Jennifer
review_text:
Went to this location earlier during the week and had a great experience!

The moment I walked in, Jillian not only greeted me with a bright smile but took my order really fast! She was very professional, friendly and gave me a great drink recommendation!

I decided to eat in-house and was impressed by Noah's diligence in keeping the dining room spotless and making sure everyone was good. He even took the time to check in on me, offering extra napkins and sauces - great service! Will definitely come back 😊

author: Тамара Гулина
review_text: Cobb salad is not tasty, very salty ingredients and sauce, it would be better if the chicken was grilled, I eat it deep-fried. Grilled Chicken Club is tasty - the grilled chicken was tasty and soft, the chicken in the salad was not tasty. The staff is friendly, the prices are affordable, the service is fast. In the hall they asked us if we liked everything. I recommend. P.S. The cafe plays classical music. It is very rare to hear such a repertoire in a fast food restaurant.

author: Adrian C.L.
review_text:
La Chuperia is definitely a must! It’s the perfect spot to pregame if you’re heading to an event at BMO or the Coliseum. They’ve got a great variety of specialty drinks from Micheladas to spiked agua frescas and every one looks better than the last.

As soon as my eyes landed on the Chuper Mango Cart Michelada, I knew what I was ordering. Topped with fresh mango chunks and paired with Mango Cart beer… 10/10, hands down! I even had to snap a pic and send it to my wife, promising a trip here soon (though let’s be real, that promise was more for me 😂).

The vibe is lively, the drinks are on point, and while the food menu leans more appetizer-style, it’s still solid. Just don’t roll in starving come for the drinks, the energy, and the good times.

author: whiplash girlchild
review_text: Came here after a concert and we ordered a sandwich with nuggets but they didn't give us the sandwich. Didn't notice till we got to our hotel and chik fil a was closed so we couldn't go back. Very disappointed. Spent 12.95 for no sandwich.

author: Jpezze
review_text: So I placed an order in store gave my name and used my app to collect points every time I come to this location on it’s an issue my order was ready and the guy working a white man could not say my name he was about to put my food up on the stand to wait I’m literally sitting in front of the counter not only that the name is in the bag and it also say the color of my shirt on the bag but I guess because I’m black native descent he didn’t not care ever other store I visit says my name even if it’s not correct but this store it always an issue that why I try my hardest not to come here

author: lillian meza
review_text: This is my favorite chicken burger place, always look for original flavors and this place has it, especially the sauce and the crispy chicken, like to order the deluxe with cheese combo, the staff has always been friendly, the service is usually very fast and coordinated it seems like, the only thing I would suggest is if they could also open on Sundays as I often forget and have had to go to other places when I have a sunday crave, overall great place.

author: Henry Smith
review_text: Good food, excellent service, if the service wasn't good enough, an employee went outside with a tray of sauces to ask people eating on the tables there if they wanted any. Absolutely beautiful service. Food is usually good but for fries I wouldn't order anything besides a large, as I got about 5 full size fries in a medium, although I think that's just Chick-Fil-A portion sizes. There's a huge difference between medium and large. Also, the fries in general always have a problem in this location, it's either too much or too little salt and sometimes the fries are just stale. I'd still give the food a 4 nonetheless.

author: josselyn chirinos
review_text: I had order lunch from this restaurant through Uber eats and aside from them giving me the work sizes of fries I got a long white hair on my sandwich which completely ruined my lunch.

author: Takahiro Koyama
review_text:
Crispy Chicken Sandwich with Delicious Original Sauce!

Chick-fil-A is a popular American fast-food chain known for its top-notch chicken sandwiches, nuggets, and friendly service.

【Chick-fil-A Deluxe Sandwich】
This sandwich includes a seasoned, freshly breaded chicken breast, pressure-cooked in 100% refined peanut oil, served on a toasted, buttered bun with pickles, lettuce, tomato, and American cheese. The delicious sauce complements the fresh ingredients perfectly.

author: Wise seer
review_text: The food was very good and the service was very good too.I'm only giving it a 4 on the  atmosphere because it was a lot of people there and I couldn't get my order in enough time but other than that I had a good experience

author: melanie quiroz
review_text: skimmed out on the fries, ordered a large expecting it to at least be more filled

author: Lily Sandoval
review_text:
Despite being right in the heart of USC and always packed with crowds from the students, this Chick-fil-A never misses a beat. They consistently get my order right and it’s always ready on time.

The place stays impressively clean given how busy it gets, and the staff does a great job keeping the service friendly, fast, and efficient.

It’s clear they care about maintaining high standards — even during the rush. Definitely one of the more reliable spots around campus. Only down fall is that parking really sucks. Unless you park in the parking garage, but even that seems a little bit overpriced for my liking.

author: Ashly Morales
review_text: Ordered a Cobb salad. It was delicious. Someone came by to clean my table as well. Great attention to detail.

author: John Catalano
review_text: Very hard to get parking, food was asnyounwould expect though. I guess I'm just a tourist that isn't used to there not being a drivethru.

author: Brandon Giolzetti
review_text: Raul was absolutely exceptional. He brought us extra sauces and made us laugh! Will be coming back.

author: J P
review_text: Really clean. Staff is friendly as always. Parking is a beast around there, but I'm assuming they are catering to museum visitors and students.

author: Daniel Navrozidis
review_text: The staff were great and kind, the food on the other hand is bland not worth it for the price. There are better fast food alternatives.

author: David Lagro
review_text:
This is the first Chick-fil-A that I have ever walked into, so I can’t give a comparison to other franchise.  The line was long when I entered as several people walked in just ahead of me.  The staff were fantastic and methodically whittled down the line.  The food was ready quickly and I was out the door.  My sandwich and fries were fresh and hot, and my shake was cold and creamy.
Job done!

author: Paul Kohn
review_text: Even though it was busy, I still got great service. Food is amazing!

author: CruzeFamily Blessed
review_text: We love it here. The customer service is immaculate. Everyone’s so nice and kind makes the food taste even better today I want to give a special thanks to Stephany for putting a smile on my one year-old son face it’s just the small things in life that can really touch a heart and make a big difference. Keep up the good work Chick-fil-A of USC.

author: April Bartol
review_text: Ordered at 11:43p. Said pick up was at 12:03a. So, I went to pick it up, got there at 11:58p. I saw my name on the Carry Out Screen. At 12:02a, my name disappeared off the screen. Asked the girl up front, Irene, why my name wasn't up there. She gave a look of "meh", then completely ignored me. So, I thought it wasn't ready. Yes, I understand they were busy after the concert release. But to completely ignore a customer with a question, a bit disrespectful.  So after seeing a set of customers walk out that ordered AFTER I asked about my food. Then, I asked the manger on duty that happened to be at the register. Told her that I've been waiting and my name isn't on the screen. She said classic wings take longer to cook.  I said I order at a quarter til. She then turned around and grabbed a bag off the shelf. I told her that NO ONE called my name, and I've heard staff repeat call names when they weren't picked up yet. I told her that her front person completely ignored me when I asked a simple question. So, IRENE cleared my name before even calling my name. Finally got my food at 12:35a, food was ok, but would have been better if I was able to get my order when Door Dash told me it was ready to pick up.

author: Joseline Animates
review_text:
I ordered 22 original hot wings , and 5 cajun wings. BUT THEYRE ALL PLAIN!
i’m calling them to talk about my order but they have put me on hold for more than 30 minutes.

author: Kieun Huh
review_text:
Date of Visit: July 29, 2025

I walked into Wingstop around 7:47 PM to pick up my order, which included wings and the free 5 wings promotion they were offering. The store was crowded, with many people waiting or still ordering at the counter. I understand that it was a busy evening, but the experience I had clearly showed poor customer service and a lack of communication from the staff.

I approached the pickup area and showed my order details on my phone to two employees at the front. One Hispanic man and one Hispanic woman. I showed them my name and showed my order more than once. They both saw it. But instead of giving a clear update or showing basic courtesy, the Hispanic woman rolled her eyes at me and other customers. That kind of reaction is unprofessional, especially during a high-volume time.

A simple response like, “Your order is coming up soon,” or even, “Thank you for your patience,” would have made customers feel seen and respected. But the silence and the attitude only made things worse. I overheard another customer who had ordered at 7:30 PM still waiting at 7:59 PM, visibly frustrated. There was no apology or explanation given to them either.

When a business tells customers to go to the pickup counter and confirm their name, it should not lead to eye rolls or dismissive behavior. It felt like staff were annoyed just for having to do their job. That is not acceptable.

The entire situation showed a lack of proper training, leadership, and communication. No one was managing the floor. Staff seemed overwhelmed and unprepared, and customers were left confused and ignored. It reflected poorly on the store.

This experience was disappointing. I hope the management takes serious steps to improve how their team communicates and treats customers, especially during busy hours. A little respect and basic updates can go a long way in improving customer satisfaction.

author: ena nieto
review_text: This guys did not send me my orders right they send me leftovers I was missing chicken wigs and the fries were nasty and cold also the wings I want my money back but they won’t answer me back

author: Jalayla Red
review_text:
I had one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve ever encountered at this Wingstop location, and I feel compelled to share it—not just for myself, but as a warning to others.

I walked in and waited in line for over 15 minutes. When it was finally my turn, the employee Edwin completely ignored me and allowed two women who arrived after me to cut in front and place their order. He didn’t ask who was next, didn’t acknowledge me, and when I spoke up, he brushed me off with, “I already started their order,”—as if that made it okay to skip someone who had been clearly waiting.

I’m a Black customer, and the women he served first were Hispanic—like him—and while I can’t say for certain, it felt very personal. Whether it was discrimination, favoritism, or just plain disrespect, it was unprofessional, rude, and deeply uncomfortable.

This experience completely changed the way I view this location. If you’re someone who expects to be treated with basic respect and fairness—especially if you’re a person of color—you may want to think twice before coming here. No one deserves to be disregarded, dismissed, or made to feel less than because of who they are.

I truly hope corporate takes this seriously. Edwin’s behavior is unacceptable and reflects very poorly on the brand. Until there’s accountability and proper training at this location, I won’t be returning—and I suggest others don’t either.

author: Sharron green
review_text: Food is amazing staff is so friendly and prices isn't bad you need to tell them how saucey you like your wings but that's fine it's more than enough for my family of seven they don't disappoint

author: Sarah Liddell
review_text: The person who worked at the order stand on midnight on 10/25 was very patient and kind.

author: Jason Foo
review_text:
Great food. Fast service. Had an absolute great time eating there. Really great sauces and chickens. Use an app to order for faster service.

Probably lacked a bin for rubbish, otherwise all good.

author: Oracio Hernandez
review_text: This wingstop is by the USC. I was there on 06-19-25 around 2:00pm. I spent 50 dollars for a family meal. The chicken  strip were hard and those were for my kids, the wings were flavorless, my fries weren't fully done. I'm actually gonna stop eating out for a while.

author: Dino Bands
review_text: “I had a great experience at Wingstop thanks to the amazing crew—Ruben, Ivone, Edwin, Henry, and Jason. Their service was fast, friendly, and professional, and they made sure everything was perfect. Big shoutout to the team for their hard work and great customer service!”

author: Hashlye Gonzalez
review_text: Horrible place! Took an hour for my order to come out wrong . I ordered a 20 boneless original hot but instead got a 10 LEMON PEPPER . Outrageous. Every time I come here they don’t serve wings instead they serve chicken nuggets . What is that . I need a refund and a Time Machine for my time wasted . Don’t come here .

author: B W
review_text: Ridiculous "rules" I ordered 8pc combo and wanted a 6pc wings only but they said I could only get the 5pc if it wasn't a combo then the 5pc does come with ranch u have to pay $2 to get a ranch if I order wings no matter how many I should at least get 1 sauce

author: E. Clara Verill
review_text: Wings were a bit tough and dry and the wait time was fairly long. No napkins were provided or visible. However, the offer of water was much appreciated, so 4 stars for service.

author: serin_rxses
review_text: Good food! I like the mango habanero sweet and addictive but spicy.

author: Braksigmog C
review_text: Food is good, service is normal. It's very difficult to find parking and their fountain drink machines are always out of service or soda.

author: Balmore Rene Esquivel
review_text: The food was good. The chicken wings can be a little bit more tender. Sometimes they're a little bit dry.

author: SavyLA
review_text: Best experience here at this location. Awesome service. Awesome employees. Will be “my spot” when I’m around this area.

author: Derek Liu
review_text: The restaurant is extremely dirty and the food is not well prepared. My chicken tenders were far too salty, I could not finish them. Additionally, the employees here are off-putting and rude.

author: Peter Michel
review_text: Wanted wings only amd was forced to get a comboniani unless I ordered a 10piece. We are forced to buy a soda when we only a drink. ALSO I ORDERED BONE IN WINGS AND I GOT BONE OUT WINGS.

author: Pablo Pinto
review_text: Great food great workers but bathroom never works and it's packed with USC students

author: Yuliia Biliak
review_text:
Absolutely delicious!
We had an amazing experience at this Mexican restaurant. The food was full of bold, authentic flavors and perfectly seasoned. The tacos were juicy, the sauces rich, seafood was super tasty. You can really taste the freshness of the ingredients and the care put into every dish. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, and the service was friendly and attentive. We will definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone who loves great Mexican sea food!
Sea scallops are hit!

author: Asli Akal
review_text:
Really fresh food!
Holbox has been on my list for a long time, and for seafood, I think it's very reasonably priced. It's located in Mercado la Paloma and has free parking. We arrived around 6:30 p.m. on a Saturday, and the line was about 20 minutes long. The mercado was pretty busy, so it was slightly hard to find a good place to sit. However, the service was very fast. The ambiance is casual and lively.
We got ceviche mixto, smoked kanpachi tostada, Baja fish taco, taco de pulpo en su tinta, and churros!
The ceviche mixto is a must, it was incredibly fresh! I would skip the smoked kanpachi tostada and taco de pulpo on my next visit; I thought they were just okay.
The Baja fish taco was amazing, definitely try it! The star of the night was definitely the churros! They were crunchy on the outside and moist on the inside, and the chocolate sauce was delicious. Overall, it totally deserves the hype.

author: Amber Zhang
review_text: Absolutely phenomenal seafood! It’s located in a busy food hall and the lines get crazy (expect a 1-hour wait on weekends), but the flavors are unbeatable. This has become my go-to spot whenever I visit LA. Everything is so fresh and perfectly prepared. If you have the time, you HAVE to eat here!

author: Zeno Lee
review_text:
Holbox definitely had some amazing dishes.  Their fish tacos and their octopus were exceptional.  The scallop aquachilles were a little too sour for us and the ceviche was good, but just as good as any other restaurant we been to.

The presentation was amazing.  And we generally really enjoyed the meal.  The only thing that was challenging was waiting in line and then finding seats.

We got there 30 minutes before open on Saturday and we waited just a little more than an hour.  So 30 minutes after they opened.  That wasn't bad considering the line got considerabl7 longer after we arrived.  Then next challenge was finding a table.  So many people were saving tables even though they weren't eating.

Holbox definitely need to relocate to a new location.  Would definitely go back for the fish tacos.

author: CB Architect-Builder
review_text:
The food here is simply orgasmic!  My son and I bought a diverse selection of dishes and loved every single one!  Talk about food coma!  Hope we can visit again sometime soon! There was a bit of a wait and line to get in as you’d imagine but it moved along and was worth it! The fact that it’s a food court takes away some of the “fine dining experience” and the interior of the place isn’t fancy at all but the food makes up for it!  Pricing also seemed reasonable for the quality and flavor!
Not being able to buy liquor (cocktails, beer or wine) also helps keep costs down.  Anyway,
highly recommend!!

author: JB Jose
review_text:
My brother took me this Michelin-starred seafood place. Though it’s in a food hall, it’s not food hall prices. The quality of the dishes were still outstanding and worthy of the cost.

The highlight for me was the sopa de mariscos. The flavors reminded me of how we used to have it as a youth, if not the texture. The seafood was abundant and fresh. Other highlights include the delicious tostadas and the fresh uni and scallop. Try all the dishes with their home made hot sauces.

Though the wait was about 25 minutes to be sat at prime dinner time, it’s still definitely worth it. We’ll be back.

author: Vincent Crisol
review_text: Holbox serves some of the best seafood I’ve had, delivering Michelin level quality in a casual market setting. The scallop aguachile was incredibly fresh and beautifully presented, while the octopus and fish tacos were cooked to perfection. Since it's located in the busy Mercado La Paloma, be prepared for a bit of a wait. Because seating is shared with other restaurants, I highly recommend bringing a partner to scope out a table while you wait in line. The logistics take a little effort, but the food is absolutely worth the hustle. It is an absolute must visit for any seafood lover in LA.

author: Julia Tsang
review_text:
This is probably my third or fourth time eating here, it seems every time I come the queue got longer and longer. This time the queue reached the beginning of the adjacent parking lot, maybe about 100 people, crazy! We stayed anyway, queued in the cold and rain for at least 45 minutes. Since it is within a food court, you have to find your own table, though we party of 5 found a table instantly.

They provide free water and 4 levels of hot sauces. Food is excellent as always, hence so many people are willing to queue into the rain!

Note to those dislike cilantro, their ceviches are very strong in cilantro taste, plenty mixed into the sauce that can not be picked out.

author: Jimmy Su
review_text:
Came here with a friend for lunch on Friday and this place totally deserves its Michelin star. We got there about 15 minutes before opening, so parking was easy and we were part of the first group in line.

Holbox serves Yucatán-style seafood tacos, and every single one we tried was incredible. We ordered the scallop taco, octopus taco, smoked kanpachi taco, Baja fish taco, and the aguachile with spot prawn and scallops. The scallop was buttery and sweet, the octopus was super tender with that perfect char, and the smoked kanpachi had this deep, smoky flavor that was just insane. The aguachile was bright, spicy, and refreshing—perfect for a warm day.

The service was exceptional. You order at the counter, and they somehow manage to bring everything out quickly and perfectly timed, even with so many tables scattered around the market. It’s impressive how smoothly everything runs.

We finished with the churros and chocolate sauce, which were the perfect ending—crispy, light, and the chocolate was rich but not overly sweet.

The small lot is paid (about $4 an hour), but there’s some free street parking if you get lucky. Definitely worth coming a little early for a spot.

Can’t wait to come back and try more of the menu, especially anything with uni. This place is a gem.

author: Now.Loading.Carlos
review_text:
Holbox completely lived up to and honestly exceeded its Michelin-star reputation. We ordered the scallop ceviche, kampachi, lobster, and the fresh uni… and every dish was an absolute standout.

The scallop ceviche was bright and silky, bursting with clean citrus flavors. The kampachi had that perfect buttery texture, so fresh it practically melted. The lobster was rich, sweet, and cooked to perfection. But the uni wow. Creamy, briny, and unbelievably fresh… now I fully understand why Holbox earned its Michelin star.

Every plate was thoughtful, balanced, and executed with precision. This is seafood at its highest level innovative, respectful of the ingredients, and genuinely unforgettable.

Holbox remains one of LA’s true culinary gems. If you love world-class seafood, this place is non-negotiable.

author: Claudia Michelle Chandra
review_text:
I am so glad I came to Holbox in a large group because I got to try a lot of the menu items!! Every single dish in this place is out of this world. As someone who is usually averse to seafood, I have to admit that the seafood here is orgasmic!! Especially the fresh uni 🤤🥲

This restaurant definitely deserves its Michelin star. Each dish tasted intentional and offered mouthwatering flavors. I did not expect such an experience from a restaurant that is located within a food court. honestly, you can't even classify Holbox as a restaurant because it is more of a booth 😅

We arrived at around 11:30 AM and there was already a long line all the way to the car park. Thankfully, the line moved along quickly. The food is absolutely worth the weight and I cannot wait to return to this place on my next trip to LA.

author: Muge Selcuk
review_text:
We had lunch at Holbox around noon, and even with the line, we were seated in less than 30 minutes. The service was warm, friendly, and quick. The food was excellent — we tried the sea urchin, grilled branzino, octopus, smoked fish and scallop tacos, and churros. Every bite was fresh, flavorful, and well-balanced.

Despite being a Michelin-starred restaurant, the prices were quite reasonable. Watching the chef chat with guests added a personal touch. Overall, everything — food, service, and value — came together perfectly. We’re definitely planning to return and try the tasting menu.

author: Yuelin Li
review_text:
Hidden inside Mercado La Paloma, Holbox is a Michelin-starred seafood counter that completely lives up to the hype.
We tried the uni & scallop tostada — freshly opened sea urchin topped with scallop and green salsa, unbelievably sweet and creamy.
The Filete al Carbon (grilled sea bass with cilantro rice) was perfectly cooked — crispy skin, tender meat, and full of flavor.
Both octopus and fried fish tacos were light, crunchy, and fresh, especially with their house-made hot sauces.
The Kanpachi ceviche was bright and balanced, a perfect mix of acid and spice.

Everything tasted so clean and ocean-fresh.
It’s a casual spot, not fancy at all, but the quality easily rivals high-end restaurants.

author: Victoria Marie
review_text:
I came here for the seafood and left questioning my emotional readiness for a live cooking demonstration. The tostada? Was amazing. The aqua chile? Just ok, but I’ve had better elsewhere. I also tried the uni scallop — buttery, oceanic, and definitely worth a try.

The real plot twist was watching a lobster flailing after being cut in half alive. Not exactly the tableside performance I was hoping for. 🦞😳

All in all, the food’s fresh and delicious, but the hype is in the Michelin rating. There’s great seafood in L.A., and Holbox is up there — just maybe… bring emotional support if you’re squeamish.

I’ll go again to check it out one more time. The line is real.

author: Sasha M
review_text: A Michelin-recognized, upscale taco spot that became famous thanks to social media buzz. I went fairly early in the evening, so the line wasn’t too long, and I was able to get a seat at the bar right away. It’s not a fully open kitchen, but you can still see part of the action — the staff all looked incredibly busy and dedicated. The server was quick, attentive, and provided great service. The food came out fast, and everything tasted exceptionally fresh. Every bite was full of flavor and satisfaction. I’d definitely love to come back to try more of their dishes.

author: Patrick No
review_text:
Definitely worth doing a little drive to get to this elevated food court and trying Holbox. This is some of the city’s best fresh Mexican cuisine, with a focus on seafood.

Do yourself a favor and order a bunch of stuff, it’s worth it. We got: Branzino, Scallop Aguachile, fresh Santa Barbara Uni, Kanpachi & Uni Tostada, Kanpachi Taco, and Baja Fish Taco.

Overall, whatever you do, get the Scallop Aquachile and something with Sea Urchin. By far, probably the best Sea Urchin I’ve had in my life. The Smoked Kampachi Taco was quite good too, it had a peanut chili oil (Salsa Macha) which I’ve never seen before until here. Really cool.

The Branzino was fresh and cooked perfectly, with insanely good blue corn tortillas to go alongside. The Baja Fish taco was pretty standard.

All in all, I try to come here every time I come to LA now. You get FRESH FRESH FISH here and it shows. Recently, there’s been lines out the door. Worth the wait, I think, but maybe come at a weird time and you won’t have to worry.

All of this order was like $100.

author: Sabs A
review_text: These plates were well-worth the long line, outdoors, in the rain. The aguachile scallops were filled with flavor that left my tongue tingling on occasion. This was my first time having sea urchin, but the creaminess and freshness of all the seafood was memorable. I don’t think the urchin made the dish - the scallops and salsa would have been great on their own, but the urchin added some nice buttery texture that added to it. I can’t wait to return!

author: Taka H
review_text:
AFFORDABLE and DELISH!
Parking is on the streets or scan the QR when you park to pay. Others park in the DMV parking lot too.

There's normally a line but the staff is VERY efficient in ensure it gets pushed through smoothly including no one trying to cut the line

FOOD 5/5
Is always consistent coming here back to back times.

- Baja Fish Taco
- Baja Shrimp Taco = I COULD EAT ENDLESS AMOUNTS OF THIS
- Filete Al Carbon
- Pulpo a Las Brasas = TOP CHOICE just like the taco they have!
- Shrimp Aguachile = Super fresh
- Tostada de Jurel + ceviche are amazing!
- Sopa De Mariscos
- Mascarpone Pumpkin Spice Cheesecake = perfect amount to compliment the courses

CLEAN AMBIENCE 4/5
Since it shares with our restaurants is busy but you're able to find seats every time you come.

SERVICE 4/5
Quick and attentive staff from ordering, bringing out the food, and cleaning up the tables

PARKING 4/5
It can get difficult on the time you come

author: Samer Salib
review_text: Amazing very high quality seafood taco options at an affordable price. The Baja fish tacos were so crispy and so tasty, my wife loved it, we had to order a second round! The Baja shrimp tacos were also great and a good size compared to any shrimp tacos I ever had. The octopus tacos were cooked just right and were large enough to have a good chew and bite and I really liked the sauce that came with it. The scallops taco was cooked to perfection like I’ve never tasted scallops this well cooked before! Finally, it was my first time to try sea urchins, and they were absolutely delicious! I loved how it was presented and the I really enjoyed the ceviche that came with it. It was so fresh and creamy it melted in my mouth. Great staff and food service. I highly recommend as a first time Michelin star restaurant on a budget.

author: Sky
review_text:
I had huge expectation for Michelle 1 star. Long story short, it is not worth to wait 1 hour to get the food. I might try again if no line.
The octopus was good but not exceptional, the sauce was not aligned with octopus and not tasty.
The Aguachille was too sour and couldn't enjoy it well. Octopus taco was good. Smoked kanpachi taco was hmmmm. I don't smell any smoke and just plain taco.
Urchin was good and I might come back for it. Lemonade was fresh good, but not super excellent. Dish setting is good for the price but not Michelle star up scale.
I think there are lots of people due to relatively reasonable price for Michelle star, but taste is not balanced well, and not tasty  for the star value.

author: Troy Foltz
review_text: Waffle was undercooked, rubbery and bland. They no longer provide butter for customers. Fried chicken was over cooked, and flavorless. Over priced and terrible food. Wouldn't come back

author: Brenda
review_text:
Wonderful new concept of multiple food offerings in one interesting location. The process was simple and food was ready for pick up in 8 minutes. I am looking forward to trying other food shops here. I will probably order prior to arrival next time so I can just drive right through. Finding a nice place to sit and eat is going to be a challenge as the area is still up and coming.
I have faith

author: Heidi Liou
review_text: If you’re going to order directly and physically come here (vs using Uber eats for example), make sure you order ahead. Highly recommend Brady’s Bakery for delicious cookies! We just got the cookies to go rather than the “made to order” cookies since we didn’t want to wait longer.

author: Carolynn LaRocca
review_text: The ordering and pick up process, and convenient location were all fantastic! We got our order from Detroit Pizza Depot. Their pizza made this born-in-Detroit woman VERY happy. Now I don’t need to wait for a visit to family and friends in Michigan to get Detroit-style pizza. And they have Faygo pop too!

author: richard g
review_text: Had high hopes with lovelys chicken almost as high as the prices, yet was extremely disappointed. The chicken wasn't even tenders like I ordered and were some reheated old stale chicken that was hard as a rock. Then the waffle was dryey than the dessert. Absolutely terrible food worst chicken I've received in LA.

author: Ny Delancy
review_text: I stumbled upon grand food Depot, purely by accident rushing around Los Angeles on a Friday afternoon, desperate to salvage a dinner party after my original caterer canceled last minute. Within a minute, they created a spread of fresh produce, artisan cheeses, specialty sauces and a selection of important spices that made my kitchen feel like a five star restaurant. Great food great service

author: beth b
review_text: Food is HEAVILY OVERPRICED for what you’re getting. For starters, the photos on the kiosk menu does not match what you’re gonna get at all. The food is fast food level at best. I got some pho, chicken tenders, fries, and two drinks and paid $110. No place to sit and eat.

author: AnunA Gankhuu
review_text: Incredibly top-of-the-food-chain grade wings from Banh Mi Cafe. Lemon pepper and Thai Chilli flavored ones were Chef’s kiss. Truly a blissful experience. The Garlic Soy Sauce Spring Rolls were not deep fried, more Summer Roll. That one was a sad emoji face. But the Wings overpowered the disappointment of the spring rolls.

author: Daniel Bray
review_text: I found this place by accident while looking for free parking near USC. Decided to give it a try. Really cool concept. Ordered a cheese steak. Waiting about 8 minutes in the lot before I got a text that my food was ready. Pull up through the alley to the vendor and grabbed my food. Cheese steak was middle of the road (my car still smells like it two days later). I’d like to see this concept rolled out in more places. Great idea

author: Jenelle Leane Velsa
review_text: A long drive thru with a bunch of restaurants to choose from. Such a cool concept and service was fast and orderly! HIGHLYYY recommend the chicken karaage bowl from Shin Sen Gumi Express

author: Randy Abulon
review_text:
there's no seating or amenities for eating at the location. so the atmosphere was 'ok'.

there are several vendors at this location, as it's more geared towards the food delivery services than the walk up customers.

i ordered a pastrami philly cheesesteak sandwich, and the pastrami was very tasty. the sliced steak seemed a little over seasoned but was still good. would recommend trying one of the cheeses versus their cheese whiz, just as a balance for their version. both meats were very juicy and tender though, as the bread was soaking it up.

the size was good, so portion wise was excellent. I'll add this to my list to try the other sandwiches here. i just need to try the other menus at this location first.

author: Andre Krause
review_text: Ordered lunch from 3 “kitchens” vendors. Wasn’t really a place to sit and eat. It’s really for pick-up only, but food options were solid and varied. My group of 3, got a Banh Mi sandwich, a BLT with waffle fries, and a “chicken and waffles” plate, from three separate vendors. We ordered ahead via online and grabbed food as soon as we arrived. Very quick.

author: Victor Hugo O.D.
review_text: Walking by caught this beauty of a place and wondered in, ordering is simple and fast.  Tons of great food options and each was delicious.  No dine it but you can carry out or order ahead and drive thru pickup.

author: Zak Poole
review_text:
Friendly staff and convenient drive thru.

Excellent variety of tastes and flavors from different kitchens, all worth a try!

author: Ana Sassin
review_text: Still blown away by the idea of 17 restaurants in 1 drive thru open til 1am.  The college students always get the good eateries LOL it is in a bit of a weird place that almost seems like GPS is leading you into a nightmare if you're going late at night. But then all of a sudden, you'll see the skinny, well-lit opening between two warehouses that is the Grand Food Depot. Tried Sundays Korean Fried chicken wings.  Very tasty however the wings aren't large.  And they give a ton of waffle fries. Almost too many.  Definitely going back to try some of the other spots.

author: Ranae Michell3
review_text: Had Hanks honey chicken sandwich was pretty good convenient and great idea

author: Bijan Ardalan
review_text: The restaurants they have here are great. They only have pickup to go since these are basically ghost kitchens. Check out their website to see all the restaurants and put together an order. You'll get a text when your food is ready, usually within 15 minutes of your order being placed. I'm especially fond of Figeroa Philly cheesesteak. The sandwiches and onion rings are great!

author: Marai Jimenez
review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of eating at Healthy Organic Catering and indulged in their Grilled Chicken Pesto Sandwich and Turkey Club. The experience was nothing short of delightful.

The Grilled Chicken Pesto Sandwich was a burst of flavors with its fresh basil pesto, ripe tomatoes, and juice tender chicken, all nestled between perfectly toasted bread. Each bite was a harmonious blend of savory and herbaceous notes, leaving me craving more.

The Turkey Club was a classic favorite done right. The tender slices of turkey paired beautifully with crispy bacon, fresh lettuce, and juicy tomatoes, all held together by soft, toasted bread. The combination of textures and flavors made this sandwich a true standout.

Overall, my experience at Healthy Organic Catering was exceptional. The use of fresh, organic ingredients shone through in every bite, and the attention to detail in the preparation of each dish was evident. I highly recommend trying the Pesto Sandwich and Turkey Club for a satisfying and delicious meal.

author: Monique Sanges
