review_text: The Figueroa Philly cheesecake was legit. So juicy anx i LOVED the mushrooms. sides are big so we definitely didn't need two sides for two people. Pricey, but you do get pretty big portions. I been coming here since my kid was a toddler and he's 10 this year... my favorite Philly cheesecake place.

author: Skyla Nava (La)
review_text: I really love going to this little shop. It’s close to my work, it’s cheaper than expected, and the food is good! The service is great as well. They recognize me from my past orders and offer me free drinks and always thank me for ordering. The banh mi’s are pretty good and they have a lunch special for only $10! Would recommend! It’s also very quick within 10 minutes of me ordering it’s ready!

author: Randy
review_text: My favorite Tijuana style tacos out of all of LA!  Savory and smoked coal-grilled meat wrapped in fresh hand-made tortillas. The line can get long sometimes but these authentic tacos are worth the wait!

author: John Wood
review_text: Great food, fresh and hit. Handmade tortilla. A bit spicy but so worth it and great price. Loved this place!

author: Edi Anguiano
review_text:
Tire Shop Taqueria is a great place to enjoy flavorful food in a fun and relaxed setting. The restaurant has a cool, casual feel, and it really does feel like a neighborhood spot where people come to enjoy good food without any stress. From the moment you walk up, the smell of grilled meat lets you know you are in for something special.

One of the best items on the menu is the carne asada tacos. The meat is very tender and juicy, and it has a rich, smoky flavor that tastes amazing in every bite. The carne asada is cooked just right and pairs perfectly with the warm tortillas and fresh toppings. These tacos are simple but incredibly delicious.

The grilled al pastor tacos are also a must-try. They are well-seasoned and full of bold flavor without being too heavy. You can really taste the spices, and the grilled edges add a nice texture that makes them even better. Each taco feels carefully made and very satisfying.

The cheesy gringas cooked on the griddle are another highlight. They are crispy on the outside, warm and melty on the inside, and packed with flavor. The cheese stretches with every bite, making them comforting and hard to resist. They are perfect if you want something rich and filling.

The campechanas are very tasty and bring together different meats in one delicious dish. The flavors blend well, creating a hearty and satisfying option. Overall, Tire Shop Taqueria offers amazing food, friendly service, and a relaxed vibe that makes every visit enjoyable and memorable.

author: josh lee
review_text:
Tortillas are handmade after you order, the folks handling orders are kind and warm while being very efficient. Meats are well-seasoned; I like the chicken most, chorizo second. There's a decently sized seating area so you can enjoy the freshly made food immediately on-site.

Legitimately one of the best, though they're quite well known now and prices seem to have risen a bit.

author: Emily D
review_text:
Definitely returning for the tacos whenever I'm in the area. Got the chorizo, chicken, and carne asada. All were an absolute hit. They did need more of a punch like some lime juice or vinegar-based hot sauce to elevate the flavors, but wow the tortilla, which they make right in front of you fresh, and the meats are awesome. Highly recommend all three meats. Ordering was easy and fast. They take card and cash. For three tacos, I paid $8.50 out the door.

Covered seating right next to the prep area. Parking is street parking, so may be tricky to find, but I got a spot just around the corner in no time.

Coming back to try more of their menu items!

author: Favorite Things
review_text: Disappointed! I keep seeing videos of this place and it looks good so my hopes were high. Unfortunately they were dashed quite quickly after taking my first bite. Zero flavor! Very surprising since everything is made fresh right in front of you. I wanted to like this place, but I have to admit... this might be the worst road side taco stand I've been to.

author: Anu Rao
review_text: The tacos here are absolutely delicious, especially when paired with their flavorful guacamole and salsas. The prices are very affordable, and I love that they customize everything right in front of you, ensuring the ingredients are fresh. The place does get very crowded, but it's definitely worth trying. Since this shop is located in the Carniceria Market, you can explore other food options in the night market as well. Just a heads-up, this shop is only open in the evenings.

author: Nhi Le
review_text:
Hands down THE BEST CARNE ASADA I’ve had in LA! You must get these, the freshly made tortillas really make all the difference! Still drooling thinking about that smoky meat and soft, fresh, chewy corn tortillas.

Cabeza was really good too, chorizo was ok. But carne asada is a must!

We preferred the soft tortillas (tacos, mulitas) over the crunchy ones (vampiros - they were a bit hard and messy to eat. Horchata was a bit too sweet for my liking.

$9 for mulitas, $2.5 for taco, and $4 for vampiros if I remember correctly.

There were some chairs and tables for sit down. We had to find street parking in the nearby blocks though. Ordering can be confusing if you don’t know what the Mexican dish names mean.

author: Chris K
review_text: They've fallen off in the past few years. Vibe and visual still great, but the meat lacked flavor. Needs salt, marinade, or a pre-roll. Very 1 dimensional. Must be retirement phase

author: Isaac Romero
review_text: Funding a good taco stand here in LA, it's not an easy task, came here by a referral, and finding parking is not that easy. They make the tortillas by hand on the spot. I tried several of their meats and I only liked their Cabeza and Chorizo. The Asada was ok. Al Pastor was not well seasoned and tasted more like Carnitas. Their fountain drinks taste fresh.

author: 龔振勝
review_text:
Let me say: I LOVE the fact that they make the shells fresh on-the-spot (got that extra corn flavor) and it's pressed right in front of you. Plus you can see them grill everything right there. Pretty self-explanatory: You start at the end of the line where the menu is. You let the lady making the shells know what you want, and she'll start the shells for those items, then you confirm with the next guy cutting up the stuff what kind of meat, so he'll cut it up and throw them on the shells once they're grilled correctly. Any more from the grill is the next guy over, but if you're good, you can skip straight to paying where you can get a drink.
Horchata tasted good too!

One thing to note: When the guy asked "Que carne?" (What meat?) My cousin said something in the most gringo accent there was. Homeboy's face got contorted as he tried to guess what she meant. Yo, give her a break, she's from Chicago, she's about as white as they come, but she tried. 🤣

author: Cindy G
review_text: These are authentic street tacos and some of the best in LA! Any meat you choose will be so delicious and the guacamole sauce they pour adds so much flavor! My family and I travel far just to eat these tacos every year!

author: Jeremiah
review_text: The Food is good the drinks are too but the atmosphere is really dirty it demoled like pee and like a dead animal. The service is bad i tried asking what i wanted but be acuse it was my first time i didn’t knee who to ask and then the one that i accedentslly ask was acting dumb on me and so then yea i would rate it 3/5

author: Ocean Medell
review_text: We come here at least once a week . You need to try these tacos . Salsa is spicy . Watch out . Tortas and mulitas are delicious.

author: Dior Ella
review_text:
Located in a paid parking lot. I was skeptically but it smelled phenomenal so I tried since people were raving how spicy it is.

Welcome to the taqueria where the tacos are as authentic as the street they're named after. The atmosphere? About as casual as a siesta under a palm tree.

Now, let's taco 'bout the food. These tortillas are so fresh, they practically introduce themselves. The carne asada? Tender enough to make a vegetarian reconsider. And don't even get me started on the salsa—spicy enough to make your taste buds do the cha-cha.

Service? It's like they've mastered the art of efficiency with a side of más salsa, señor?You'll have your tacos faster than you can say guac!

So, if you're craving a taste of Mexico without the airfare, this taqueria is your ticket to flavor town. Just bring your appetite and leave your expectations on the side street. It’s street food after all not a five-star fiesta.

author: MIlton Ramos
review_text: I have mixed feelings about this place. I saw a YouTube and TikTok video where it was pretty hyped as a great place to eat, with a good atmosphere and great location. Visiting today the tacos are all OK, but I would not drive the 33 miles again to this location. The carne asada was excellent Tortillas are handmade. The salsas are spicy, but I think that there’s a lack of selection in meats. They have Al- pastor, Asada, chicken, and chorizo.  They are missing lengua and tripas.   They have vampiros, which was a hard tough tortilla, so not getting this again, and the guacamole is not real.  Place was relatively small with limited seating spaces.  Overall not quite what I expected.

author: Br3
review_text: I was in the area and just had to stop by. It had  been too long. I ordered 6 tacos and a large drink and paid $20 flat. They take cash and card.  Hand-made tortillas (always a good sign) and freshly cooked meat and spicy salsa plus agua frescas. They have a few tables set up to eat your food. If you're looking for good tacos, give them a try. FYI, parking is tricky. Sometimes, you have to drive around to find somewhere to park.

author: Roxana A
review_text:
We started this adventure not knowing what we were going to encounter… we arrived a little after 5:30pm on a Friday but  because it’s the middle of December it’s like midnight outside, so looking for parking was a nightmare here. Be ready to park a bit far and walk through puddles of piss or you might get lucky and find one close enough 😏 Avalon Blvd is busy that hour too!

On to the food. I ordered something called a Vampiro, which was essentially protein sandwiched between two really toasted tortillas. Which wasn’t too bad I had the carne asada, the meat was really well seasoned and tender.

Ordered a carne asada quesadilla, this was much better, love that they are making the tortillas right there in your face, super delicious this way!

Also ordered an al pastor burrito, it was huge and lots of meat that was also very good and tasty. Kinda wish they added pineapple to this!!

The mulita was also good and got two large agua frescas, which always hits the spot.

Service was okay, a little intimidating (to me) when ordering because they do have different stations and people just standing around and I was trying figure that out but got going. Lol

Prices were okay, we paid about $60 for all this and they take cash only.

They have a lot of seating available as around the time we got there people are really prob getting off work and picking up to go’s. Music plays and pretty nice little spot to eat and enjoy good food. 💫

author: David Levy
review_text: Best tacos in Los Angeles. Granted there are a lot to choose from but these are the best. Wonderful people great service. Totally authentic.

author: Ortiz Ortiz
review_text: Food is ok but service is bad. They talk to you as if they're doing you a favor for serving you. Very rude.

author: Jennifer De La Torre
review_text:
First time coming here because King Taco was closed, but glad we gave it a try. I will say that if given the choice I would always pick King Taco but this was a nice alternative.

We ordered; torta cubana, tacos, militas and champurrado.

Meat was tasty but I was not a fan of the cheese they used. It was not stringy and I honestly don’t know what cheese they used but I was not a fan. Both salsa were spicy so if you are into really spicy salsas, then this is a good place.

Champurrado was good too! I would come again if King Taco was closed again.

author: Sandy Swenson
review_text: This place is the freakin bomb.com. Great food, great prices, amazing condiment bar. Like I’m not even gonna tell you what you’ll find at the condiment bar because you’ll just have to go and find out for yourself. Definitely an LA favorite!!

author: Robert Rael
review_text:
Food was good and came out quick. There was no cilantro/onions on the burrito. They offer little packets, but who wants to open up the burrito again to put it on?

Restrooms could use some work but otherwise nice place.

author: Elizabeth Wong
review_text: Passing by on street nearing downtown L.A. two locations, big inviting building with a comical chicken logo, a local chain??? The place looked clean fresh maybe  newish amidst a not-so- clean or fresh or inviting urban neighborhood. I just felt like a little adventure, so I pulled in and found the parking lot full but one happy space for me. I went in to use the restroom, but the menu and wide open cheerful red-accented modern plexiglass screamed buen comida, eat something. And all the Hispanic clientele cannot be wrong. I got a super burrito. 5/5...carnitas 4/5 (saltiness is subjective, but i thought the carnitas too salty, my mom who shared this huge bad boy with me thought it was perfecto). She took a bit and said, " mmmmmm, is good!!) You get your choice of protein for anything you order -- they have sopes!! And the quesadillas look huge and impressive as other people were dining in and I snuck a peek at their dine-in trays...omg the soft street tacos looks good....gosh I wanted to try it all....they also had mulitas, tortas, and even a Cuban sandwich. I dont even know what a mulita is, but i wanted to try it. About my burrito, I wondered if I wanted to add a scoop of al pastor if I could have done it....I should have asked. Also the burrito was well built and held its shape great. I got it home and at it an hour later, still warm! Not soggy!@ Everyone there was friendly from the owner manning the order desk to the guys assembling your food...to the lady bagging takeout orders. She read my mind as I stood waiting nearby for my takeout, bec without me having to ask, she gave me a plastic bag for the handful of condiments. She's a mind reader!! Great service. Also great attention to hygiene as the salsa bar has everything prepackaged and ready to go. Also there was a traditional salsa bar.  Very clean and sanitary. While I was there a guy came to wipe the counter with a clean towel even though it wasn't sloppy or dirty, very impressive. There's so Taco Gavilan where I live, the owner told me they are a chain of 15, maybe the closest is one in Huntington Park. I hope they establish in the SGV someday soon. Because my mom loved her burrito. Thanks for the fun foodie adventure while passing thru an unfamiliar part of town, I wish I had my cell phone with me so I could take pics of your well designed open large friendy colorful dining room. Next time!!

author: TAO D
review_text:
Driving through the bustling downtown LA area under the scorching sun, a craving for some fiery Mexican cuisine suddenly struck me. We stumbled upon a low-key local chain eatery that specializes in quick-serve Mexican cooking, offering everything from mouthwatering tacos to scrumptious mulitas, along with a salsa bar. I must say, this hidden gem exceeded my expectations.

From the moment we entered, the register welcomed us warmly and displayed incredible patience as they guided us through the menu. As someone who isn't well-versed in Mexican cuisine, their thorough explanations and recommendations were greatly appreciated. Their willingness to ensure that every customer feels comfortable and informed added an extra touch of hospitality to our visit.

The restaurant itself was immaculate, with a steady flow of customers and a glimpse of the kitchen where fresh food was being prepared behind the counter. We opted for the taco combo, which allowed us to savor three tantalizing tacos with different meat fillings alongside a serving of steamed rice and flavorful bean paste (with a splash of cheese on top). The presentation of the food was exceptional and convenient. I particularly enjoyed the individually packed condiments and the generous serving of onions and cilantro, allowing us to customize each bite to our liking on the go.

Another aspect that truly stood out was the reasonable price of the meal. For this combo (please see the attached pictures), it cost us less than $10 in total.

Overall, our experience here was short (less than 15 mins) but nothing short of delightful. The combination of friendly and patient staff, spotless surroundings, and delectable food made for an exceptional dining experience. Whether you're craving a quick bite or a full Mexican feast, this low-key local chain eatery is definitely worth a visit.

author: Giovani V
review_text: Food and service good enough. I’m giving five stars because the time when I was there a man came in with different capabilities and they serve him as they should fhe other time a lady not in her  best, she were dirty and maybe drunk  but they still treat and serve here as they supposed to.  Maybe if she were bothering the customers maybe they will do something .

author: R E “Florecita Rockera” Villalta
review_text: It has been 10 years and still the same or better. A little renovated with packing salsas still a place to go.

author: Joshua Gonzalez
review_text:
Good food for the price, we tried the nachos andvtorta de milanesa with a horchata.
The torta was actually really good, no complaints. Besides, I wish the milanesa had more breading, but besides that, it's all good!
For the nachos, the chips seemed to be a but stale and not fresh cooked, but I could understand because of the cheap prices.
The horchata was good, nothing bad or great about it.
The service was exceptional and quick. The restaurant was clean, and the tvs were on with futbol that I loved!
If you are looking for a cheap and quick meal, this is the spot.

author: Dukwan Adderley
review_text: I received this location to try. I will be honest the food wasn't as hyped as I was told however it wasn't bad. There tacos where okay but not something I am looking to run back to at the first chance. The area it is located is mas o meno (alright / so-so) again not a place if make a priority to get back to anytime soon. The service was good however. Very friendly and helpful staff members. The order and time to pick up was quick and efficient. 10 out of 10 for their staff members.

author: Rachel Avila
review_text: Kind of scary because we went to use the restroom and one of the workers were in there using the restroom and they walked out without washing their hands so we never end up getting anything except for I got a flawn that wasn't that great I've had better and that was pre-wrapped already that's the only reason why I bought it just because we went to use the restroom but other than that we would never go back

author: Valencia
review_text: This is my Favorite food spot when I'm in LA..the food is fresh and the beans are hot and seasoned well  and garnishments are fresh and a added bonus(free) I ate chicken burritos both days (  Thanksgiving eve & Thanksgiving instead of turkey) this is how Goood & fresh the food is

author: Ryan LaFebre
review_text:
It breaks my heart to have to change my rating from 5 to 3. I've been coming here since 2016 but unfortunately they've changed for the worse.
The tacos are just different and not as good. This change started at some point during Covid and I was hoping it was temporary. It's not. Tacos are maybe more oily and a different type of corn tortilla? And they got rid of the amazing roasted jalapeños that used to go so well with the original tacos.  I really wish they'd raise prices instead of making the food less tasty and offering only the cold, canned, pickled jalapenos that aren't worth eating.
I miss the amazing, original Tacos El Gavilon 😔

author: Fredis Maravilla Saravia
review_text: Great customer services and the food always excellent.  I love the beans 🫘

author: Pedro Rico Jr
review_text:
Great service and tacos. I love lengua tacos and theirs remind me of home.

100% recommend trying this place at least once.

author: Dana “Pineapple Drop” Miles
review_text: Good service, food tasted good, I purchased their chicken burrito for $10+. The only problem to me is that their burritos can be bigger for that price, it tasted good

author: Rocio A. Cruz (Rosy)
review_text:
First time here and I like it, I hesitate a little bit about eating here because I knew it would be just tacos, Tortas, burritos, etc., and it was really early in the morning to have tacos. While I was looking at the menu and , I asked the cashier Maria, and she was kind enough to tell me everything they have for their breakfast menu. I ordered a chorizo and egg burrito 🌯 and it was huge and yummy 🤤 I added the red tomatillo sauce and it tasted just like homemade! I will definitely return. Just a suggestion for the owner or manager about posting that your place carries delicious breakfast and hot coffee ☕

BTW... plenty of parking 🅿️

author: Sandra Figueroa
review_text: The staff here was very friendly. The food was subpar. It wasn't bad by any means, but if you want some really good tacos, then definitely look elsewhere. their aguas frescas very refreshing

author: isaac nagode
review_text:
If you're craving late-night tacos in South LA, Tacos Gavilan on Broadway is a solid go-to. It's open crazy late (like 2 AM on weekdays, 4 AM on weekends), so it's perfect for post-party munchies or just a spontaneous taco run.

The carne asada and al pastor tacos are my personal faves—super flavorful, with just the right amount of grease to hit the spot. The salsa bar is a nice touch too (if it’s open), with all the fixings to dress up your tacos just how you like. And the portions? Generous. You won’t leave hungry.

The vibe inside is pretty chill—clean, fast service, and usually sports on the TVs. It’s not fancy, but that’s kind of the point. Prices are reasonable too, especially for LA.

Only heads-up: double-check your order if you're doing takeout or delivery. A few folks (myself included once) have gotten a wrong item or two.

Overall? Tacos Gavilan hits the spot when you want something fast, filling, and legit tasty. Definitely worth a stop if you’re in the area.

author: Zulma Aguiar
review_text: Tacos Gavilán is hands-down one of the best taco spots around! 🌮🔥 The food is always fresh, flavorful, and authentically delicious. Their tacos are packed with perfectly seasoned meat, fresh toppings, and warm tortillas that taste like they were made from scratch. The salsa bar is amazing, and the aguas frescas are the perfect refreshing touch. The service is quick, friendly, and efficient, even when they’re busy. Whether you’re dining in or grabbing food to go, Tacos Gavilán never disappoints. 100% recommend for a true taste of Mexico! 🇲🇽💯

author: TEAM BViR
review_text: I ordered a burrito with 2 horchatas using uber eats and got a small quesadilla with no drink. This is preposterous. And when I called no one answers the phone. I recommend others to just eat somewhere else. Totally unsatisfied with this experience.

author: Vanessa
review_text: My mother brought me for the first time and I was surprised of this place. I order the soup and fried bananas. So good and love my chicken plate with soupy. Will come again for something different. Enjoy! 😉

author: Carlos Daniel Lopez
review_text:
Food was delish! Very friendly staff kept on checking on our party of 9 people.
The food portions are nicely served. We were all pleasantly surprised and will be back for more whenever we come back to L.A.
Thank you!

author: CR
review_text: The hospitality of this restaurant is amazing. Very welcoming, comfort with a nice gate around for security. The outside patio is amazing, the theme itself is very relaxing it really helps with the ambiance. Food is really close to a traditional home style meal. 👌🏼

author: Roberto Hernandez
review_text: The plate that I order was "mar y tierra" I was completely satisfied with the amount of food. the plates include : chicken, stake, beans, rice, salad, asparagus and shrimp with vegetables on top a souce. The food was well cooked also   the quality of service was excellent. I recommend this plate

author: Delmy Rivera
review_text: Better than I expected. The food was really good, the waitress was attentive all the time. I’ll definitely come back soon.

author: j AM
review_text: Super delicious!! Beautiful clean restaurant friendly service

author: Misha
review_text: Ok it's mostly my mistake. Who orders steak in Salvadory restaurant.. But anyway, waiter asked if I want it medium or well.. I said medium. And got the piece of overcooked plastic.. Asked to redo it.. For medium. Or if they can't, bring chicken.. And you can see on the picture what i got second time.. Piece of raw meat.

author: Iveth Campos
review_text: Love that a Salvadoran restaurant opened up in the neighborhood. Great food and drinks. Indoor seating area is pleasant as well.

author: Josie_LA
review_text: Nice ownership, have only tried the Salvadoran breakfast and it is delicious.

author: Jose Sanchez
review_text:
Just got a quick lunch 2 tamales
There chicken  tamales are moist & delicious & a good size

author: Denise Muñoz
review_text: Delicious food! Every plate is well served and the worker is always making sure everything ok and is refilling your cup of coffee

author: Cesar Henriquez
review_text: Real Central American Food prices is good for what you getting 👌

author: Roger
review_text: They are currently remodeling but overall everything about the shop was excellent. Great service, delicious food (especially the pupusas), and wonderful atmosphere.

author: Child ofgod
review_text: Amazing service and food would recommend to anyone who wants to eat good food

author: D Hernz
review_text: Service could be better.   Short staffed.  Place was busy.   Food was very good.  Priced just right,  good portions.   One of the better Salvadoran restaurants I've tried.   Will visit again.

author: Joseline Lopez
review_text: The times I have gone to the restaurant always have seats available even for a large party with no long wait times. Definitely recommend the Churrasco Santa rosa it offers a variety of food for a very affordable price service is always great.

author: Raul Cienfuegos
review_text:
Santa Rosa Restaurant is a hidden gem for anyone craving authentic and flavorful Salvadoran cuisine. From the moment you step inside, the welcoming atmosphere and friendly service make you feel right at home.

The pupusas are the star of the menu—perfectly crispy on the outside and stuffed generously with delicious fillings like cheese, pork, and beans. The curtido and salsa served alongside are fresh and tangy, complementing the pupusas beautifully. I also tried the carne asada plate, which was tender, well-seasoned, and served with a variety of tasty sides.

Their menu offers a great selection of traditional Salvadoran dishes, and everything I tasted felt like it was made with love and care. The portions are hearty, and the prices are very reasonable for the quality and authenticity.

If you're in the area and want to explore a different culinary experience, I highly recommend Santa Rosa Salvadorean Restaurant. It’s a spot you’ll want to return to again and again.

author: Josh Rangel
review_text: The place looks very welcoming, and if it's your first time trying Salvadoran food, it's very similar to what my godmother would cook. I had 4 Pupusas, and they were top-notch always ask for more curtido, you could thank me later but there is VERY LIMITED parking otherwise is a beautiful and delicious Salvadoran Restaurant high quality food and FRESH FRUIT WATER (Agua Fresca)

author: Johanna Martinez
review_text: Great food and service but sometimes the wait time goes longer than usual and they don't provide complimentary chips to snack on while you're waiting.

author: V P
review_text: Good food,  but can be difficult ordering if you don't speak Spanish.. that's all the workers speak.

author: Nikola Zemani
review_text:
Got 3 types of tacos and also the pastor fries. The portions are big, reasonably prices, and the service is very friendly. You get to add your own topings. Service was super fast.

I am not gonna lie, the location itself was kind of dirty and you had dirty pigeons coming near your food, so I would personally suggest you get your food to-go and eat somewhere else.

Highly reccomend! Amazing staff. Good food. Will come again!

author: Isaac Paiz (AVENTURASCONLOSPAIZ)
review_text:
This is a Taco Truck, great for a quick bite, they serve freshly made tacos, Burritos, tortas, etc.

We ordered Tacos al Pastor, burritos al pastor a Steak Gringa and Champurrado and everything we ordered was so tasty.

Prices are just right and the staff was very friendly.

Definitely recommended if you happen to be in the area.

AVENTURASCONLOSPAIZ

author: Mario Ruano
review_text:
Food taste good. Plenty of parking…
Not crazy good but just like any other Mexican taco stand.
This spot is 2 minutes sways from a big chain Mexican restaurant, I’d rather go there so I could have a place to sit and not be out on the cold .

author: A. A.
review_text: Not authentic tacos. Al pastor was very dry. The burrito 🌯 has dried beans 🫘 and just asada. Not very tasty At all. The best thing was probably the mulita. Yet again, you end up putting hot sauce, spices and limon to give it a descent taste. Not authentic Mexican tacos. #facts

author: Z H
review_text:
Worst burritos I've ever had. No taste, salsas are waterdowned, very bad quality, no reason for them to be so expensive 👎👎👎👎
Many better taco trucks than this

author: Mr. Ducky
review_text: The tacos we okay not the best 3$ seems a bit steep for mediocre tacos agua frescas where good salsa not so much.

author: Sina Nazemi
review_text: The lime was not fresh and good. I wish they would have made the shell there.

author: Jose Garcia
review_text: Best taco truck out there. Stay open real late for people coming out of concerts and what not. Hand made tortillas also for anyone who likes that.

author: Erica Bravo
review_text: We love these tacos they are so yummy, homemade tortillas make them the best. They are not greasy and thats the best for us!!

author: John Gerhardt
review_text: Exactly what I want from a taco truck. Good food, good service, good prices.

author: Eli Almonte
review_text: Didn’t want a drink before making my payment  they said they don’t accept returns like I didn’t pay for it I don’t want it I ended up paying for it… Worst experience traveling from the east side to try their food never again…

author: Lily Gonzalez
review_text:
You can't go wrong with tacos in South Central 🤌
Both green and red salsas have delicious flavors and a tolerable spice ✨
Asada and tripas tacos.

author: Rob Thompson

author: Sam

review_text:
As far as I'm concerned, the positive reviews I read before I tried Lucky's, were right on the money💰. Everything looked fresh and delicious the first time I visited. I had just found my favorite Chinese food in South Los Angeles! That's why they get the 5 stars.

The spring rolls are always fresh, crispy,  and very tasty.  .50 cents extra for sweet & sour sauce. The combination plates are delicious. Served with generous portions. You won't be disappointed ordering at Lucky's.

Every time I go back I try new things and I am never disappointed.

author: Reynaldo Garcia
review_text: 10/02 I bought 3 combos and 3 large Thai tea boba. The drinks were missing sweetener. I don’t live close to the location. I called in and told them the situation. I was told to come back whenever I get a chance and they will replace them. I went back today and was told I was only to receive one med drink. I paid for 3 large boba, I was going back and forth with the cashier and asked to speak to the manager. I was refused any communication with him. At the end I said “keep the drink I don’t even want it no more.” I wasted over $15 on 3 large drinks. I’m disappointed with the Customer Service I received. I used to like this place, time for a new location.

author: Victor G
review_text:
I’ve been coming to Lucky’s Chinese Food for a while now, and it never disappoints. The portions are super generous for the price, and the food always hits the spot hot, fresh, and flavorful. The chow mein and fried rice is fire too, always cooked just right and not overly greasy like some other spots.

What really sets this place apart, though, is the service. The staff is always friendly, fast, and welcoming. Even when they’re busy, they move quickly and stay polite. You can tell they care about keeping customers happy.

author: Maria Ruvalcaba
review_text: This is the go-to spot for amazing Chinese food! Their chow mein is absolutely my favorite—it has a unique flavor that sets it apart from other places I've tried. The food here is consistently excellent, and the staff are incredibly friendly, always providing fast, outstanding service. Highly recommend

author: Oopszahdaisy Crayola
review_text:
Retraction:

I have never done this before. I am retracted my statement for now. I decided to come back for some soup. And the next visit, I came back for a 2 combo plate. I must say I was very impressed. My food did not spoil. The food was fresh. It was nice. I've only been back twice, but if my third visit is a winner then I will delete the bottom of my post. I don't know what happened, but I thank you for the drastic change. I appreciate this. I never go back and retract my statements. I may edit them or just delete them. But I feel this restaurant did a total change, and they need to know the customers are looking and watching and tasting. And I thank you for listening.
It takes three chances to win my vote. We will see what happens next.
December 22nd 2024

First of all I "used to love coming here". I can deal with a lot of things.
But what I CAN NOT deal with is how my food SPOILS within a few hours. On MULTIPLE occasions, I would come in for a plate after my shift at 4:30. By 8, I could not eat my food because of the sour smell. My food had STUNK up my whole house. I mean it smelled like kimchi, dead rats, and skunks. If it will spoil within three hours, imagine what it will do in your stomach. I am SO Sick of Chinese food places in South LA serving us reheated food that sours within hours. If you do get something, get white rice. The spices is KILLING the food under the heat. I know I'm not the only person experiencing this. This happens EVERY single time. It's HORRIBLE. We deserve FRESH food. I decided to give this place a few chances because I really liked it, but hell no, not again. Don't say I didn't warn you. If you knew better you would do better by us. I will NOT be coming here EVER again. Food poisoning isn't CUTE or healthy. I have permanently giving up Chinese food because of it, unless it's 🐼. I would love to see the owner eat his own food after leaving it sitting for 4 hours. I guarantee if he did, he would have the same reaction as I did 🎯

author: Brenda Luna
review_text:
To Whom It May Concern,

I am writing to formally report a highly unprofessional and unacceptable experience I had at your McDonald’s location. I expect this complaint to be taken seriously and addressed by management and, if necessary, escalated to corporate oversight.

On [06/09/2025], I visited your drive-thru. I was behind another vehicle and waited several minutes at the ordering speaker without any communication or greeting. After three full minutes of silence, I asked aloud if the location was open. I received no response. I proceeded forward to the second window, where there was also no employee present. When I reached the third window, I was shouted at by an employee who claimed someone was at the ordering speaker. They proceeded to refuse to serve me, even though I was attempting to purchase a simple coffee.

When I asked to speak to a manager, the situation escalated rather than improved. The manager on duty was dismissive, confrontational, and completely unwilling to acknowledge the breakdown in communication or take basic accountability. Instead of resolving the issue, the manager instigated further hostility and excused the behavior of the staff.

To make matters worse, a drive-thru employee named Miguel—who I’ve had issues with before—mocked me and laughed at me during this visit. This is not the first time he has behaved unprofessionally. In a previous incident, Miguel served me scalding hot coffee without a lid, which resulted in me getting burned. I reported that incident, and I believe he now targets me because of that prior complaint.

I am deeply concerned that your staff:
• Refused service without cause.
• Failed to communicate properly at the ordering station.
• Reacted with aggression when questioned.
• Allowed personal bias and retaliation from a previous incident to impact current service.
• Showed a lack of basic professionalism and critical thinking required for customer service.

This is unacceptable for any business, let alone one operating under the McDonald’s brand. I request:
1. A formal apology.
2. A review of staff training, especially regarding customer interaction and drive-thru procedures.
3. Reassignment or disciplinary action for employees who engage in retaliatory behavior.
4. Clarification on how complaints like mine are being tracked and followed up on.

I am a paying customer, and I expect to be treated with respect and dignity. I hope your company will take the necessary steps to correct these issues.

author: Joshua Gonzalez
review_text:
I hope McDonalds corporate sees this, but I doubt it. I came in with my fiancé for a quick bite and started doing the usual pictures for my review without intrusion on customers or employees and went out to take a street shot of the building. Again, they were very aggressive, but I simply told them I do google reviews and was taking a couple of shots. One issue to be resolved is the merchant surcharge to use debit cards which is illegal in California. Surcharges are to be applied when using credit cards, not debit. I'll be looking to see that this issue is resolved in this community. I rarely see this happening in other communities and that's probably because it's reported and not overlooked in those areas.

The driver-thru is totally backward as it's located on the passenger side only, so if you go alone, be prepared to reach over.

review_text:

The service crawls when they have customers. The "famous pastrami" is grilled. Tough, chewy, and grisly. I don't recommend it.

author: Markesha Smith
review_text:
My aunt had a truly distressing experience at Domino’s that I feel compelled to share. During her visit, she unexpectedly felt faint and ended up passing out. It was a scary situation, and she had to call 911 for assistance. In that moment, she asked for a simple cup of water to help her recover while waiting for help.

Shockingly, the employee on duty refused to give her water unless she paid $2. Given her state—disoriented, shaken, and unable to think clearly—she wasn’t in a position to pay. It was deeply upsetting that, even in an emergency, a basic act of kindness like providing water wasn’t extended.

While I understand that businesses have policies, this was a clear situation where human decency should have prevailed. My aunt was left feeling disappointed and hurt, not just because of her health scare, but because of the lack of compassion she experienced.

I hope Domino’s management takes this feedback seriously and trains their staff to handle emergencies with more empathy.

---

When I ordered a "Jamaica" with lots of ice ,  i received  more like a really sweet iced tea, no ice.

However, the corrected drink ended up tasting a bit artificial and, wow, it was super sweet – like, *really* sweet! I ended up just sticking with plain water after that, which was a bit of a bummer.

Also, a little heads-up about the avocado that came with my meal – it looked like it had seen better days, if you know what I mean. Just a thought for quality control! And the sushi was whatever.

I will also suggest being extra careful with packing the food,that would make a customer happy, because I had to get up three times and ask for napkins, forks, chops sticks, sriracha, etc.... It kind of broke up the flow of the meal , I was-annoyed by then.

All in all, these little hiccups just added up, and honestly, it made my first visit less enjoyable than I'd hoped. As a result, I'm not really feeling like coming back . I'm just sharing this because I genuinely believe in giving constructive feedback, and I hope it helps you guys make things even better for future guests!

author: Roberto G
review_text:
August 10, 2025 – My First and Last Visit

I finally went to this sushi place my fiancé had been bragging about. I was excited… until I experienced the service.

This is my personal opinion based on my personal experience. The food is good — but when customer service is this bad, the quality doesn’t matter.

My order number was 141, and I waited 55 minutes before my food came out. Yes, they were busy, but here’s the problem: there should be a system in place — at least one dedicated cook or staff member for dine-in customers so they’re not stuck waiting while take-out orders flood the kitchen.

By the time my food arrived, my hunger and patience were gone. For me, this was the first and last time I’ll be here.

Advice for anyone thinking of visiting:
Call ahead, place your order by phone, and give yourself at least an hour before you expect to eat.

Owner/manager, if you read this — take it as constructive criticism. Good food might get people in the door, but bad service will keep them from coming back.

review_text: Such a spacious and fun atmosphere! The waitresses were super friendly. The robots are pretty cool too. The meats were fresh and came out immediately after ordering them. I recommend the green apple soju.. it tastes like juice! I had such a fun and delicious time dining with my husband

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: saul mercado
review_text: Made a reservation for New years day party of 10. There was some miscommunication on their end not seeing my reservation the day of. Dispute that tey honored my word and the reservation I had made, and got me through even though it was super busy and a long wait. Seating area is large. We were seated at a large table in a somewhat secluded area which was perfect for our party. We all got the combo B. Meats where good. Large selection of sides, even got tortillas which I thought was cool. Service was excellent never had to wait long periods for food or drinks. I would definitely be coming back!

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Jonathan Wildman
review_text: Perfect all you can eat K bbq! Lots of sides, lots of meat options, three levels of meals, good quality on all, the service is quick and attentive and they have cool service robots that even sing happy birthday and say the person's name. Place gets busy as expected but it is large and good for big family groups. Will definitely be back again.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Yessi Gomez
review_text: First time here and I can honestly say I had a great experience. The food was good quality and overall, the atmosphere is amazing!! 10 out of 10

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: John Ramirez
review_text:
Beware if you are a family of four.
18% gratuity added on the bill.
Been a customer for a while now just recently brought my kids and god damn $140 is crazy. Server came once to ask for drinks and second to ask if we wanted meats as they were closing.
Food is good, but service is subpar.
Adding gratuity on 2 adults and 2 kids when’s it’s not busy is going to turn away a lot of people. Especially families. For two people this place rocks!

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Nicole N
review_text:
SO HAPPY I FOUND THIS PLACE🙌 9/10 The quality of the food is so good and fresh. Someone recommended the radish paper in an older review, it has been a life changer imo! Overall the service is great, but I like that there's a button to call the waiter over. This place dosent get packed like most kbbq's, which is always a surprise to me because this place is just as good, if not BETTER than other kbbqs! I love getting Menu B, it has a good variety of dishes beyond regular meat options like fried rice, fried wontons, corn cheese, and i love the squid! Good for going solo or for a big group. A few things that dont make this place a 10/10 is there is a robot that brings most of the dishes, usually the waiter helps and unloads the dishes but not at all the time so its awkward having to standup from the table to get the dishes and you only have about a minute before the robot leaves so you have to be fast😅 Its also awkward when the robot stops in a spot where youre unsure if its meant for you or the table next to you... certain tables are too close to each other. Also the paying situation, I never know if Im suppose to ask the waiter for the bill or get up and pay at the exit. I always get up and pay on my way out but then they ask for my table number and i have no idea. Maybe this is a me problem? IDK, but this is the only restaurant that gives me this confusion.
Confusion or not, I will be back😊

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Roger Alarcon
review_text: Great service by both the human and the robot lol.. food was great as well.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Emelyn Ortiz
review_text: Great music!! Macaroons are no longer sold temporarily because the warehouse burnt down 9/29/25. They have robots that take the food trays to your table for quicker service.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Stephanie Eudave
review_text: One of my fav Korean BBQ spots! There are little to no wait times & the food quality is amazing 😻

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: JMA Amaya
review_text: Real good service. The meats and sides are delicious. My group of 6 enjoyed menu A. Personally, enjoyed the beers on tap, they're better on tap. Lots of variety of Soju. Their radish paper is really good, preferred it over their rice paper. Good for a dinner on a Monday night.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Lutthanee Sattharatanatri
review_text:
Authentic Korean food with an all-you-can-eat buffet option. There are Set A, B, and C available.

Desserts not included.

Free parking is available in front of the restaurant.

They use robots for serving and iPads for ordering.

The food comes out quickly, and the staff provides excellent service.

A must-try!

😍😍😍

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: H FG
review_text:
Excellent food and great customer service!!!
Been coming here for years, I love their egg soup

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Sam
review_text: First and last last time coming here. Food was pretty good. Came in for lunch wasn't too busy. Asked for the check or how to best pay they went and got the bill brought it back out didn't say anything , so I left cash plus cash tip. Waited quite a few minutes finishing my food and drink no one came so go to leave say thank you to the staff as we're leaving and this random chic employee comes running out after us yelling did we pay for our food . Totally uncalled for and rude.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Pedro Najera
review_text: The Food Is Great!! A lot of Options!! Service Was 6 Out of 10, Just Cus The Server Never Came Bak To Our Table After The 2nd Time We Ordered, We Waited about 30 Mins And She Never Came Not Even For Refills But Again The Food is Delicious.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Drew
review_text: Good was great . However they do add a gratuity fee to your bill with out any notice and it's hard to get a waiter to come to your table when it's busy .

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: maddy acosta
review_text: Okay look Korean bbqs are my things. I've been to many bbqs and look the food is ight . The meets are great. The side dishes are alright like the rice and cucumbers. Everything was ight till I started to notice the hygiene of the restaurant.  The bathrooms are extremely dirty. It smells like black mold . The seats at the tabels are greasy and sticky. How can it be both I have no clue but for sure my pants where peeling off the seats. Walking to bathroom 8 months pregnant was almost a safety hazard from the slippery floors. I really think they should have some professional cleaning done. The robot service it's pretty cool till ur trying to get everything off and it says bye and your still trying to chase it to get your food. The mango lemonade was so watered down I had to ask for a coke after trying 2 cups. Over all it wasn't that bad just i think they need to invest in cleaning the restaurant

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Pam Leonido
review_text: Amazing staff, meat selection and amount of time you can stay for this all you can eat Korean BBQ! Everything is top quality and the staff are the most respectful and kind people we met and we had a party of 12!

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: araceli angel
review_text: rvice was great and attentive. Everything we ordered was brought to our table within minutes. The food was good and spicy pork belly was delicious! The music was good throughout our visit. Very good place to have a good meal, drinks, and have a chill time

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Alexa Gonzalez
review_text: This place is so good!! I love the food🌚 Honestly it is so worth the money! You get to eat as much as you want and the meat is really good quality!! The staff is really kind. They check up on you and overall real sweet. The atmosphere is calm and chill. Very lively with all the people enjoying their food. I brought my friends here and they liked it too

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Jerry Granillo
review_text: Mauro is an amazing server! My family and I have been coming here for some time, and Mauro is always so friendly and attentive to us. One of the best servers here! The price is good and the food is amazing! Great place to come relax and have a great family experience

author: Hungry J
review_text:
Surprisingly not hard to get a booking on a friday night.

Overall the experience was positive but for the price, the food overall fall a bit short of expectation.

Salad was good, meatballs can be better, calamari was decent but the sauce does not seem match.

The bread and dip was good too but the eggplant was hard to taste.

Cavatelli pasta was good but i think the balance was off due too much cheese. And the sausage was a bit too mushy.

The vodka pasta was solid, the the Squash Agnolotti was the best pasta I had in a while.

Steak is crowd favorite but the special duck dish is not there. The duck smelled a bit off but unfortunately it happens once in a while. Not much a restaurant can do.

Sides was good too. Service is nice an chill. Its worth a try for sure.

author: Lily Zhang
review_text: Horrible experience. Everything was bad, especially the service and the food. First, we asked for iced lattes and they gave us all hot lattes. When we pointed this out they dumped the hot lattes into another glass with 3 ice cubes; the lattes were still warm and now, watered down. Our waiter was SUPER un-attentive. It took us forever to order our main dishes. To give the restaurant credit, the food came out fast and looked tasty. However, looks can be deceiving...the food was horrible too. The ocean view was nice, but it was hard to even look at it because the pasta tasted like it had been dunked in the salty ocean water. Our cacio e pepe and ragu tasted so salty we thought the whole salt canister was dumped onto the dishes. Since the waiter was no where to be seen, we only had one measly cup of water that was finished and our whole table was extremely parched. The waiter didn't check up on us once and was sitting at the bar chatting with her co-workers. We had to waive the waiter over to ask about alternative options with the food, she was dismissive and spoke so quietly we could not hear her over the chatter in the restaurant. The best part of this experience was leaving the establishment.... unless you are handicapped then good luck leaving because the exit points down to three flights of stairs.

author: Shanru
review_text: Beautiful restaurant with great views of the ocean from the windows. We were able to be seated before sunset — highly recommend getting a reservation. The whipped eggplant was unique and delicious as well, and the service was friendly. It felt a bit crowded inside the restaurant, with the seats and tables crammed next to each other, and it was harder to talk as it was very loud inside. The food also took longer than expected to come out, but it was nice to sit and enjoy the views.

author: Mike Sperando
review_text:
Elephante was one of those restaurants that instantly stood out when searching for top Italian spots in the area. I can confidently say this experience was an absolute 10/10 from start to finish.

I started with the Caesar salad and ordered the vodka sauce pasta. The Caesar was incredibly flavorful and generously portioned, and the vodka sauce pasta had some of the best flavor I’ve had in a long time — easily the standout of the meal.

We sat outside by the window, which was perfect, but the indoor space is just as impressive. The interior has a bright, airy vibe that almost feels like something you’d find in Arizona (even though I’ve never been there), which made the atmosphere feel unique and memorable.

I would go back to Elephante again and again without hesitation. This was my first real meal and true taste of Los Angeles, and I couldn’t have picked a better place to start.

author: Cindy W
review_text:
Our meal was delicious, and the service overall was pleasant, but the hostess was not well trained and thus ruined the overall experience for us.

The cocktails were decent, but nothing out of the ordinary. Some must-get food items are “whipped eggplant”, “octopus salad” (even though I have been avoiding eating octopus given the Netflix show), and the various pasta dishes (gemelli and ragu).

Reservation is a must here. We were here to catch up with friends, so it didn’t bother us that we were seated in the garden section (no exterior view) of the restaurant rather than the lounge area that gets packed with patrons there for the sunset views.

The restaurant is in partnership with GreenPlaces to reduce carbon footprints by charging a 0.5% fee per check. It was a relatively small amount but goes a long way to make the guests feel good that we get to participate in something positive.

author: Thu-Nga Ortega, DDS, MAGD
review_text: This rooftop restaurant is pretty cute. It has a nice ambience and overlooks the beach from afar. We came here for brunch. The food is decent, dessert is pretty good. We got the steak and eggs and it was tasty. This scrambled egg with prosciutto and cheese bread was delicious. The pepper pasta ( cacio e pepe ) is also pretty tasty. The mango and pineapple sorbet was delicious. Tiramisu was also delicious. This restaurant is worth going to if you are in LA

author: Portia Freeman
review_text:
Positives: Service was fairly good, they were attentive, they let us switch our table to the lounge seats when we asked at a quiet time. The ambiance is very nice, and the view is to die for! It’s perfect to go at sunset so you can watch it over the ocean on this rooftop restaurant.

I got the Oaxacan old fashioned, it was strong and delicious.

Negatives: I heard so much about this whipped eggplant dip. It’s just a very small plate of velvety spread, and it mildly tastes of eggplant. It came with a huge plate of puffed up pita, which looked cool and was nice to rip into as a table. The spread and the pita as a whole just didn’t seem worth the hype? It wasn’t bad, but it was kind of nothing. My main gripe is that you realistically go through the entire spread before you get even halfway through the pita.

We also ordered the ragu, pesto, polenta and mushrooms, and a vodka pasta. All of it, ESPECIALLY the ragu, was unbelievably salty. I am not shy about salt, and unfortunately, I am known to oversalt when I cook at home because I know how much the right amount of salt can elevate a dish, but it was so salty, it made my mouth hurt slightly. It was a bummer that the over salting showed up in every single pasta dish. I also didn’t appreciate the undercooked egg white in the polenta. It was pretty gooey…

Lastly, this is more of a pet peeve of mine, but they took one of the plates of pasta away when approx a quarter of the dish was left. The server didn’t ask if we wanted it boxed. Usually, I’d say something or stop them before they whisked it away, but it was so mediocre and salty that I didn’t really care to not have it again.

Go for the ambiance and a nice cocktail, not the food. It may be disappointing, at least given how much hype this restaurant has received in LA.

author: Karen Schreiber
review_text: The restaurant is beautiful.  We were celebrating our nephews 18th birthday and sat on the private patio. The waiter was amazing. So warm, so attentive and so eager to know if we need a anything else. His helpers were also fantastic.  This was our first time. Great people watching, great ocean view and delicious food.

author: Melisha Mahakumara
review_text: We had an incredible experience at Elephante thanks to Angelo who offered the best service! He was attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable. He made us feel truly taken care of from start to finish. The food was just as amazing.. the corn truffle agnolotti and truffle pasta were absolutely fabulous, perfectly balanced, and full of rich flavor. Every bite was a delight!

author: Brittany Furlan
review_text: Literally such a fun spot. Feels like you’re in Tulum but it’s Santa Monica. If you can get there before sunset, you will have the best view of the sun setting above the ocean. Pure beauty. The food is delicious. The whipped eggplant appetizer is insane. Everything is so good actually you can’t go wrong. Make reservations.

author: Ray Eguavoen
review_text:
Elephante for lunch with a friend, and we did their $40
per person express lunch( one starter, one main, and one dessert). Even though it was overcast and the view wasn’t at its best, the food definitely delivered. The vodka pasta and branzino were the clear standouts. I also really enjoyed the calamari, though the balsamic aioli was a bit too bitter for my taste. I highly recommend asking for the lemon aioli instead. A must order is the whipped eggplant (not included in the express lunch). Overall, the express lunch is a great deal for the amount of food you get.

author: Tharindu Mahakumara
review_text: I went to Élephante for a birthday dinner and had one of the best nights! Our server, Angelo, was amazing! He so attentive and full of great recommendations. It was my first time dining there, and definitely not my last. The view was stunning, the food was delicious, and the whole experience was unforgettable. I highly recommend checking it out if you haven’t already!

author: Miguel Sanchez (Mich)
review_text:
Élephante in Santa Monica is an absolute gem! Perched on the rooftop with breathtaking ocean views, this Italian restaurant is the perfect spot to watch the sunset. As the sky transforms into hues of orange and pink, the atmosphere becomes truly magical.

Élephante's rooftop setting offers an unobstructed view of the Pacific Ocean, making it an ideal spot to witness the sunset.
From wood-fired pizzas to handmade pastas, the menu features a range of traditional Italian dishes crafted with fresh, locally sourced ingredients.
The staff at Élephante are knowledgeable and attentive, ensuring a seamless dining experience.
The combination of chic decor, lush greenery, and stunning views creates a lively yet intimate ambiance, perfect for special occasions or casual gatherings.

Reservations are highly recommended, especially if you want to secure a table with sunset views.
The restaurant's rooftop setting is particularly stunning during sunset, making it a perfect spot for romantic dinners or special occasions.

Overall, Élephante is a must-visit destination in Santa Monica, offering an unforgettable dining experience with its stunning sunset views, delicious Italian cuisine, and vibrant atmosphere

author: Reto K
review_text:
After all, apparently this is one of Santa Monicas best (italian) restaurants. As an almost Italian I have to say this place is not living up to its promises. In my opinion their only advantage are those tables at the front site facing the sea. Watching sunset from there is really nice.

As a walk-in, they just put you on a waiting list  that allows you to sit on the bar. Totally unclear whether at one point you will actually get a table.

Luckily we got a table after 1 hour wait. The food menu is pretty strange as neither dish seems to be a full dish. You order the chicken, you will only get the chicken (in a chinese chili sauce - this is supposed to be an italian place, no?). Pasta is just the pasta. So I ordered both. The bucatini were nice but ordering them alone would be like ordering a burger without buns.

The bottle of wine I ordered… yeah I definitely had nicer Primitivos with more flavor.

The service at the bar was pretty good, the one at the table not so inspiring.

It seems like a place you go for the reputation and to be seen but not for the rest.

author: Delaney Weiland
review_text:
Elephante is that kind of restaurant you can go to with so many kinds of groups and it works for every situation. Between the views, the food, drinks, and service, the experience is a 10/10.

I was traveling for work and decided to go based on a colleagues recommendation. I went alone and sat at the bar. It was pretty crowded for 5:30 on a Tuesday but didn't feel too packed in and the service was still super quick.

At the bar, I had Daniel and Dorian as my bartenders. They definitely made the solo experience lots more fun. They recommended my dinner and drinks, all of which were delicious and fun! I even got a little taste test of one of their frozen drinks which was a bonus. They definitely knew their menu and bar well.

I had a dirty martini as well as a margarita and would say the margaritas are the way to go there!! It was so delicious and I am still thinking about it. As for the food, I had whipped eggplant to start and for my main, the Ragu Bianco. Whipped eggplant was incredible, I had never had anything like it and was super obsessed. And the Ragu was perfect, not too heavy and a good portion of food.

Overall, it was a great dinner and I ended up chatting with another solo diner for the majority of the evening as well. Would recommend to anyone looking for a good date spot or just a place to grab dinner on a work trip! And if you're at the bar, ask for Daniel or Dorian for a great experience!!!

author: Kahani Patel
review_text: Elephante is such a vibe. The cocktails were excellent — super balanced and really well made. The standout dish for me was the whipped eggplant; honestly one of the best things on the menu. Fresh, flavorful, and addictive. Great atmosphere, great service. Perfect spot for a night out.

author: Alan Ritchie
review_text: We had an excellent meal at Elephante. The ambiance is next level and will be extremely hard to beat given its proximity to the water in Santa Monica. During our meal, we had a nice view of the water yet enjoyed the dark and moody atmosphere of the restaurant. The service was very kind and attentive despite being busy. We got the whipped egg plant dip which was solid (the bread is next level). We then got the vodka pasta and sopressata pizza. I really enjoyed the combination of the honey and hot soppressata on the pizza and felt that the vodka pasta was extremely well balanced. This was a great meal and I am glad we were able to make it in.   Note- I would definitely recommend making a reservation multiple weeks in advance as it was quite busy.

author: Alain Maalouf
review_text: Great food and a really nice atmosphere. Everything we ordered tasted fresh and well prepared, and the service was friendly and attentive. A few small details could be improved, but overall it was a very enjoyable experience. I’d definitely come back and recommend it.

author: Jo S
review_text: Ehh. It’s a try hard scene-y spot that only cares who you are. I have been there numerous times and tried to give them the benefit of the doubt, but the last time I was there it became abundantly clear. Friends from out of town always want to go here, and I have been happy to oblige as I enjoy the sunset views and their famous eggplant dip. But every time I’ve been here, I’ve been treated like an imposition for simply being there, shoved at a table with barely enough space, crammed between 4 other parties and a server trying to rush to get their next cover. The last time I was there, they were “setting up for a private party” which literally included tables being carried OVER my party. It was stressful and chaotic. When asking our server, she was immediately rude about the situation. There were at least 10 open tables in the front (near the railing) but I was told those were all booked. Then some influencers in sweatpants came in, were given those tables and I watched the staff members discuss their needs and serve them right away; while I’ve been waiting 10 minutes for a drink and am having tables carried over me. I follow another Bachelor contestant on Instagram that is always perched in the front. This is a see and be scene spot more than anything, and if you’re an everyday person trying to enjoy the sunset with your mom, you’re better off elsewhere.

author: Gray Stone
review_text: Élephante is a must-try and a classic LA brunch spot. Anything you order on the menu is guaranteed to be great because of the high quality of the ingredients. The ambiance is unbeatable—think chic, beachy, and effortlessly cool. It’s the perfect place for a brunch with friends, a casual date, or even out-of-town visitors. I would absolutely recommend it, whether you’re a local or a tourist looking for that quintessential LA brunch experience.

author: Ezgi Melody Yurtseven
review_text:
I had such a great experience at The Butcher’s Daughter. Our waiter Emily has such a kind soul — she was super friendly and took the time to explain everything to us about the orange wine. The manager Ashley was also very welcoming, which made the whole experience even better. I can honestly say that not only is the food good, but the people are too.

We had the margarita pizza, and it was amazing. We also had white wine and rosé, both incredible, and we tasted some orange wine which was also very good. The aesthetic of this place is just unmatched. It’s such a clean, aesthetic, Pinterest-worthy restaurant that I will definitely visit again.

The food came fast, the vibes were so on, and overall it was just a perfect experience.

author: Sara Volpatti Knutson
review_text:
We had the most amazing dinner at The Butcher’s Daughter last night! 🍷 Their wine flights were such a fun and delicious way to try a variety of pours—each one was perfectly paired and absolutely delightful. The food was just as incredible—every bite felt so fresh and flavorful. The pasta was rich and comforting, the pizza was perfectly crisp and loaded with flavor, but the star of the night for me was the gnocchi. Hands down the best I’ve had—it just melted in my mouth!

The ambiance was warm and welcoming, the service was spot on, and everything about the experience made it such a memorable evening. Already counting down the days until our next visit!

author: Your Honest Neighbor
review_text: I tried a white pizza and a lavender latte. Both were delicious. You can really taste that everything is made fresh and that the cooks enjoy being creative. I’d definitely come back and would recommend this spot. Service was super friendly and attentive. Atmosphere is relaxed.

author: Guillaume Bourcy
review_text:
As a vegetarian this is a landmark place for me. Imagine this is where plants and veggies come to party to create the perfect dishes. Even the smoothies look ready for a magazine cover. It’s that perfect mix of “I’m being healthy” and “I might still order fries.”

The space is pure Venice — sun-drenched, leafy, and filled with people who look like they just came from yoga or a photoshoot (or both).

Food’s fresh, colorful, and guilt-optional. The avocado toast is practically a local landmark, and the juices taste like they were mixed by someone with a PhD in vibes. We also love their Pad Thai as well as the Surfer burrito, available all day.

Pro tip: if you have the option, sit outside — it’s the best people-watching spot on Abbot Kinney, and the sunshine somehow makes your latte taste 20% better (scientifically unproven, spiritually accurate)

author: Mayank Dayal
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Food and service here are excellent. The red onion tart was absolutely amazing—full of flavor and beautifully presented. The spicy watermelon margaritas were another standout—refreshing with just the right kick, and the bartender is top notch.

What’s also great is their bakery: after 8 PM, all remaining baked goods are just $1! The coffee cake and muffins are fluffy, fresh, and really tasty.

I’ve also vouch wonderful things about their pizzas—crispy, light, and loaded with fresh toppings. Overall, this place is a real gem in Venice for a laid-back vibe, delicious food, and great drinks. Highly recommended!

author: Sophia Liu
review_text:
This is a very nice vegetarian restauraunt. They offer a variety of options which is nice, but as someone who isn’t vegetarian, the flavors were a little bit weak/off to me. The Greek Style Eggs were pretty good, but the burnt flavor from the charred sourdough was a bit overpowering. I liked the addition of avocado on the side, but I think more feta would’ve enhanced taste. My family also commented that the Surfers’ Burrito and Impossible Burger both tasted okay, but that they were both a little flavorless. The Pure Passion juice was delicious and refreshing though, especially if you like sourness! Other than that, service was good, and the atmosphere was probably the highlight of this restaurant. Really nice to sit in the outside area, much quieter than inside.

Overall, I think this is a good option for vegetarians but if you aren’t used to vegetarian meals, it may not suit your taste. I will mention, we didn’t get to try the salad or pizza but both looked very yummy too.

author: André
review_text: Great spot with a rustic warm interior serving some good coffee options, juices and good for a brunch with a variety of seating indoor and outdoor the service is friendly and attentive no waiting time and dishes are served fast.

author: Soraya Teffaha
review_text:
Couldn’t resist stopping by for a bite. Cozy atmosphere, delicious food, and great drinks.
Even though I’m not vegan or vegetarian, I was pleasantly surprised by how delicious everything was. A place worth returning to!

author: Shruti Rajiv
review_text: We came in during lunch hour but they have long brunch hours until 4pm and later dinner with different menus. We had the Mushroom quinoa burger and Mushroom Truffle pizza. The burger was the most delicious vegetarian burger I have ever had. Completely recommend it!!

author: Justin Ouellette
review_text:
The Butcher’s Daughter – Stylish, Satisfying, and Full of Flavor

The Butcher’s Daughter on Abbot Kinney delivers on every front—delicious food, warm service, and a beautifully curated atmosphere. The space has a cool, airy vibe that feels equal parts trendy and welcoming, perfect for a relaxed breakfast or brunch.

I ordered the gluten-free vegan waffles with maple syrup and added a side of bacon—the combination was absolutely perfect. The waffles were crisp on the outside, soft on the inside, and full of flavor. The bacon added that savory contrast I was desiring.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and created a genuinely pleasant dining experience. Whether you’re plant-based, gluten-free, or just looking for a great bite in Venice, The Butcher’s Daughter is a must-visit spot with great vibes and even better food.

author: sophie jacqueline
review_text: The vibes here are unmatched ☀️☀️ super beautiful and beachy space. The food was incredible - we got the ‘best egg sandwhich’ but veganized with tofu scramble & impossible sausage and it changed my life. We also got the butcher’s breakfast veganized & oyster mushroom calamari. The tofu scramble is soo flavourful & delicious! Also had really fun drinks like mimosa flights. Perfect sunny brunch spot. 5 stars!

author: Michal Carmel
review_text:
Great place for drinks & small/big plates :)
The place is vegetarian but it’s a non issue as everything’s so good so you can enjoy a whole meal without paying attention to it.
The drinks are VERY good - especially on happy hour (afternoon of discounts on specific wine glasses, beers and cocktails) + they have daily offers (Wednesday afternoon all wine bottles are half price).

A MUST - appetizers of broccolini and cauliflower alongside with cold sangria & a twist of espresso martini

author: Britt F
review_text:
Very great vegan food, had the avocado ceviche and red beet pepperoni pizza.
Place is a bit too loud for me because of the music. But would def come again because of the food!

author: hardika dave
review_text: We had a fantastic experience at The Butcher’s Daughter! We ordered a waffle, a burger, and a coffee, and everything was absolutely delicious. The restaurant offers a great selection of vegetarian and vegan options, making it a perfect spot for plant-based dining. The ambiance was warm and inviting, with a beautiful garden-like vibe that made it feel incredibly cozy. The service was excellent, making the entire visit even more enjoyable. Highly recommend!

author: Abhijit Chaterji
review_text:
Anyone seeking a vibrant vegan-friendly dining experience in Los Angeles, The Butcher’s Daughter stands out for its creative plant-forward cuisine and chic ambiance

Great experience

author: Christina W.
review_text: Really love having access to a vegetarian spot. The food was great, especially the mushroom calamari and Pad Thai. It’s not vegan but they’ll ask if you’re ok with eggs, etc. Very friendly wait staff and super helpful. We did have a bit of an issue regarding our seating but happy with everything else.

author: Vedangi Patel
review_text: I don't remember the server name, but she was very polite and well behaved. We ordered classic butcher's burger and the best egg sandwich. Sandwich was little in blend taste but burger was the highlight. Also we ordered cold pressed juices - red and passion . Which were truly amazing. The place's vibe was so so good. Love this place.

author: Tyra Montour
review_text: So I have all great things to say about this place! For my first time in Venice Beach it was a great experience. We went for my friends 30th birthday brunch and unbeknownst to us we didn’t know it was a vegetarian restaurant because she thrives off aesthetics but it was a 10 out of 10 on that end and for dining! We had some starters which were the biscuits and mushroom calamari and there were no pictures because we devoured them. The breakfast burritos were delicious and everything pictured matched my sentiments! Other friends ordered pizzas which are not pictured but they enjoyed them as well. I asked for hot sauce which I believe was made in house and it was more on the vinegar end but it’s all preference. The potatoes were well seasoned but to my taste they could’ve been a little more crispy but that didn’t take away from our experience at all. I provided a picture of where we were seated because it was beautiful and perfect for the birthday girl

author: Lauren Pagan
review_text: The food was pretty good, service a bit slow but beautiful outdoor seating to enjoy the LA sunshine. I would say the gluten free toast is decent but hard to cut. The most unfortunate thing was I got food poisoning from either the avocado toast or green juice. I’ve never been so sick. I hadn’t eaten anything else that day but by 5pm I was very ill.

author: Michael Daniels
review_text: Burger was solid, worth getting again. Pad Thai worked well with tofu (replaced instead of egg). Gnocchi and affogato both were good picks. Portion sizes were more European (not oversized, not tiny). Only miss was the hummus, not worth the price, would skip next time

author: L
review_text: Very fresh and great balance. Bamboo rice was good, ponzu was good and not too much source like other poke.  It would be better to order online and pick up.

author: Linda McLoon
review_text:
For a small take out poke place, this was great. The fish was fresh, and all the ingredients in our poke bowls were well thought out. We had the mango albacore poke bowl and the shitake chili tofu bowl.

Lots of people came and picked up takeout. They do have two small tables in the front on the sidewalk. I would definitely get their poke bowls again. Not much atmosphere needless to say.

author: Helen Abera-Taggay
review_text: Goodness! I have given this place chance after chance and they disappoint. The portions here are a joke and you give four slivers of cucumber with a sprinkle of tuna. My goodness, at this point, just rob at in front of our eyes so we can see it coming at least. DO NOT ORDER FROM THIS LOCATION!

author: Talia Yohai
review_text: Very good poke and even better thanks to the student discount!

author: Euthymios Logothetis
review_text: Great food, good staff but badly understaffed most of the time. Orders taking fully a half hour after scheduled pickup times, god forbid you walk in. It’s a shame that it makes it unreliable when all the fundamentals are so good. Just trying to squeeze out an extra dollar.

author: Riley Cohen
review_text: I come here almost every day after work so I think I should leave a review at this point. Super nice staff and great poke :) they’re super sweet. I get orders in this location since it’s pretty fast service and i always get time to sit down and eat during my 30 minute lunch breaks.

author: - Romanoz -
review_text: Good service, friendly staff, very tasty natural lemonade! Very clean inside🤗

author: Joe Kleyner
review_text: I placed a pickup order at Sweetfin and was told it would be ready in 10 minutes — it ended up taking over 30. On top of that, while I was waiting, I noticed flies hovering over the food behind the counter, which was really off-putting. The food itself was decent, but between the long wait and hygiene concerns, I’m not in a rush to go back.

author: Dan Barker
review_text:
horrible portions for the price I was paying I would have at expected then to be at least full.  The tiniest little bowl with 3 pieces of tuna.  Looked like they just threw it in there as quickly as possible:
