What a rip off!!  15 bucks a bowl for this??!! Never ordering from them again and I’m pissed I didn’t look at the reviews before I ordered.

author: Melanie Empting
review_text:
Used to love this spot, but the poke quality just isn’t there anymore — not worth the price.

Staff is friendly!

author: Joy Ni
review_text: Rice is undercooked. Can’t pick them up. Service people has food in mouth to talk to me …

author: Ira Simmons
review_text: I tried a new bowl (Sad Papi) It was delicious. (Albacore and forbidden rice) Try it. You’ll love it!

author: Constanza Blondet
review_text: I love Sweetfin Poke!!! I’m a fan! My go-to is the Signature Spicy Tuna Bowl with bamboo rice, extra salmon, and so many goodies I get to pick, to make my bowl exquisite, fun, and sensational! Everyone who works at my local Sweetfin in Venice, is a star! Super kind each and every time I go in person to enjoy Abbott Kinney. Grateful for Sweetfin Poke! 🙏🩵🍣🥗

author: Stella Han
review_text: If you are craving poke, this is a really great spot. They have premade menus for bowls or if you want to customize your own you can do so I usually get the large bowl and it is pretty filling. They have free water. They have outside seating and it’s pretty quick to receive your food. You will sometimes be able to find street parking depends on what time of day it is, but if you need time to kill time, there are plenty of shops around and there’s also a salt and straw if you want ice cream 🍦

author: Brandon Martinson
review_text: I ordered lunch online through the app for delivery. Everything was easy, worked perfectly and my lunch arrived on time. Everything was as I ordered and fresh. Highly recommend the spicy tuna poke bowl.

author: Andreas Lips
review_text: I love the location and vibe, but the food is not worth the price. I had the Yuzu Salmon bowl with Bamboo rice. Sounded yummy but was pretty tasteless…could not taste any Yuzu sauce and normal Sushi rice would be so much better. Unfortunately that is not available. Quite expensive, too. I ordered the large bowl which was not really large and had more of said bamboo rice than anything else. And cost me $20 (in tax and tip). All a matter of taste in the end, it’s a different spin on the classic sushi bowls. Service and vibe were good.

author: Jakub Szrodt
review_text: Cozy and welcoming, the spicy tuna burrito is AMAZING, must try!

author: Karen Berrien
review_text: I got the spicy tuna burritos last night for the family. First burrito here usually get the bowls. Fantastic experience, loved every bite and my family all felt exactly the same. Keep them coming and great new idea burritos. Thank you Tom for your great service. 5 star evening. Thanks karen

author: Cameo Litz
review_text: The quality of food is excellent. The service is phenomenal. The app is easy to use to order online and pick up. It’s my favorite place for poke.

author: Marti Deacon
review_text:
Food was great. Spicy mayo def has a kick.

Only problem is that when you order online, once you hit send, there is no way to contact the establishment if there is an issue, etc.

author: Emily G
review_text: Let’s just start with the white truffle pasta, out of this world divine, and yet so simply prepared and perfect in every way, worth the $100, for us yes! We much prefer quality over quantity. We had two other pasta dishes, all extremely good. The market salad was light, simple, healthy and delicious, for us the way prefer a salad. The Somm help us choose a perfect bottle of wine to celebrate our anniversary. The cannoli and the gelato were also worth the calories. If I were a local, this would be my neighborhood spot! We loved sitting next to the pasta making room.

author: corina vozniak
review_text: For Venice this was 5* for me. Attentive staff, good cocktail/wine list, and most marvelous sausage/rabe orecchiette pasta. Loved the meatballs, okay pizza (mostly because all LA pizzas taste the same, soggy in the middle, yeasty fluffy crust and whatever else on the middle), but the pasta...it was a little chewy, a little doughy (all in the best way possible), perfectly saucy, spiced to perfection. The Nebbiolo they source washes down splendidly after all the protein/carb intake. Servers are attentive, knowledgeable, non-intrusive but always around and quick.

author: Richard Wehmeyer
review_text: Came here for a birthday dinner. We had great service and got all questions answered professionally, especially one person has an allergy. All the food was delicious so at the end there was nothing left on the plate :D

author: Angelique Milillo
review_text: Wow! Amazing service from Kelly and a dining experience that was nothing short of perfect. Every dish, from the appetizers to the dessert, was beautifully presented and absolutely delicious. Authentic Italian flavors, fresh ingredients, and handmade pasta that melts in your mouth—what more could you ask for? A true culinary delight!  thank you!

author: Gray Stone
review_text:
Fantastic meal at Felix! You really can’t go wrong with an Evan Funke restaurant. The pasta was perfectly made, and the flavors were spot on. That said, I do wish the menu felt a little more distinct from his other restaurants. It’s definitely in line with his signature style, so if you’ve been to his other spots, you’ll find a lot of overlap.

The quality and service are definitely there—the staff was knowledgeable, friendly, and attentive without being overbearing. The atmosphere is cozy but lively, with a great energy for date night or a special dinner with friends. Overall, Felix is absolutely worth a visit.

author: Chris Tang
review_text:
Food here is pricey but the quality reflects.  The true stars of the place are the pasta dishes.  We ordered the peach with Burrata cheese and Polpette Della Maestra Alessandra (prosciutto meatball) as appetizers. Both were good but didn’t particularly stand out. The prosciutto meatballs was the better of the two dishes in my opinion.   We tried the Margherita pizza and it was very good. The pizza dough had a good chewy texture.  For the pasta dishes we got the Trofie (pesto sauce), Rigatoni All’Amatriciana and Orecchiette.  All three were outstanding and cooked Al Dente.  They were all delicious and had nice firm chewy feel in the mouth. Sauces were solid also. My wife liked the Trofie the best. My daughter voted for the Rigatoni, and I personally rate the Orechiette the best (on the slim margin the sauce has a spicy kick to it). It’s a good sign that there were no clear winners here - gives a good indication they were all good.  We also ordered the grilled Branzino - preparation was great (they had debone most of the fish bone), the taste was good but didn’t blow us away (albeit we were all really full by that time and only took few bites of the fish - maybe if we had less food before we would have rate it higher.

Service attentive and efficient and decor was good also.  Overall the food were very good with special mention to the pasta. We plan to return

author: 밥버걸
review_text:
I had one of the worst dining experiences at Felix Trattoria. Our server, a white blonde woman, seemed friendly on the surface—but what happened with the food was unacceptable.

First, we ordered the walnut salad. It arrived with absolutely no walnuts. Strangely enough, the table right next to us got the exact same salad at the same time, and theirs was full of walnuts. When I pointed this out, the server apologized and just brought walnuts on the side. At first, I thought it was just a mistake or bad luck.

Then the shrimp (gamberoni) came out—salty but still decent. The real nightmare started after that. We waited 20–30 minutes for our pizza while the table next to us got theirs much faster. We brushed it off, but after finishing the pizza, we ended up waiting another 40 minutes for our pasta. By then, we were furious.

When the pasta finally arrived, it was inedible. It was so salty it actually tasted bitter. It was the kind of salt overload that makes you feel like even in death, your body still wouldn’t decompose. Everyone at the table took one bite and gave up. The pasta texture itself was fine, but serving food like that is disgraceful.

On the outside, the staff put on a smile, but if you’re going to play games with the food, that’s something this restaurant should be ashamed of. Especially since this place was recommended by someone we trust, and they specifically said it wasn’t salty. That makes me believe this wasn’t an accident—it felt deliberate.

And as if that wasn’t enough, when we asked for the check, they brought us the wrong bill. We had ordered four dishes and a glass of wine, but the check showed $440—obviously not ours. Imagine if we hadn’t noticed. So here’s my advice: if you ever dine here, always double-check your bill unless you want to get ripped off.

So thanks for giving us the worst dining experience possible. But here’s a tip: don’t ever do this again. Tourists aren’t stupid. And if this was rooted in discrimination, that only shows your true lack of class.

author: Papa
review_text: Joined friends for dinner, it was our first time and the meal and service was amazing.  We sat in the patio area, which was nice it being a warm night. The food came out delicious and the service was on point. Perfect place for date night.

author: Peter Farejowicz
review_text: Felix Trattoria on Abbot Kinney delivered a fantastic dining experience. The atmosphere was sophisticated yet warm, making it perfect for a night out with friends or a special occasion. We ordered everything family style, and every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. The pastas, in particular, were standout. One note: I wouldn’t recommend the white sauce pizzas—those fell a little flat—so I’d suggest sticking with the traditional ones. Service was attentive without being overbearing, and the whole evening felt well-paced and enjoyable.

author: Kyle VonDeBur
review_text: Traveled to Italy last year, and this is still up there with the best pasta I have ever eaten! The bolognese and amatriciana were both phenomenal, and the prawns were also great! And the kids enjoyed the Margherita pizza too!

author: Ruth Alba
review_text: Felix Trattoria does not miss. The burrata with persimmons was unreal, fresh, creamy, and the persimmons made it feel special. And the pizza? I’m not even a pizza person, but I was obsessed. Spicy pepperoni with the perfect heat. 10/10 dinner.

author: NL. C.E.
review_text: Amazing experience! Had wanted to go here since I saw Funke’s Amazon docu in 2020! Well it was worth the wait. Fast (we were dining during a long layover to AUS), friendly service and amaze balls food. We were able to eat apps, mains and dessert all in an hr. Thanks to our server (and kitchen staff) for taking into account our short time to dine! Perfect, perfect all around.

author: Hamilton
review_text: Great pizza and pasta, not a fan of the pork chop with apricot jam, too dry.  Be aware, the pasta is quite “al dente”.  Obviously over-priced for what is basically a good pasta ($26 to $50 pastas)

author: Brian Young
review_text: Our third time coming and it never disappoints!  Every part of the dining experience is top notch -- location, service, food.  Servers are attentive without being disruptive, pacing is perfect, questions always answered with deep knowledge of the menu.  Every dish we've had has been an A+: roman bread (so good!), every pasta, deserts.  Wine selection is really good with Italian options that complement the meal.  Lots of drink options with a full bar.  The view of the pasta making station is such a cool touch to see all the handmade pasta.  Secondi dishes also so good, we've had the pork and beef.  Just everything you would want from an upscale Italian meal that tastes like Italy.  We haven't had the pizza yet, but it's coming one of these days.  Finish off with a Limoncello or Sambuca, just like you're in Tuscany.  A+

author: Daniel John
review_text: Disappointing. First off, you can’t argue that the pasta itself is god-level. Perfect texture and shape. But the sauces on the pasta were terrible. Extremely oily and heavy, completely overwhelming the beautiful pasta. We couldn’t even finish the Busiate, and quite honestly it looked awful as well. The tagliatelle ragu was so oily after one small portion of it my plate was covered in residual oil, see the photo. The green salad was nice as were the prawns. We didn’t think the pizza was remarkable, super soggy in the middle. We skipped dessert. Wine was egregiously overpriced and small pours. I guess we missed out on this place’s heyday because there is much more refined Italian going on all over the city right now, especially at this price point.

author: P T
review_text:
Food was incredible. Had the prawns, in-house focaccia, squash blossoms with herbed ricotta, and the pappardelle w/ragù toscano, fennel pollen & parmigiano reggiano.

Nothing fell flat, everything was perfectly seasoned and cooked. I will definitely come here again when I'm back in LA for work.

Server's were extremely helpful and kind.

author: Jessica Rush
review_text: We had a great time in Beverly Hills, and the Mexican food was an added bonus. Our server was excellent, and the food was good. However, as someone who hasn't had Mexican food in LA before, I wouldn't have too high of an expectation, It was good but could have been better. The atmosphere was lively, which matched the fun vibe of the town. The restaurant did a good job keeping the energy up. Although not cheap, the prices were reasonable considering the location.

author: taylor banasiak
review_text:
The food at Felix was good but not unforgettable. The arancini were crisp and cheesy, the rigatoni carbonara was rich and well balanced, and the gnocchi in tomato sauce had that classic comforting flavor. You can tell the pasta is handmade with care, and the ingredients are fresh.

That said, the overall experience left something to be desired. The service felt too casual, almost indifferent. For a restaurant of this caliber, you expect warm, attentive hospitality especially given the price point and reputation. Instead, it felt like the servers were just going through the motions.

If you’re choosing between Felix and Funke (both from the same chef), skip Felix and head to Funke. You’ll get just as good (if not better) food, and the service and atmosphere are far more polished and welcoming. That makes all the difference.

author: Du Rainie
review_text:
Agreed—an incredibly overpriced wine list. The food is okay, but one pasta dish was very salty, and the inside was still hard and undercooked.

We arrived after 8 PM, and by 9 PM, the patio was empty. Staff started checking on us every 10 minutes while we were still finishing our last two dishes which were served very late (including the salty undercooked pasta). For over $100 per person, there are better options in the area.

author: Giuseppe Digiamma
review_text: Felix is one of the best places I've been in the last few months. Food is amazing, staff extra caring and accommodating. Never felt so much welcomed in a place being there for the first time! From the greetings to the service and the attention received during the meal all was outstanding!!! I'll definitely go back and try more of their dishes!!! AMAZING!!

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Michael Paul
review_text:
I found the food to have a vast variety of choices, and absolutely fabulous.
Most of the prices are reasonable.
However I find the service itself to be poor and lacking as your suppose to tip a non waiter/waitress server that does not serve nor collect. No Bueno!
Further more if your going to work with customers in the United States, speaking and understanding english clearly and fluidly is highly recommended if you like repeat business and recommendations.

I am going to change to a five star, as my boyfriend and I went back for a second chance and it was better, as tips were earned this time by interacting at our seat with service to receive our food! Thank you!
I don't mind putting my dishes away on the way out, it should be marked better to do so.
I love the make your own bowl.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Casey Kopp
review_text: The people working here are so friendly!! Coconut cold brew is a must get. Great place to work or hang for a bit because of their nice patio seating area!! Inside has some seating as well with a couple outlets. Breakfast sandwich was 10/10 too!!! Coming back next chance I get 😍

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Emil Cohen
review_text:
The Hive coffee shop at AMLI Marina Del Rey may look like a nice café, but behind the scenes, their operations create a serious nuisance for the residents who live here.

Every single night at around 1:30 AM, delivery trucks arrive for The Hive — seven nights a week. These are large trucks with lift gates, engines running, loud reversing alarms, and flashing lights that wake people up in the middle of the night. The deliveries last 30–60 minutes, and the noise carries directly into apartments above.

What makes this worse is that The Hive doesn’t even open until 7:00 AM. There is no valid reason why deliveries must happen at 1:30 AM when they could easily occur after opening or before closing. Instead, the business chooses a schedule that disrupts hundreds of residents’ sleep for their convenience.

A café should be part of the community, not a source of nightly disturbance. Until The Hive changes its delivery practices and respects the residents who live above them, I cannot recommend supporting this business. If they fix this, I will update my review.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Pao M
review_text: Bad service in the afternoon..not sure if the morning staff is better. I updated my rating due to another bad experience, purchasing food at 6:30 pm, and not being allowed to eat inside because they were closing at 7. We were not told our food was going to be to-go only, we, and two other couples,  were literally kicked out. ....I’ve been here many times and the food is usually very good. Service is generally OK too. However, I want to share a recent issue. I placed a to-go order two days ago for two chicken pesto bowls, and both were missing the chicken. Since it was takeout, I didn’t realize until I got home—and by then, the store was closed. I called the next day and was told I could come back to pick up the chicken, which didn’t make much sense and honestly took me by surprise. I let them know I wouldn’t be returning just for that, but wanted to make them aware so they can look into it and improve. I was disappointed with how it was handled. If interested in looking into it, the order was to go at around 6:50 PM on 07/02/2025 (I added a video of the bowl)

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Alex Ford
review_text:
I met a friend here for breakfast. It’s a cute little spot! The menu has hot breakfasts, salads, açaí bowls, and smoothies.

I had the breakfast bowl which isn’t marked as gluten free but is indeed gluten free. It was great!! Next time I’d ask for my eggs scrambled just because it’s hard to sop up all that yolk-y goodness without bread. But overall, very happy with my breakfast. I also got the Jasmine green tea and they gave me a FAT wad of tea which is awesome.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Heather Martin
review_text: We moved to the neighborhood recently and have gone to The Hive a couple of times now and definitely plan on making this a weekly treat. So far we have had: hot PSL, iced PSL, Green Hornet Smoothie, the Açaí berry champ smoothie, and the breakfast sandwich with bacon. Everything we’ve tried has been yummy. Cute and quiet little coffee shop in MDR. Pricing can vary depending on if you just get drinks or if you get drinks and food. For 2 beverages and 1 breakfast sandwich we spent about $45

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: NJ H
review_text: I love this place. They have the best fresh catch salad. I get it like once a week. I’m obsessed. Staff is nice. Food is clean. Try it out.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Colleen Grant (Wanderfrequently)
review_text:
Just picked up my order that was ordered online. I asked for an 8AM pick up. I live in the area and this place is the only place to get decent healthy food. However, their customer service lacks.  My latte was starting to freeze. I nicely told the front counter person that I thought the refrigerator was programmed too cold and that my drink is starting to freeze. She replied that it was sitting there for a while. I am 5 minutes late. Drinks don't freeze in the refrigerator for 5 minutes. Freezer - yes. Frig - no. She dismissed me. No offer to make it over again. Have you tried a frozen latte? I assume that if the refrigerator is operating correctly, she probably made my order at 7:30 when I ordered it and it sat there for 35 minutes. Either way, their staff are not willing to take ownership of their errors.

If you go and order in person, things are typically fine - still have staff attitude. But if you order online, you have a 50/50 chance things are good.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Cassandra Bell
review_text: My favorite health food spot on the Westside! I’m actually attached to the Blue Crush smoothie…. Service is always warm, wide selection of health conscious options, vibe is lovely with books and games on the shelves. I make sure to come here whenever I’m in the area <3

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Raina M.
review_text: I got the iced strawberry matcha and the smoked salmon toast. I stood at the register quite a while before anyone acknowledged me. Food and drinks were good though. Almost all the customers there who stopped for a coffee had 1-2 dogs with them, which i loved! Plenty of outdoor seating.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Giancarlo Manco
review_text:
We had a fantastic breakfast at The Hive. I went for the salmon toast with poached eggs, while my girlfriend chose the avocado toast. Both dishes were really well done—fresh ingredients and great balance of flavors. We also ordered two cappuccinos, one with almond milk, and finished with a gluten-free chocolate donut. The cappuccinos were spot on, and the donut was a perfect sweet treat to end the meal.

Everything tasted fresh, and the ingredients were well-balanced and flavorful. The portions were satisfying without being too heavy, and the overall quality really stood out. If you’re looking for a spot with great food and attention to detail, The Hive is definitely worth a visit.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Zachary Weisenthal
review_text: I would give The Hive 6 stars if I could. It’s such a cute, clean spot right on the water. The entire menu is delicious and has truly nourishing options with healthy ingredients. The portions are good sizes. This is my teams’ go-to healthy spot for breakfast, lunch, and dinner whenever we are in the area! Staff is friendly!

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Lobna Akl
review_text: Their bowls are delicious, I’d have breakfast there everyday if I could!

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Melissa Jeffries
review_text: The Hive is THE spot in Manhattan Beach! Organic coffee? Fire 🔥  Build-your-own bowls? Straight-up fuel for the soul. They’ve got so many macronutrient-packed options that even my 🦩 flamingo spirit animal stays balanced—one leg up, vibing with the ocean views. The staff? A1 👌🏽 Friendly, welcoming, and they make you feel like a regular even if it’s your first time. Whether you’re pulling up for a post-surf espresso or a power bowl to keep you thriving, The Hive gets it right every time. 🍯 Hive, let’s heal 💛 Stay healthy, stay happy, and keep those good vibes buzzing! 🦩☕🔥 For more organic coffee reviews and music follow me IG: @TheBaristaBae

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Christopher Tann
review_text:
Absolutely incredible eating experience. I had a warm bowl and every individual ingredient was fresh and prepared so deliciously. One of my favorite meals that I didn’t cook myself.
And the people here are super cool; Angel is super kind and answered all my questions and help me with all my modifiers!

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Sasha de Witt
review_text: PHENOMENAL food. The make your own bowls were incredible as well as the protein shake. Will definitely be back!

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Taka H
review_text:
Small grab and good spot Orangetheory fitness and semi close to Marriott

A decent amount of outdoor seating and friendly service. They actually brought the food out and consistently checked in

Donnie’s breakfast burrito was Phil. I love how it’s loaded with tons of mushrooms and well-balanced.

The OG breakfast burrito was also amazing if you like your baking crispy or your potatoes crispy, I will let them know

Avocado toast looks like a popular item since I saw a lot of people get it along with her açaí bowls

Had the blue crush smoothie which is really good the blue spirulina, blueberries, and coconut whip cream definitely blended well

Love this spot and nothing but positive vibes definitely will be coming back

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Anthony Montijo
review_text: Came in today as a dad on a mission, my daughter was working hard on her homework and really needed a coffee break. I wasn’t sure what to get her, so I asked the team for help. They were so kind and helped me pick out the perfect drink. She absolutely loved it! Thank you for the friendly service and for making her study session a little sweeter.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Nancy Garvin
review_text: The Hive is my go to spot in Marina  del Rey! Delicious, health, fresh, + Inspired 🍒🍓🫐🥗🌯

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Sara Lee
review_text: Such a great vibe and food! Had the chicken pesto bowl and green hornet smoothie. Both were delicious

author: Faaz
review_text:
Playa Provisions offers a wonderful coastal dining experience with a warm, inviting vibe. The space is cozy yet thoughtfully designed, with a variety of seating options across different areas. There’s a lively bar, a charming fireplace, and a beautiful patio that truly shines—especially given its proximity to the ocean. The wooden tables and chairs feel solid and high-quality, adding to the overall relaxed but refined atmosphere.
Our waitress, Jordyn, was genuinely kind, friendly, and sweet. Her attentive and welcoming attitude made the experience even more enjoyable.
For food, we ordered the lobster roll, which came as a smaller sandwich but was absolutely delicious. The flavors were well balanced, with just the right amount of seasoning, and the portion felt satisfying. Definitely worth trying.
The bay scallop and tiger shrimp ceviche was another highlight—fresh, vibrant, and refreshing. It had a clean, healthy feel, and the addition of diced mango introduced a subtle sweetness that elevated the dish and added an extra layer of flavor. Both dishes were served cold, which worked perfectly for the seaside setting.
Overall, Playa Provisions delivers great ambiance, attentive service, and thoughtfully prepared seafood. A lovely spot to enjoy quality food by the ocean.

author: Kayla-Kae Betalero Nepomuceno
review_text:
We came here for lunch on a Friday afternoon and it was not too busy but definitely seems like a popular place to eat.

We ordered at the counter and then we were able to seat ourselves and choose a place to sit.

We ordered the Reuben sandwich and the lobster seafood roll. Both were one of the best sandwiches we had and were so delicious. The Reuben didn’t seem like a traditional Reuben but had their own twist which we loved.

We are definitely coming back and excited to try more but would be hard to not reorder the same sandwiches because of how amazing they were.

author: Kate May
review_text:
🌟 🌟 Chill beach vibe and super fresh oysters 🌟 🌟
We really enjoyed our visit to Playa Provisiones! The ambiance is stylish yet relaxed ~ perfect for a coastal evening out. The oysters were absolutely fresh and delicious, a true highlight of the meal. It’s the kind of place where you can unwind, enjoy good food, and feel the beachy vibe all around. We’ll definitely be coming back! 🌊🦪

author: Marie Taylor-Morrison
review_text: Laid-back beach vibes, relaxed restaurant. Friendly staff, excellent food, good service. We ordered the fish tacos and the corned beef sandwich. Both delicious. Nice relaxing music played during our lunchtime visit.

author: Zhanna Godkin
review_text: we had a great dinner here. arrived during happy hour, ordered some starters and drinks off the menu, and also ordered off the main dinner menu. everything was fresh and delicious. highly recommend the scallop, crab claw lollipop, and ciopinno. kid friendly as well - kids menu available with crayons to draw on it.

author: Angela Lopez
review_text: Absolutely incredible, we used to frequent The Triple; a restaurant owned by the same chef (has since closed). Found out she opened this location and serves the clams pesto, a favorite dish loved by my entire family. Our experience was unforgettable. Would highly recommend! We had the fish tacos too and they were yummmm!!!! Bon appetite

author: Scootski
review_text: Food was really good — I genuinely enjoyed it. The atmosphere was a whole vibe, especially being right next to the beach. Definitely worth stopping by!

author: Dave R
review_text: This the second TOC Champion’s restaurant I have been to, but sadly no where in the same league as Maneet’s Chauhan Ale and Masala House.  Maybe we came on a bad night, but our server didn’t seem engaging at all and forgetting a couple of items we ordered. Our entrees were just so-so at best.  Really had hoped it would be a memorable dinner, but sadly far from it.

author: Brian Bossin
review_text: My wife and I like this place. It is in a great location, we walk to the beach before dinner. She enjoys sea food more than me. I wish there was a burger that was simpler. Guyere? No thank you.The wagyu steak was covered in sauce and was whatever. The desert ice cream area is awesome. The staff is great. By the bar is super loud. The main dining room is better.

author: Bader Ink
review_text: We searched for fish and chips and ended up here! This place didn’t disappoint. The Smoked Trout Dip is wonderful. The muscles and clams were the best I’ve ever had and order them often  all over the world. The fish and chips didn’t disappoint either. The fish was lightly battered and the fish was delish. The lobster roll was something of a waste of money. The roll part was good but the liberated was lacking of flavor compared to the rest of what we had.

author: Adi
review_text: Tons of fresh options with a great selection of seafood dishes. The oysters were great, but the highlight was the fresh scallops which were delicious. The drinks were good and the staff was very friendly.

author: Nicole Parker
review_text:
My husband and I drove 1.5 hours each way to visit Brooke’s restaurant. We were in Long Beach for one night for a convention, and because my husband is a huge Brooke fan, this stop was a must for him. Unfortunately, the experience was a major disappointment from start to finish.

Ironically, the best part of the entire night was the parking attendant—he was genuinely warm, friendly, and absolutely exceptional. I wish the rest of the experience matched his level of service.

For a restaurant that boasts a speakeasy whiskey bar, the old fashioned should be a standout, yet the one we had at our hotel earlier was significantly better. The appetizers were shockingly small, and not a single dish stood out. Everything tasted just “okay” at best.

The steak frites were the biggest letdown—so chewy that we couldn’t even finish it. We’ve been to several celebrity chef restaurants, and while we know they can be hit or miss, we expected more from Brooke, especially with how competitive and talented she is.

The restaurant itself is cute but underwhelming, and the food simply isn’t worth going out of your way for. Be prepared to spend quite a bit of money for mediocre dishes and tiny portions.

Overall, this was not the experience we hoped for, and sadly, we wouldn’t return.

author: Zan Lee
review_text:
A seriously delicious, casual, hip seafood restaurant in Playa Del Rey, right near the beach. It is owned and managed by Brooke Williamson, who is one of my favorite Top Chef winners. She really has some unique dishes on the menu and every single one has great flavors and preparation. I will say the only downside we experienced was we were a table of two and had to wait 45 minutes for our first appetizers to arrive at our table, but I’m guessing that was due to some sort of delay in the kitchen. Inside is really well designed and laid out well. It’s very spacious, modern and as indoor and outdoor seating options. I love that outside has a working fire pit with tables all around it and views of the sand dunes. They also have a full bar that was very busy when we dined in this past Saturday night and I did not see a single open table so I would recommend making reservations before stopping in. Parking in the area can be a bit tricky but we are able to find a free street space a few hundred feet away from the restaurant entrance. There is plenty of parking options near the water side, north west of the restaurant.

The menu has a ton of great options on it and our server was extremely polite. It took me a while to choose what I wanted to order because there were so many things that I wanted to get. The first dish that came was the Fried Crab Claw and we thought these were fantastic. We ordered two but they have a lot of meat in them so they are more filling than they look. The dipping sauces on the side were a great addition and I love the Old Bay seasoning with them. Next came the Clam Chowder and this was one of the best Clam Chowders I’ve had in a very long time. The pancetta inside was a great addition and it just had really nice flavors. We followed that with a Bluefin Tuna Tartare that may have been our favorite of the three appetizers. It had great flavors and a bit of a crunch to it, and I could taste the mix of flavors long after finishing the dish. For our entrées, we chose the Connecticut Style Seafood Roll and the Bucket of Clams and Mussels. We also ordered a side of the Sunchokes, which were fantastic. Sunchokes are in the artichoke family and taste just like an artichoke heart so if you’ve never had one, but like artichokes, I would highly recommend ordering this. Both our entrées were fantastic, the Connecticut Style Seafood Roll was filled with all different types of seafood and was much more filling than I anticipated. The bucket of Clams and Mussels was also great and the sauce it came in it was very light but packed with flavor. I was really impressed with all the dishes that we ordered and we did not have a single bad item. Aside from the delay getting the food items to us, it was a great meal and I would highly recommend to anyone in the area or even close by. This would be a great place to visit with friends/family or it would also be a nice date spot. I would definitely recommend and I plan to be back many times in the future.

author: J
review_text: The shellfish tower was great—particularly the Peruvian scallops! The lobster would have been excellent if served hot instead of chilled. The Connecticut style seafood roll was incredibly delicious in flavor, and the bread was perfectly toasted! The swordfish steak was fine, but not very impressive in flavor or texture. The crab mac and cheese was fine, but could have been great if more crab was added. The service was vey courteous, attentive and helpful with menu suggestions. The night atmosphere in December was excellent with the low lit theme, fire pits, holiday decorations and an aquarium next to the bar with a very impressive array of sea life. Great spot for dinner if you’re in the beach area!

author: Gerard Lee
review_text:
This was my first visit to this very crowded and vibrant restaurant where Culver Blvd meets Pacific Ave in Playa Del Rey. Valet parking only ($5, plus tip). I had a 2:30pm reservation but was in the area early so I ended up dining at the bar.

I started with a Hendricks gin & tonic ($14) and two Peruvian Scallops ($7ea). The scallops were a visual and taste treat … curry Amarillo sauce, daikon relish, yuzu tobiko, sea grass and some chili oil. I should have ordered more.

I had the lobster roll ($26), cold chunks of lobster meat, mixed with pickled mustard seed, celery and crushed potato chips in a soft, toasted roll. It was very good, but I wished the lobster meat was warmer. I should have ordered a side of fries … the person next to me had a large bowl of fries … I was jealous!

I ended my meal with a cup of coffee (gratis) and walked out sated. This restaurant was added to my list of “must stops” when I’m in LA. To remind me, I bought a T-shirt with their logo on the rear ($35).

author: Justin Ouellette
review_text:
Playa Provisions – Warm Vibes, Incredible Banana Bread

Playa Provisions is a coastal gem that blends laid-back charm with high-quality food and genuinely kind people. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt warm and welcoming—easy to relax in, with good energy all around.

I have to say, the banana bread completely blew me away. It was gluten-free and hands down the best banana bread I’ve ever had—moist, flavorful, and perfectly balanced. The bacon was also a standout—crispy, delicious, and reasonably priced, which is rare these days.

The staff were friendly and attentive, making the entire experience even better. Whether you’re looking for a quiet morning bite or a spot to soak in positive vibes and great food, Playa Provisions is a place I’ll be returning to again and again.

author: Judith Gottesfeld
review_text:
Excellent food and service. We shared a dozen oysters of 4 different varieties.
The Cajun shrimp and dungeness crab benedict was tasty but one of the egg yolks was overcooked.
The corned beef rueben was definitely shareable.
We ordered a side of fries and it was served with ketchup! I thought that was rather mundane. The server brought a delicious aioli instead.
The cup of hot Chai tea was wonderful - plain without latte.
Our adult beverages were excellent.

author: Oana Gusatu
review_text:
We stopped here for breakfast. Options are limited especially if you’re vegetarian/vegan.

We had a croissant (which was quite good) served with jam, and a buttermilk biscuit which was very fresh and tasty. The breakfast plate however looked a bit sad. Drinks were good (tea and oat milk cappuccino).

Their patio is very dog and child friendly but parking is difficult (only option is valet parking or street parking if you’re lucky).

author: Jay Sun
review_text: What a cool little place just 15 minutes or so near LAX. If you're coming for a flight from further out and not sure about risking traffic, might as well come here for a nice meal or coffee before heading over the the airport. The fish tacos were spot on! So good that I ended up eating nothing at the airport so as not to diminish my last meal in LA. Service was also very friendly. Will definitely come back!

author: Meridith Marshall
review_text: We had a great experience at Playa Provisions.  We were doing an early dinner prior to a concert so we got here in time for happy hour.   The appetizers and wine were on the happy hour menu and very reasonably priced.   The calamari and the Szechuan wings were both very good. Both were crispy and flavorful.   My husband had the lobster roll which she really enjoyed and I had the Bronzino and Dashi and it was delicious!   The broth was amazing.  We had the vanilla bean crème brûlée for dessert and that was really good too. It was served with delicious lemon shortbread.    Our waiter Victor was fantastic!

author: Ya- Ya
review_text:
Good location (love The Library & Cocorenos across the street); street parking is a challenge.
Lunch date with my gal.
We've had shrimp 'n grits in Nawlins, and love the cheesy grits at The Hangout in Seal Beach. THIS version was unexpectedly creamy, sweet.
The highly recommended (by the waiter/server) sizzling rice bowl had a flavorful sauce, 2 eggs on top--wished we had tried the gumbo instead as we don't like rice & eggs that much.
Overall, fun fusion food adventure. Well appointed interior & staff.

author: K F
review_text: We went on a Sunday around noon. It was very busy but the wait wasn't that long. The staff was friendly and attentive. We started with the mac and cheese with flaming cheetos, which was really good and the best part of the meal! I had biscuits and gravy + 2 eggs. I ordered the eggs over medium/jammy. They came very over easy so I didn't appreciate that. The biscuits were slathered in gravy but still on the drier side. I wish I would've ordered the gravy on the side as it was too much. My husband ordered the burger and enjoyed it.

author: Diana Puzikova
review_text:
Amazing!
Great service, people are really the best over there! Atmosphere is nice, I see the love that put in the place.
I stopped on Saturday for mini bites party with my fam, we were pleasantly surprised that they have Happy Hour daily and tried Mac and cheese, burgers, and the best donuts (!!!)
Everything is amazing!
Drink menu is good, we had sparkling Californian, AC/DC, espresso martini and whiskey.
I’ll be back!

P.S. they saved my purse! 😂🙏

author: Nathan Hanners
review_text:
Great spot for a weekend brunch. The cheetos mac-and-cheese was amazing get it with the short rib! The restaurant made pasta was very good. My wife and I had split the Benedict with the Grit cake was a really interesting idea and we really liked the shrimp, the pork was a little all over the place taste wise. French toast was huge! We took over half of it.

Service was on point. Recommendations were good.

Flies. There were lots of flies. They have little fans but you have to ask for them.

Overall we loved this place and my wife looks forward to having brunch with her friends soon.

author: Brandi Bird
review_text:
Loved our server, Emma!
She was wonderful, very attentive and personable. :)

The overall atmosphere here is awesome! The decor is lovely.

Food was delicious - the Mac & Cheetos is a MUST.

Highly recommend!

author: Jorge Menendez
review_text: For more than a few years I had been wanting to give this place a try, today we finally made it happen. Late lunch at 2:30pm, my guest ordered the reliable cheese burger with fries and I decided to go for what seemed like the most unusual dish, their Shakshuka Stew. Wow, the burger was great, but the Stew is this kind of satisfying meal where you felt like you also got a B-12 shot. Great flavor and very satisfying. I look forward to going back as soon as I have a chance. We were there in a not busy zone, so great service was expected and delivered. Thank you, and high compliments to the Chef👍

author: Allison K
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The Attic is phenomenal! The food is bursting with flavor and truly memorable. The gumbo is absolutely five-star, perfectly seasoned and comforting. The AC/DC cocktail was spot on, and the banana pudding dessert was the perfect sweet finish. Everything exceeded expectations. I’ll 100% be returning!

author: Gustavo Espinoza Jr
review_text:
My friend brought me here during a gap between our classes and told me it was a fan favorite here in LB. Truth be told, I had never heard of this place but I'm glad he brought me.

We were able to be seated almost immediately. After a few recommendations, I settled for the chicken and waffles. I wanted to try the Reuben, as the waiter mentioned it is a more popular option but also limited. They had ran out of them by the time we got there. I was disappointed but it just means I will have to come back to try it another day!

The chicken and waffles were pretty good though. It was a fair portion too, not too much and not too little. One giant piece of chicken and one medium sized waffle with a side of gravy and hot honey Tabasco. It all tasted really good and the chicken was super tender and crispy. I can't say I was left disappointed with my choice.

Our server constantly checked up on us to see how we were doing and constantly brought us glasses of water. I liked this detail. Also the patio seating outside was lovely on a sunny afternoon in Long Beach. Thankfully it was not too hot or cold outside.

author: JOANNA LUNA
review_text: This was my first experience at the attic and it won’t be my last. The grandmas cornbread and bone marrow pie was so delicious. The atmosphere was inviting and the service was attentive and respectful. My family and I had enjoyed the evening for a few hours leaving satisfied.

author: Alex Rice
review_text: This spot is such a gem! Staff is always so friendly and they go above and beyond in service.  Notably, Fernando and Nathaniel have consistently provided excellent service!  The food is delicious, the happy hour specials are top tier, and the menu is fun with unique offerings. Pictured is my latest visit with their “girl dinner”.  On my latest trip, I was chilly and they even had the softest coziest blanket for me!  Seriously,  I can’t say enough good things about The Attic!

author: Alon Grinshpoon
review_text: This place is an incredible restaurant! 🍴 The Attic serves an incredible selection of unbelievably delicious 🤤 dishes 🍽️ - definitely get the Bread 🍞 with Pimento 🌶️ Cheese 🧀, the Cornbread 🌽 with Butter 🧈 and Honey 🍯 (probably the best cornbread I ever had), Mac & Cheetos 🍝, and Spring 🌱 Pea 🫛 Salad! 🥗 The place is nicely decorated 🛋️, the ambience 🎶 is great, service is professional and quick ⏲️, and the staff 👨‍🍳 is super friendly and helpful! I wish I knew about this place earlier and could come here more often!

author: Rebecca J
review_text: We came for brunch - my friend who lives locally recommended. The vibe is very trendy with a cute patio space outside. The Riccota French toast was amazing! Im going down a star as the chicken sandwich had a chewy texture that threw us off.

author: Renett Young
review_text:
This was my second visit.  Dined on the patio were the louvers moved with the change of the suns direction.

Nice ambiance allowing us to take in the neighborhood good vibes of people walking and visiting the local shops after dining.

The waiters and staff worked well as a team.  The rice breakfast bowl is one of my favorite and didn't miss out on getting a bloody mary.

Looking forward to my next visit.

author: James Parker
review_text:
We found The Attic while searching for the best breakfast spots in Long Beach. It wasn’t at the very top of the list, but with thousands of positive reviews, we decided to give it a shot—and we’re so glad we did.

Located in a charming neighborhood with local shops and a great dive bar (Reno Room—definitely worth a visit after brunch), The Attic has a modern, welcoming vibe. There’s plenty of outdoor seating, a large open-air bar area, and indoor dining as well.

The menu is packed with tempting options. We ordered the Chicken and Waffles and the BEC—both were absolutely delicious. The real standout, though, was the biscuits with jam and butter. Honestly, they might be the best biscuits I’ve ever had—crispy on the outside, flaky on the inside, full of flavor, and not at all dry.

To top it off, the mimosas were only $4 each and poured generously with champagne. Service was excellent: attentive, friendly, and fast.

I’ll definitely be back the next time I’m in Long Beach.

author: Tonia Davis
review_text: It was my first time at this restaurant The Attic. My daughter chose this location. I love the ambiance, the ceiling decor, fireplace and the musical was amazing.  The service was very good and professional. Now the food was marvelous.  I had the chicken gumbo and it was  delectable to my palate and satisfying. My daughter had a buger and fries and cleaned her plate. I would love come back again and try their brunch. We will be back soon.

author: Christopher Grant
review_text: The cuisine was fantastic. This banana bread treat that my wife got was delicious. I took three sixteen-year-old males who placed a large meal order. They order macaroni, which is topped with Cheetos and contains shredded ribs. Along with these fantastic garlic fries, the boys also ordered a large bacon burger, which was wonderful. I also order rice and gumbo there. It was also tasteful. The manager gave me a free cap and my family some free shirts when we had the opportunity to meet him. Since it was our first time at the restaurant, our server was excellent and patient while going over the entire menu. Whenever we come back to Long Beach, we will eat here again.

author: Zan Lee
review_text:
Wow today was honestly one of the best breakfasts that I’ve had all year. I drove down from West LA specifically for this location and feel it was more than worth the drive. This breakfast restaurant is a south eastern fusion and is honestly terrific. I enjoyed breakfast so much that I want to come for dinner. I would not classify it as a diner, more of an elevated breakfast restaurant. Inside is quite large and they have indoor and outdoor seating. They have a small free parking lot in the back otherwise neighborhood parking is pretty easy to find. The menu is not very large, but it has a lot of great options on it. They have some unique takes on some classic dishes and it was refreshing to try something new. Our server was really polite and everything that we ordered arrived pretty fast.

To start I ordered a Tres Leche Latte and thought it was fantastic. It was the perfect level of sweetness and had a great flavor. For my meal I chose the Up Country Benedict which was extremely unique because one of them was shrimp and grits, and the other was a smoked pork croquette that tasted like a crab cake. It was the first time I’ve ever had a shrimp Benedict and I honestly loved it because the shrimp was marinated and cooked, and it just had great flavor. Finally for dessert we finished off with the Beignets and really enjoyed them. They are basically oval shaped not the traditional square shaped, but they serve it with the most amazing strawberry jam on the side. You can tell it’s homemade. We also ordered Biscuits for the table and I thought they were some of the best buttermilk biscuits that I’ve had in a very long time. I would go here specifically for those biscuits alone. Overall, a fantastic meal and I will definitely be back soon even though I don’t live in the area.

author: Bev Lazo
review_text: Love The Attic and their Southern Nights $55 CHEF PRIX FIXE menu. A delicious evening with the family!  Food was amazing , service was great, and ambience was nice.  Next up , Brunch!

author: Jasmin Hussain
review_text: This is one of Long Beach favorites and I have not tried it for the longest... I finally went to one of their Happy Hours! The great thing is that they have Happy Hour every day, even on the weekend. Their drinks especially the Espresso Martini are great and even better with happy hour prices! We tried the fries which are thin and crispy. They got spacious bar, indoor, and outdoor seating.

author: Peter
review_text: The food had us disappointed, we ordered the chicken sandwich and it really wasn't very special and we were hoping it would have been better.  The waffle and chicken were also ordered and once again left disappointed. The chicken was the same style and flavor in both dishes.  The OIL is DIRTY and OLD that they used for the fried chicken. The French fries were also cooked, most likely with the same dirty and old oil. As seen in the photos, you can see dark breading results from the oil as well on the fries in the photo. I'm not sure if we came on  a bad day, and the oil was old from the 4th.  The service was great, at getting the oder at first, then it became hunt for table services. We normally don't write complaints, but today was a disappointment as we heard about The Attic from an Instagram favorite who posted on the Attic.

author: Leese Sheesh
review_text: I had one of my top 3 worst experiences as a customer at this location, and I do not saythag lightly. As soon as I walked in, I urgently needed to use the restroom, so I wanted to do that first, has people in front of me were still ordering anyways. The employees would literally not allow me to place my order after using the restroom; they refused to give me the code until I waited for my turn and then chose and paid for my order. I was already extremely unimpressed at how they were interacting with me, specifically as a customer. You would think it would end there, wouldn't you? WRONG. As I am in the process of using the songle person restroom, I had to deal with multiple knocks on the bathroom door. Finally I pick my head out, and told him I needed to still wash my hands, Ingrid rudely informed me that I had a strict 5 minute time limit for doing all my business in the bathroom!!! On top of being grossly unprofessional, I was so uncomfortable and perturbed are there multiple interruptions during this whole ordeal. The other employees then stated it was because of other customers need to use the restroom, but I sat in the restaurant for another 10 minutes after I got out and not a single person went in after me. Dishinesty can be added to the list of tbings I was forced to endure as a PAYING customer. Just overall gross, cheap, and unsophisticated behavior from all of the female workers behind the counter. If I go to rate this zero out of 5 stars, I would gladly do so, and it would be whole accurate. Honestly, just overall shame play treated me, from their tone to their explanations to their complete lack of sympathy and social/business etiquette. Do better, because honestly you couldn't do much worse. 👎👎👎

author: Lone wolf
review_text: I went to this place because I was in a hurry to get something to eat fast but I ended up paying for a simple sandwich without any vegetables just meat and cheese. $19 for a very simple sandwich meal come on. Just go to mcdonalds cheaper and better.  Never coming back again

author: Antwon Waters
review_text: The food was absolutely delicious and the service was impeccable. I will definitely be coming back soon.

author: Victor
review_text:
Ordered the Togo's #33 Triple Dip (1/2 lb. of hot roast beef, turkey & pastrami with provolone. Includes hot au jus) via Grubhub takeout and was quite impressed.

While the place was busy during the weekday lunch rush, it only took about 10-15 min to get my food after placing my order. The half pound of meat is substantial and delicious and the bread and meats combined with the au jus made for a super satisfying meal. The indoor/outdoor seating area isn't the most comfortable but it got the job done. No Wi-Fi but was able to hotspot my laptop to watch a video while enjoying lunch. Decent amount of seating that even during peak times there was enough for everyone to get their own table. Most were taking the food to-go.

author: shannon filson
review_text: Togo's always hits the spot, although they seem pretty crazy expensive these days. A half a salad is $10! I used to get the half salad, half sandwich combo which was perfect amount of food. Now you can get a half salad and a mini sandwich, on the mini sandwich you can only have one meat unless it's the Italian.

author: Greg Mitchell
review_text: Very limited options for vegetarians. The veggie and cheese sandwich I had made for me was only so so.

author: Gabriel DeRose
review_text: The ladies in here were so friendly.  I ordered a Mediterranean Chicken Wrap.  It was great.  Thanks.

author: Bernabe rramirez
review_text: Very good the servicio Rosario help us  to get our sandwiches .  We recommend

author: Deb B
review_text: Drove in from Berkeley, stop by Togo for lunch but Really had to use the bathroom Very badly. I was told that I had to purchase something first , even in my dyer state, before I could use the bathroom . I have purchased many many sandwich trays for work presentations for many years from this location. Needless to say, I have never felt so humiliated in my life!!! Very very awful feeling especially to have gone to the bathroom on yourself!!!! Of course I couldn’t dine or take out as I was so embarrassed!

author: teeku mulu
review_text: Very delicious sandwiches at this location. Friendly staff as well. 10 stars 🌟 🤩

author: Vikram Makol
review_text: Amazing sandwiches at this location. I drive 10 miles to get sandwiches from here.

author: P Hamilton
review_text: Closest location to work!! So it was busy, but served quickly. Food was great!!

author: Chelle T
review_text: Just had a half salad. It was a basic Iceburg lettuce with carrots but it was refreshing. Next time I may try a sandwich. I placed an order and within 5 minutes I was paying and ate on outside tables. Service is nice and efficient.

author: Althea Elaine Jaug
review_text: I go to this location a lot and usually do mobile order here. The customer service is always nice/helpful and the food is always fresh. This location is also very clean.

author: Norma Correa
review_text: For me it's a great treat I love pastrami sandwich no one has like them. especially when you had good results at another place this my treat for the day .

author: Tiana
review_text: I came in around 6pm. The store was pretty empty. Both workers helped my friends right away. The sandwich was nice. The restaurant clean and the workers friendly. 👌🏽

author: Ed Murphy
review_text: Great sandwiches! Love this location, super clean and very friendly staff!

author: A Holn
review_text: Pittsburgh if you're hungry and you want Togo's I suggest you go to Costco and buy a hot dog. Food was lacking hardly any meat on their sandwiches anymore.

author: Scott Davis
review_text: Great food and service, but I'm pretty sure I lost my wallet hear and it was never found so not all great.

author: Robert Llc
review_text: PLS BE AWARE OF THIS TOGOS, THE WHOLE ORDER WAS WRONG AND MESSED UP, THE CASHIER OVERCHARGED US, $5.00 FOR CHIPS?? WOW, THE STAFF IS VERY RUDE AND ARGUMENTATIVE! NEVER GOING BACK TO THIS LOCATION. DISHONEST AND UNEDUCATED STAFF!!

author: Kevin Drost
review_text:
San Pedro Square Market is a really cool indoor market with plenty of outdoor seating as well. It’s made up of three different buildings, all packed with a wide variety of food vendors and bars, so there’s truly something for everyone here.

I had to try the Hella Good Burger, and it definitely lived up to the name. The burger was very well seasoned, super juicy, and served on a soft potato bun that was honestly one of the best parts. It was a little messy, but in the best way — overall a really hella good burger.

We also shared a margarita pizza from Pizza Bocca Lupo. The pizza was excellent: the sauce had great flavor and the crust was even better, perfectly cooked with a nice texture.

Overall, this is a fun spot with tons of food options and a great atmosphere. Definitely a place you can come back to multiple times and try something new each visit. I’ll for sure be back to try more.

author: buyushay
review_text:
San Pedro Square Market in San Jose is the kind of place that grabs you by the senses the moment you step in and refuses to let go until you leave pleasantly overfed and a little dazzled. It’s a lively crossroads of aromas, colors, and clinking glasses—a pocket-sized festival happening every day of the week.

The variety of food alone feels like someone spun a globe, pointed blindly, and said, “Yeah, let’s serve all of that.” Want tacos? You’ll find tortillas puffing on the griddle and salsas bright enough to wake the sleepiest taste buds. Craving pizza? There’s dough spinning through the air like a mini–Cirque du Soleil performance. Fish and chips? Crispy, golden, and steaming like it came straight out of an English seaside fryer. Indian food? Spices bloom from those stalls—cumin, cardamom, chili—each one whispering promises of comfort and fire. And when you need to cool down, reset, or just enjoy the energy of the place, there’s always a bar waiting with something cold, smooth, or sparkling.

Despite the crowds, seating never feels like a battlefield. There’s ample room to settle in—inside, outside, tucked into corners, or right out in the open where you can people-watch to your heart’s content. Families, couples, tech workers, the pre-show crowd, the post-work crowd—they all blend into one big, cheerful urban hum.

Everything was excellent. San Pedro Square Market isn’t just a place to eat—it’s a place to graze, wander, sip, and soak in the good life for an hour or an afternoon. A colorful little oasis in downtown San Jose that delivers every time.

author: Aravind R
review_text: Nice place to visit and hang out while at downtown. Variety of food choices, plenty of seating including outdoors, a bit noisy atmosphere but the vibe is awesome. Parking across the street at the garage .

author: Subhankar Das
review_text: San Pedro Market Square is always buzzing with life — a vibrant mix of locals, travelers, music, and color. With tons of great food choices and stalls to explore, it’s easy to lose track of time. The blend of indoor and outdoor spaces makes it the perfect spot to wander, eat, and soak in the atmosphere.

author: Steven Cheng
review_text:
It’s a good concept with many choices but the food is mediocre at best! But good beer selection for sure!

The fish and chips are okay. The calamari is terrible， chicken burgers also bad, but hamburger is better!

They even have a band playing on the Wednesday night, that’s impressive but makes regular conversation almost impossible.

Lots seating between indoor and outdoor area. There are gas heaters available at the outside area that you can turn it on at you discretion!

One other good thing is they have vary clean restrooms!

author: Paramveer Singh
review_text: Amazing place overall and a must visit when in San Jose. They have a lot of places and small restaurants. I really loved the Indian restaurant and the small tarts and gelato ice cream. Must visit with your friends!

author: Mika'ele Keni'
review_text: Great place to hang out and enjoy a variety of different cuisines, desserts and drinks. Can't forget about the live music as well

author: Teri Nardello
review_text:
Can someone please sell a salad?!  Or better yet, open a salad restaurant.   Everything is deep fried and greasy and a person can only eat so much pasta or pizza.

And maybe a breakfast spot with actual egg dishes.  If nobody wants to open early, maybe a current vendor could put an all-day breakfast on their menu.  Eggs are cheap and people love hash browns and toast.  So simple.

Out of the more than a dozen restaurants, there is nothing healthy.  I've heard out-of-town people comment on it too.  They have the courthouse crowd as a captive audience - people should not have to drive to get a decent meal.

It saddens me because I eat there multiple times a week because I work at the courthouse, and I am constantly struggling to decide.   It's worth the short walk to Nick the Greek's to get a gyro bowl, which at least has lettuce and tomatoes.  I wish they would open a MIXT or Sweet Greens or something similar.

author: Randy
review_text: Beer selection is very good, with multiple bars with large selection of taps.  Various food options, all quite good.  Outside garden area is very well done, with live music.  As long as it doesn't get too crowded, this is a great place to have a few and enjoy the  ambiance.

author: Daryl Marcelo
review_text:
If you're looking for a vibrant and diverse culinary experience in San Jose, look no further than San Pedro Square Market! This bustling marketplace offers a fantastic selection of food vendors, each serving up delicious and unique dishes to satisfy every craving. From savory empanadas and flavorful tacos to gourmet burgers and fresh seafood, there's something for everyone here.

The ambiance is equally impressive. The open-air setting creates a lively and welcoming atmosphere, perfect for gathering with friends and family. The colorful decor and live music add to the overall charm. Plus, the easy parking options nearby make it a convenient spot to visit, even on busy weekends.

author: Eleana May
review_text: I'm excited to try the food at San Pedro Square Market in San Jose, CA, which offers a wide variety of options. I recently had a spring roll with fresh vegetables, crispy chicken and shrimp that left me eager for more. My priority is seafood, and I was thrilled by the shellfish combo I tried, which included mussels and clams in a delicious soup. The seafood flavor, combined with herbs and garlic bread, was fantastic! It's a great spot for delicious, affordable food in a pleasant setting with good music and a fun atmosphere.

author: Anthony Contreras
review_text:
PROS:
* Amazing selection of food from different restaurants.
* Live music often playing outside and inside.
* Tap beer selection is vast!
* Family friendly place.
* Plenty of outdoor seating for nice weather.

CONS:
* Parking can be tough.

author: Amanda Warnars
review_text: Great place to enjoy company with friends and family! Private party in the corner was amazing! The food they provided on the buffet was delicious!!

author: Joseph Saperstein
review_text: A wonderful space for hanging out, socializing, eating, or grabbing a drink right in downtown San Jose. It felt, calm, pleasant, and lively. I also loved feeling the connection to history. We need more places like this in downtown!

author: Jared Byrne
review_text: I was in this area for one night, a (not very busy) Monday in June 2024, as a part of a work trip; and myself and a colleague stumbled on San Pedro Square Market. The market turned into a highlight of my time in this area, as the food (and service) was good, there were lots of food options (I'll have to come back and try some other vendors), the location was clean, and the entertainment (a band) was good as well. I can't speak to the comparative price of the food (I only spent one night in this area), but it seemed reasonable for a California restaurant. As noted, I had a great experience and, because I'd love to come back to the San Pedro Square Market, I would recommend this location to anyone visiting the area.

author: Alex Buchanan
review_text: Checked out San Pedro Square for the first time—definitely got that Hispanic vibe going on! Tons of energy, a bunch of restaurants, parties happening, and people just chillin’ outside with some seriously cool rides parked up.

author: Shruti Sinha
review_text:
Visited San Pedro square market on May 5th so got to witness the Cinco de Mayo festivities, live music and such vibrant atmosphere even though it was Monday evening. Lot of food options including Mexican, Indo-Nepalese and others bars for a good time.
This square has a lot of history. Got to know that San Jose was the oldest city of CA from an info placard. Reminded me of The Alamo in San Antonio.

author: Carrie Tam
review_text: Super fun location that my roommate and I stumbled upon accidentally! There’s free parking for the first 90min nearby and plenty of outdoor tables where people are willing to talk to new strangers and dance and have fun! Indoor food courts with wide range of super tasty looking options.

author: Leah Borrino
review_text:
Absolutely unacceptable treatment — I’ll never return

I used to genuinely enjoy San Pedro Square. It used to be one of my favorite casual spots in the area. But after tonight, I’m honestly shocked by how poorly we were treated.

My friends and I grabbed slices of pizza from a shop around the corner, then headed to San Pedro Square to buy beers and sit down. The moment we walked in, a security guard stopped us and said we couldn’t bring in outside food. We decided to try going to the other entrance around the block. After all, we intended to be paying customers. We weren't just going to bring in our food and not pay for something.

Except…the same security guard FOLLOWED us. Around the block. To the other entrance.

We walked inside anyway, and my husband and my friend’s boyfriend immediately got in line to purchase drinks there, but within 30 seconds, another guard approached us and told us we needed to leave. They were wearing earpieces and openly communicating about the “pizza box people” over the radios, like we were some kind of security threat instead of customers trying to buy drinks.

We were escorted out of the marketplace. Escorted. For carrying pizza slices we fully intended to eat quietly while giving this place our money.

The whole situation was bizarre, humiliating, and completely unnecessary. If San Pedro Square wants to run a cafeteria-style marketplace but act like a high-security event venue, that’s their prerogative — but they’ve lost my business for good. There are plenty of places nearby that don’t treat paying customers like criminals. I’ll gladly spend my money anywhere else from now on.

author: Joseph Thomas
review_text: Live music, good ambience and lots of food options. A great place to hang out with friends. Also there are a lot of other bars to hang around in the area outside.

author: bhanu khera
review_text: Love this brunch place! This was my second time visiting during my Bay Area trip, and I love their food. I definitely overate. I tried the veggie omelette, pancakes, and French toast. Everything was amazing except the tiramisu pancake (it was okayish; the cream on top tasted a bit too milky). But apart from that, everything was so good. Definitely recommend this place for brunch!

author: Hai
review_text:
- The beef(?) patty inside Loco Moco is overcooked and BITTER.
- Ordered Steak and Frites in medium but it came out as almost well done. This dish also took way longer than the other 3.
- Surf n turf Benedict and Shrimp and crab omelette were both good.
I think they are better in making seafood than beef?

author: Kshitij Bodhankar
review_text:
Some delicious food and a great vibe.

Def recommend going here for the classic weekend morning breakfast/brunch experience.

The coffee tastes so good and their dishes are heavy. Super warm hosts and a great place for a weekend meetup.

author: Robert Fang
review_text: Always a great experience here. Portions are big and the service is great. The quality of food is awesome and I'm never disappointed. They have a great menu with unique items and flavors. We always come back to try new things. A great brunch place though it does get very busy. Arrive early or after the rush and you'll be seated pretty quickly.

author: Kimberly Iwamoto
review_text:
Waiting time: 40 mins at Sunday morning

The menu has so many choices , I ordered Country fried steak and eggs $22 . It was very good, like the hash browns were crispy on the outside and buttery which was great, but it made me so full that I didn't have to eat dinner.

The portion is huge, I guess that's why it's so popular.
Service is fast and friendly !

author: prakhar deep
review_text:
This restaurant has firmly established itself as a popular go-to spot for brunch and breakfast, and it’s not hard to understand why. Whether you’re catching up with friends or starting your day with a hearty meal, the experience here consistently hits the mark.

One of the standout features is the portion size. The servings are generous without feeling overwhelming, offering great value for the price. The drink selection is also worth noting—whether you prefer a classic mimosa, a refreshing iced coffee, or something more creative, the bar delivers quality beverages that perfectly complement the food.

Speaking of food, the pancakes are an absolute must-try. Fluffy, golden, and served with a variety of toppings, they manage to be indulgent without being too heavy. It’s no surprise they’re a favorite among regulars.

However, the menu does have its limitations—particularly for vegan and vegetarian diners. While there are a few meat-free options, the selection is quite minimal and could benefit from more thoughtful variety. This might be a drawback for those with dietary restrictions or preferences.

Despite that, the restaurant remains a beloved choice for many. The cozy, lively atmosphere and consistent food quality make it a reliable option for those in search of a satisfying morning meal. If you’re not following a plant-based diet and enjoy classic brunch fare, this place is definitely worth a visit. For pancakes and good vibes, it’s hard to beat.

author: Ally L
review_text:
I regret looking at the menu for the purposes of this review because now I want to go again and I was planning on crossing off a few new places first.

This was the first modern brunch-exclusive place in the South Bay. Before that, there were old school places like Bill's Cafe and Stacks in various locations. Also, Country Holder's Inn. Now, even though this place has churros inside horchatas, it still supplies very hearty food. It is not like those instagrammable places that sprung up later.

The omelet, scrambles, and benedicts are amazing. They have at least 10 different types of benedicts and you can mix-n-match. I recommend the crab cake Benedict and the Neptune, which is scrambled eggs with crab and shrimp. Bit unorthodox but it's good to scramble things up, especially if you get two flavors. The New York Benedict is made with bagels if you want to switch up the bread. For the sides, I prefer the country potatoes over the hash browns here.

The sweets are fine but just too sugary for my tastes. There's an option to choose 3 types, another combo they offer. It's limited to pancakes and French toast though. As you can see in my photos, it's quite a lot. The graham cracker really adds a nice touch. I don't remember those things tasting so good. My favorite of them all is the raspberry cream cheese stuffed French toast.

I would say the last thing I have to talk about are their sandwiches. The club sandwich is so classic, comes with fries and a long pickle. The breakfast sandwich is made of grilled brioche and has hash browns, eggs, ham, bacon, cheese. It's good if you are feeling breakfast. Otherwise anything with grilled bread like the reuben or tuna melt are good options.

The service can be so slow. There was only one designated waitress working the tables when we went. Very nice lady, though. The tables may get a little sticky and the wait is long on weekends if you don't go early. Last I went was an weekday afternoon at 2:30, right before they closed at 3 and it was pretty empty. They are pretty chill and don't rush you out.

author: Jesse
review_text: Mediocre at best. Not worth the drive and can’t understand what the 5 stars is all about. The wait and maintenance of a waiting list is inadequate. There seems to be no logic behind the “list”. People were upset and frustrated with how or when names were being called. Would not return.

author: Aaliya Chyanne
review_text: We stopped in for a quick bite and we were immediately seated. The restaurant was quite busy and has a beautiful ambiance. The servers were professional and attentive. The food was pretty decent and they had a nice drink selection. Just about every dish came with eggs but they were able to sub some things out and accommodate. I would say the plate seem to be drowning in the hollandaise sauce which took away from the meal.

author: Sachin Prasad
review_text:
We had a great brunch experience here! We tried the California French Toast, Mexican Scramble (with Soyrizo instead of Chorizo), and the Cookies and Cream Pancake.

Everything was excellent, and the food presentation was impressive. I’d highly recommend the Mexican Scramble for its unique flavors, and the California French Toast is a must-try if you have a sweet tooth—the Bavarian cream really takes it to the next level.
We had to wait 45 minutes, but it was worth the wait.

author: Sandeep Kaur
review_text: This was my first time here and I absolutely loved it. The pancakes, the scramble, mimosas, and the orange juice were all 10/10. The service was great and the prices were more than reasonable.

author: Nikki A
review_text:
Located in a convenient area with easy parking, this brunch spot initially seemed promising. The spacious interior and patio provide plenty of seating, eliminating the dreaded weekend wait. The vibe is casual and welcoming, making it a pleasant spot to catch up with friends or enjoy a leisurely meal.

However, the experience fell short in several areas. The food arrived lukewarm, which detracted from what could have been a satisfying meal. While portion sizes were generous, the quality didn’t match. The French toast, a staple brunch item, was underwhelming and lacked the flavor and texture expected from such a dish.

To add to the disappointment, attention to cleanliness was lacking. My napkin had a coffee stain, suggesting it hadn't been replaced after the previous guest — a detail that's hard to overlook when dining out.

Service was adequate but not memorable. The waitress was polite, but the interaction didn’t leave a lasting impression.

In summary, while the location, space, and vibe are definite highlights, the lackluster food and overlooked details in cleanliness hold this spot back from being a top-tier brunch destination. It’s worth a visit if you’re in the area and looking for convenience, but don’t set your expectations too high.

author: melialvarez23
review_text: Food was good. We shared a hash dish. And a pancake. The pancake was just, ok. The server was really nice when I asked for almond milk with my coffee. She was charming. Tho she did not check on us much after our food arrived. We wanna go back and try the chicken and waffles. It looked amazing!

author: Nique
review_text: We typically go here for breakfast after work and it's so good. The steak and eggs are always great and I love that after a long night at work we can get a good drink and talk.

author: Tommy Pak
review_text:
🍳🥞 Breakfast Club – A Brunch Spot Worth Returning To

📍 Located at W San Carlos & Meridian

Parking is okay, but it can be a little tricky, especially on weekends when it gets busier. If street parking is full, there’s a garage behind the restaurant with extra spots, so you should still be able to find a place.

🎶☀️ First Impressions

Step inside, and you’re immediately hit with a lively crowd and a perfect brunch vibe. The music was on point—it felt like someone had grabbed our personal playlist and queued it up for the restaurant. My girlfriend and I were absolutely loving it!

🍊 A Must-Try: Fresh-Squeezed OJ

If you come here, you HAVE to order the fresh-squeezed orange juice. Since it’s January, oranges must be in season because this OJ was next-level good—a perfect balance of sweet and citrusy goodness 🍊🤤. If they had free refills, my girlfriend and I would’ve shut them down!

🍽️ Our Orders

👩‍❤️‍👨 Her Order: Country Fried Steak
✅ Portion: HUGE—and not just all breading! A thick, juicy cut, fried to crispy perfection with just the right amount of crunch.
✅ Gravy: Savory and well-seasoned, tying everything together perfectly.
