✅ Sides: Herb potatoes 🥔 (delicious) and wheat toast 🍞 (more on that later).

👨 My Order: Santa Maria Omelette
✅ Steak: Well-seasoned and cooked to medium well, just as I asked 🥩👌.
✅ Flavor Combo: Steak, cheese, salsa, sour cream, and avocado 🥑🧀—each bite packed with flavor, especially when paired with the herb potatoes.

🍞 The Only Miss? The Wheat Toast

The only thing that didn’t hit the mark was the wheat toast—it came out late and cold, making it less enjoyable. But honestly, that’s such a minor thing compared to how good everything else was.

⭐ Final Thoughts

This spot has quickly become my go-to for brunch, and I get hesitant about trying other places because I always end up comparing them to Breakfast Club 😆.

🔥 Highly recommend for any breakfast/brunch lover! If you’re in the area, this is a must-visit.

author: Mrs Persia
review_text:
I kept hearing about this place so I tried it out. I have tontry more food there, but I got a simple breakfast.  2 eggs with homemade corned beef hash and potatos.  So they charged me 9.00 for the corned beef hash and when it came it was basically potatos with a sprinkle of meat. I was expecting meat with sprinkle of potatos. Boooooo.

It's a cute place but music is so loud it's like eating at a night club. I'll have to give them another chance,  try a different meal.  My friend's burger looked pretty good.

author: Claire
review_text:
The food was very good and full of flavor! Lots of options on the menu. We waited about 45 minutes for a table on a Sunday afternoon, which is pretty expected for this place.

Unfortunately, the service did not match the quality of the food. Our server wasn’t very attentive and came across as rude. Because of this, we left a lower tip. Afterward, the server confronted us not once, but twice!! Once at the table and again as we were leaving, with a coworker. They asked us why we didn’t tip more. This felt intimidating and unwelcoming.

It’s disappointing, because the food itself was great, but the service really took away from the overall experience.

author: ESQ Fresno
review_text: Very good atmosphere ambience is great. Everybody looks happy in community. The food is amazing. Presentation is spectacular.

author: Shay Asael
review_text:
Nice place, Ok food
I drove here for 20 min !
It wasn't as good as I'd expect,
Since I don't eat Pork, I had maybe only one option, dissapointing..

author: Katrina T
review_text: I love this place!! I came on a Monday and it was a little busy, but overall the food was amazing and even though I found a few things that shouldn’t have been in my food and water I gave them the benefit of the doubt and asked our server to get us new waters and food because i know these things are accidents. But the waffle was yummy and the food was great! I recommend getting the hash browns instead of potatoes, I wasn’t a big fan.

author: طارق بن عزيز
review_text:
I liked the atmosphere of this café and its location is nice. However, the presentation lacked attention to detail. The espresso was served without a spoon, and the sparkling water came in a paper cup. I also came specifically for the affogato and was surprised to find out they no longer offer it.

That said, the staff were wonderful. I especially appreciated the barista who prepared my second drink — she took care with the latte art after noticing I pay attention to details, even though she mentioned it would be more difficult with oat milk instead of regular milk.

Despite the presentation issue, I will definitely come back. It’s still worth revisiting.

author: Rebecca Schiappa
review_text: Boosting the stars on this place — they deserve more! Service was quick and friendly. Super cute ambiance, great vibes on a Saturday morning. :) I had the spinach feta pastry (simple and delicious) and my partner had the GF rose pistachio cake… yum! Such a uniquely  flavored treat for breakfast. The baristas clearly know what they’re doing; my cappuccino was perfectly crafted and the Gesha pour over was *muah* chefs kiss!

author: Ben D
review_text:
I came here to meet up with a friend, and it turned out to be a great spot. The place is cozy and everything feels well thought out.

We asked the staff for a recommendation and tried the charcoal coffee. It was rich, not too sweet, and really smooth. The flavor was unique and easy to enjoy. The staff were super friendly and helpful, which made the experience even better.

I also tried matcha granola for the first time in my life. I had it hot, and it was surprisingly good. Warm, earthy, and just the right texture. They also have a lot of beautifully presented pastries, and I asked for something not too sweet just the right balance.

There are other light breakfast options too, like wakota toast and some vegan dishes, which all tasted great and felt healthy.

The only downside is that it gets really crowded on weekends. We had to wait quite a while for a seat, and after we sat down, others were already waiting for our table. There’s a good amount of seating quiet corners for working, a central area, and a little outdoor patio but still, weekends are busy.

It was also a bit noisy outside because of a bunch of motorcyclists riding through the usually quiet town. Definitely not the café’s fault, just one of those “welcome to America” moments.

It’s a such cool and chill place for coffee, conversation, working, or just having some time alone.

author: Liam
review_text: Giving this place extra stars because it truly deserves them. The service was fast and genuinely friendly, and the space itself is adorable with great Saturday-morning vibes. I ordered the spinach feta pastry—simple, warm, and really tasty—while my partner tried the gluten-free rose pistachio cake, which was such a unique and delicious breakfast treat. You can tell the baristas are skilled pros: my cappuccino was perfectly balanced, and the Gesha pour-over was flawless. Total chef’s kiss. ☕✨

author: Sohail Mohammed
review_text: Wonderful start to my day. One of the more elegant and relaxing cafes in the bay. Cappuccino hit the spot. First time tasting a charcoal latte. It was surprisingly tasty and gorgeous looking. Will be sure to visit again.

author: turev acar
review_text:
Great coffee and snack options.  Recommending charcoal coffee and other coffee specialities. An ideal place to work and enjoy coffee at the same time.

Not too many food options.

author: Mike Mu
review_text:
Handcrafted drinks in a nice setting with plenty of seats and tables.  You also get to drink out of one-of-a-kind pieces of cups made by Sue.  Internet is slow, but that's probably Comcast's fault.

I enjoyed my charcoal ube.

It was a bit warm inside (we sat at gallery side, as it was busy).

Great place to do bit of reading, some work, or have a pastry.  Sold out of croissants when we got here on the weekend.

author: Anna
review_text:
There is so much work space here, it is almost unbelievable.

Charcoal latte was unique but gritty, although I should’ve completely expected it. I got it with a shot of espresso that didn’t really taste super strongly, but it does come free of charge with this drink if you want it. Their offerings lean a little more expensive and it is a bit diabolical to charge for whole milk…

The other drinks and food both look delicious and there is plenty of street parking nearby, as well as a couple of lots.

author: Anna Maro
review_text:
I’m going to just say it: I had the best cup of black coffee here.
The best cup of coffee I’ve ever had in the US.
Do whatever you want with this info, but I know the ball, so it’s safe to trust me.

author: Jess Liu
review_text: Very nice coffee place! I tried their cold brew and ice latte, both tasted great!

author: danbi byun
review_text: I absolutely loved my visit to Sue’s Cafe! I ordered the charcoal latte and strawberry shortcake! Both were amazing. The latte had the perfect balance of nutty and sweet flavors without being overpowering, and the cake was incredibly soft and delicious. The staff were so kind and welcoming, and the peaceful, calming atmosphere made the experience even more enjoyable. Can’t wait to come back!🌱☕️

author: Josh
review_text:
Very good location but very expensive. Coffee and cheesecake and tip is $20. Limited parking spot. Pumpkin latte is visually good but not hot enough right after served and disappointed.

Request to warm coffee and owner served with remade hot latte. Satisfied.

It would be wonderful if they serve filtered water, instead of tap water. It smells chlorine on water.

author: Minh Ngo
review_text: This place is surprisingly cozy and fancy. It’s like a combination of a gallery and also a coffee shop at the same time. I would definitely recommend this place for dating. The drink is good too. The hojicha latte has a distinctive taste.

author: Srik Kath
review_text: Meeting a colleague in a good setting. This cafe rocks it. Coffee cups were unique in a way and my Americano just had enough caffeine. Wonderful setting with fall foliage outside. The cheesecake was a decent accompaniment for the coffee. Enjoyed the coffee only to realise that there was no picture.

author: Meghan Knight
review_text: This is a cute little coffee spot but the customer service could use some work. It was super busy when I went and I definitely felt rushed to order and they still messed up my drink. The avocado toast wasn’t very good but I did try it at 9am and a strong tomato pesto that early just is not the move and for the price I just felt disappointed. Their raspberry donuts were pretty good though!

author: Vincent Tang
review_text:
It's a nice cafe to study at with the basics--coffee and snacks. Well kept space, just okay food.

We ordered the toast with spread, earl gray milk jam, and yuzu marmalade. For drinks, I got the cold brew. The cold brew felt like 75% crushed ice and some coffee. If you order x2 toast it's essentially 5$ per toast. The flavors for the spread were muted, nothing really stood out for me or popped out. It might be good if you are looking for a light flavor.

This place is a good spot for the scenery and maintenance, but I wouldn't go here to eat.

author: Grace Zhang
review_text: came here on a weekend morning and ordered the mascarpone toast, cold brew, and latte. everything was a little pricey but delicious, and the gallery space and outdoor seating were both lovely as well. was wonderful to stop by after driving down skyline.

author: Galina
review_text: It is one of the best coffee shops ☕️ around Saratoga. The espresso served with sparkling water to allow you to experience the coffee in the purest of flavors. By drinking sparkling water prior to drinking your cup of coffee, you cleanse your taste receptors before the first sip of coffee, and you can fully appreciate the flavors. It's very busy on the weekend morning.

author: Aneesh Dalvi
review_text: Great place to get some work done especially when it is quiet during the day or early in the morning. The iced latte and matcha latte are very good. Wifi is weak, but everything else is great.

author: Ann Koppuzha
review_text: One of my favorite hidden gem cafes. Love the space. The drinks are great. I also loved the pastries. The avocado toast and ham sandwich are a little overpriced but tasty.

author: Viale M
review_text:
Our experience at this dumpling house was a mix of practical positives and some notable drawbacks.

On the plus side, the dumplings are decent, and the prices are fair. The steady stream of delivery drivers in motorcycle helmets suggests its main business is takeout. For walk-in customers like us, this meant there was no wait and plenty of available seating, which was a convenience.

However, the physical space could use some attention; it felt a bit shabby and worn. A more significant issue for us was the menu's lack of vegetarian main courses. Aside from a few appetizers, there were very limited options for anyone in our party who was vegetarian, making it a difficult choice for a group with mixed dietary needs.

In summary, this is a functional spot for a quick, affordable meal of decent dumplings, especially if you're dining in and want to avoid a wait. However, the shabby interior and the near-total lack of vegetarian entrees make it difficult to recommend for group dining or for those seeking a more polished experience.

As ordinary consumers, we are not paid or compensated in any way for this review. We offer this feedback to help other diners make an informed choice.

author: mellie settie
review_text:
Only the Dan Dan noodle was good.
Dumpling is better at all other dumpling time and dumpling kitchen chains. Do not order the shrimp scallop mostly Flour and no shrimp taste the scallop is also the one that's supposed to be dried for rice dish. The specialty Fried dumpling also too dry. All just too thick and dry. They also do not care about quality when I reported the shrimp. Other chain that has similar good quality Hayes, Fillmore, Noe (nearest to this Castro) and the Design district. Not comfy people too loud. Other Chain also lots of people and loud but within social standard

author: Oksana Maister
review_text: My new favorite spot in SF! 🍜 Cozy vibes, super friendly staff who make you feel instantly welcome, and some of the tastiest dumplings and noodles around. Great prices, flavorful drinks, and they also offer takeaway—perfect when you want their delicious food at home. A true neighborhood treasure!

author: francis montgomery
review_text:
It was cold and we found soup. Won ton soup with delicious won tons and baby bok choy that was vibrant while tender...so tender. The broth was light, not salty.
We also enjoyed soup dumplings that were so fresh, hot, and tasty, the black vinegar with slivers of ginger. As well as the won tons in chili sauce (yes, please...to embarrassed to order second serving) Salt and Pepper chicken wangs with light coating that remained crispy. Oh, the marinaded cucumbers were a fresh, delicious and seasoned with a nice Chile.
The price of some dishes were only $12.50, while others were $9.95 cucumbers were $6.50.
We are willing to take MUNI in order to avoid looking for parking. F-LINE here we come.

author: Anna
review_text:
I saw this spot on TikTok and made the drive into the city to try it out; what a disappointment. At prime lunch hour, we were the only ones seated, which should have been the first red flag.
Service was attentive and friendly, but unfortunately the food just didn’t deliver. We ordered the pan-fried dumplings, pork xiao long bao, shrimp gyozas, and scallion pancakes. All of it was just…meh. I’ve had far better at dumpling restaurants in the East Bay for a fraction of the effort.
Overall, not worth the hype or the drive.

author: K B S S
review_text:
On my ‘must-go-back-sooner-than-later’ list!
YUMMY - delicate - flavors well developed

Very professional and friendly staff, mellow atmosphere for quite a busy spot.

Decoration and (silent) tv on Chinese cooking channel making one appreciate even more the talent it takes to produce such tasty bites.
It feels as though the kitchen is cooking per order rather than batch cooking as in most other dim sum places.

Comments on the dishes I ordered as captions per photo.

Truth be told: I had just gone for dim sum at a very popular and celebrated restaurant in a SF nearby city and left curiously unsatisfied compared to my previous time there.

author: Gunjan Karamchandani
review_text: Veggie potstickers and scallion pancakes were too oily :/ scallion pancakes were soggy. Mango pudding was ok. Spinach dumplings were also ok

author: Todd Luoma
review_text: Another excellent choice in the Castro District.  I had a variety of dumplings.   My favorite was the pork/shrimp dumplings.  The wait staff was very helpful.  I even had the opportunity to practice some Chinese Mandarin language.   I highly recommend the Dumpling House!

author: G Santana
review_text: Ok food, dumplings above average, noodles soups recommended for sharing n the chrysanthemum tea was great.. recommend tor try if you are in the area

author: Lynn Friedman
review_text:
I really love this family run business. The dumplings are made to order, and the staff is friendly & helpful, will take the time to help you order if you can't deal with the QR code system. Love love love the Crystal Shrimp Dumplings. Other favs are the chili oil wontons and the cucumber salad. Actually, anything with chili oil is delicious. There's sriracha & soy sauce on the table. Beware, they close for a stretch between lunch and dinner, except for the weekend, so mind their hours.
On a nice day I do takeout & eat in nearby Dolores Park.
100% recommend

author: Andrew Wang
review_text:
One of our local favorites for dim sum specialties. The dumplings are, of course, the star attraction, but I also really enjoy the wonton soup, garlic green beans, and fried chicken wings. Also very kid friendly, my toddler loves going here and watching the Chinese cooking show they have playing on the TVs.

If you're around for the lunch special (dine in only), it's also a great deal!

author: Joost Mi-Maltha
review_text: I visited the Dumpling House based on the reviews here. I was disappointed by the whole experience to be honest. I found the dishes rather bland and I definitely had better elsewhere. You can order with your phone using the QR code on the table which is convenient. Service is quick. Atmosphere is so so.

author: Ethan Guinn
review_text:
Amazing dumplings, skillfully folded and cooked. Fresh flavors including the shrimp. Introverts dream since you order on your phone from start to finish. But hard to eat all the food without friends with you. Best bbq pork steam bun ever :)

Simple establishment , simple eats. Done right.

author: 5679 W
review_text: very good restaurant. Super authentic shengjianbao and dumplings

author: Daniel R
review_text:
The Dumpling House is a great restaurant to eat dumplings. I have visited many times and always love to eat there.
Sometimes it gets busy, but the service is usually fast.
Personally, I do not like that they do not have printed menus and you can only order on your phone.
Highly recommended.

author: Caleb Rose
review_text:
My girlfriend and I loved our experience at Dumpling House. The fact that ordering food from the web app is fantastic - especially since everyone at a table can add food to the order from their own phones with the given QR code.

There was only one person working all the tables; but given that orders were placed through the web app, this allowed them to serve all tables while orders were placed. The server went above and beyond in terms of making sure our glasses were always full, that we had time to look at the menu, and check in to see how we enjoyed our food. She was friendly, kind, and didn’t hover when we made our order through the app.

When we got our food, it arrived quick, and in a manner that allowed us to try each dish. Each dish we ordered from the pork dumplings to the fried wontons were amazing and straight from the kitchen.

The next time we’re back in San Francisco, we’re coming back here. The ambiance was quiet with calm music, perfect for talking in a group setting. We loved the food, we loved the service, this is my favorite lunch place in the Bay Area.

author: Patricia Cordero Perez
review_text: This is one of those places you never forget. The flavors are truly unique and unforgettable. Totally recommended, one of the best quality-to-price experiences you can find in San Francisco.

author: Amy Cebada
review_text:
The food here was amazing and service was quick and friendly. Ordering was easy using QR codes set on the table. We had their cucumber salad, soup dumplings in the regular and spicy varieties, the leek and shrimp dumplings, wings, and bbq pork bao. Everything was scrumptious.

This establishment has an unpretentious feel—authentic, and likely a local's favorite. We were recommended to visit by some locals we met at Black Hammer Brewing, another local gem. 10/10 would recommend.

author: Mark Menensez
review_text: Dumpling house is one of many dim sum restaurants here in San Fransisco but to me, and a lot of people, highly regarded as one of if not the best in the city. Not only is it easy on your wallet but the food was so delicious and comforting. Biting into some of the food felt like being a baby cradled by your mother with a blanket on a cold day. It was seriously all so delicious but my favorite dishes were the chicken wings and the bbq pork bun. I cannot describe how good those wings were but I sadly didn’t take a picture but please, take my word for it, it’s worth every single penny.

author: Jared Z.
review_text: I’m from SuZhou, and I think in terms of taste and price this place would be pretty hard to beat anywhere in California. Definitely worth a try and I recommend the half fried juicy pork bao (生煎包）.

author: Michael Fisher
review_text: I adore this place for its all day breakfast. The atmosphere feels warm and welcoming, and Melody made my visit even nicer with her wonderful service. My meal was amazing. I ordered the veggie scramble and it was so filling that I could not try the cornmeal pancakes, even though they looked fantastic. I already know that on my next visit I am definitely going to try them.

author: Brandon Brabender
review_text:
Such a great find! Out of all the places you could grab lunch in San Francisco, I’m sure glad we stumbled upon Kate’s Kitchen.

Highly recommend!

author: Isabeau Terlouw
review_text: The food was very tasty and the staff was super friendly! While we stayed in San Francisco we have had breakfast at Kate”s Kitchen twice. The coffee and food was great. They also gave us blueberry pancakes and Hush puppies to try. Definitely would recommend, it made our stay even more great! Greetings from the Netherlands :)

author: Chef Tony
review_text:
I've been wanting to try this place. Well, no surprise, I was disappointed. I understand busy and wanting to turn tables, but there is this thing called customer service, rather than watch your customers and ask if they are finished, ask them how thier meal is or if they need anything. I really like being asked how my meal is or if I need anything.
With that said, the food was good, DO NOT order a Cappuccino from them. That was really my only problem. The waitress was nice and took it off, Reason why I left a good tip.

author: Regan Donecker
review_text: Nice breakfast/brunch spot. Attentive service and plenty of coffee refills. Delicious omelette of the day and American breakfast. Feels like a typical cozy east coast cafe with classic American dishes!

author: Angela Wright Baumsteiger
review_text: Absolutely delicious veggie breakfast scramble. Fresh squeezed OJ in the mimosas. Many veggie and gluten free options. Excellent service. No wait on a Saturday. Great mimosas prices.

author: Wissam G. Azar
review_text:
If you’re looking for that home made breakfast place in San Francisco, then this would be the place for you.
The food looks like it’s coming out of your kitchen, no fancy style, just good food.
I went for the big guy’s breakfast, definitely needs a big guy, a two butter pancake short stack, 2 sunny side up eggs, a flat sausage, bacon and some fries, I will give that a 4/5.
The cappuccino was really good, very well presented and deserves a photo of its own 😁.
Home made coffee and fresh orange juice (pulp included) compliments it all. Enjoy 👍

author: Claire Bonnepart
review_text: This place is clean, staff are friendly and the food was tasty! Gluten free bread and vegan options available. I ordered the tofu scramble and added a side of chicken apple sausage ($7) a bit pricey .. but I’d definitely go back to hang out in the outdoor patio area for brunch again.

author: Lin Flores
review_text: I literally cannot believe the ratings for this joint aren’t higher! The food was flawless and the best meal I ate while visiting San Fran! We ordered hush puppies to share and they were divine, so thickly breaded and delicious. I had a latte with oat milk and it was actually the best latte I had while there.

author: Danice M
review_text: The best ever coffee.... We all loved our coffee and hush puppies.  The vibe, staff are amazing.  We felt right at home and are excited to stop in the have breakfast on our next family outing.  Brother Cran and sister Claudia are the best, they know all the amazing places - Photos to follow... Thank yuou!

author: Lizabeth Walsh
review_text: I was able to walk in and sit at a 2-top alone, just before the real Sunday brunch rush began. Delicious chicken apple sausage, split and browned perfectly. Gluten-free options made choosing a dish delightfully difficult, but I finally settled on the French toast, which came beautifully topped with a banana, strawberry, blueberry mix. Hot coffee, plenty of it, brewed fresh often was the perfect accompaniment. My neighbors ordered the hush puppies, and I longed for the days of eating gluten when their bowlful was delivered. I will certainly return on my next trip, and I'll likely repeat the walk up the hilly part of Haight to Ashbury to burn off a few of the happy calories I'll take in then, too.

author: Bali Nelson
review_text: I had a lovely brunch with a former colleague today and really enjoyed the veggie scramble. We talked at length with the charming long-time owner and had a great experience at this quaint place.

author: emir akdere
review_text: Charming institution with amazing owners, servers, and food! Coming here every sunday with my boyfriend is one the highlights of my life in san francisco. There is so much soul and livedness packed into this space, and it awaits you to make it a part of your life story!

author: Bob Ortega
review_text:
I've been going to Kate's Kitchen since late 90's.  I was always a big fan.  After Covid, I noticed the quality and quantity had decreased, but that was to be expected.  I was happy that they survived post-Covid downturn, while many small businesses did not.

However, last time we were there, I wanted to give the owner some friendly advise, which was to take the word "thick-sliced" bacon off of the menu as I the bacon was no longer thick-sliced.  I told him it was still good, but I knew that he might save himself some grief over customer complaints, just by removing that word from the menu.

Instead, the owner went on a loud tirade about how "he doesn't need us" and he is retiring in 2 years.  Very disappointing, and I will never go back.

author: Julio Gonzalez
review_text: one of my favorite brunch spots in the lower haight. every time i go here i order the steak and eggs 🍳

author: Frontier Cookers
review_text: Their staple food items are great! Service is good wish they would tell you there is a surge charge on bill. Atmosphere is small and cozy parking is is a task.

author: Jubal Engelhard
review_text:
Really nice folks working here 🤗
The Flannel Hash is my all time favourite 😋 and the HUGE wall art piece is mesmerizing 🤠

author: Davide Bigoni
review_text: This IS the place for breakfast in San Francisco . Worth standing in the queue for such amazing delicious food

author: Ron Vega
review_text: The food was delicious. Some of the lightest, fluffiest, and delicious pumpkin pancakes. Everything we ate was so good. Can't wait to go back. The staff was super sweet and nice 👍🏽🙂

author: Christina McGold (Christie)
review_text:
I have been coming here since 1994. Im great friends with the owner, Hasan! I'm a big fan of a few specific dishes here.
A Grate Salad, add Fried Chicken.
M&M sandwich
No bread.
Homemade sausage patty, side of red beans, side of smoked bacon collard greens. Thats a full meal.

author: Mike G
review_text: Incredible ceviche, probably the best I’ve had in the US, and with very generous portions. Make sure to ask for spicy sauce — really brings the food to the next level. This place is a rare find of delicious authentic cooking, large portions, and very reasonable prices. Will definitely be coming back soon to try the rest of the menu.

author: H Lib
review_text: My family and I have been coming here for years and we love the food, especially the  Lomo Saltado and Ceviche. The lomo is tasty with lots of sauce that I like to mix with the rice. The portion is generous and reasonably priced. The fish in the ceviche is fresh and the sauce perfectly complements the dish. The owner is friendly and the service is great. I highly recommend this restaurant for excellent Peruvian cuisine.

author: Mayra Deleon
review_text: This place was recommended by a coworker and since we were in town we decided to give it a try. I am glad we decided to give it a try because it did not disappoint. The workers were amazing and welcoming. The restaurant was clean and the decor was nice. Parking was a bit difficult to find, but we expected this from San Francisco. The bread and sauce given at the beginning were delicious. I could not get enough and wanted more. The Lomo saltado needed a bit more seasoning, but it was still good. The pescado sudado was very good that I finished it all. The portions were great and I would be definitely be coming back when in the area.

author: Charlotte Cabezas
review_text: Always hits the spot. I love that they serve such generous servings and the service is always kind.

author: Alvar Marin
review_text: The food was exquisite. I’m Peruvian, I’ve been in the US for more than 8 years and this is by far the best Peruvian place I’ve been to in the US. Really glad I ran into this place. The waiter was very attentive and kind too!

author: Bri D
review_text: Absolutely disgusting, a disgrace to Peruvian food. Ceviche was just lemon water on fish, Conchas a la Chalaca were absolutely horrible. Not flavor at all. If you are looking for a real peruvian restaurant this isn't it! Customer service is great but food is horrible

author: Michelle V
review_text: One of my favorite Peruvian restaurants. I was given the wrong order today and was disappointed in my meal. Not because it was bad- but its when you think you're getting one thing but you get something else. Guy told me I ordered Lomo saltado, even though I ordered the Lomo a lo pobre. They did offer to give me what I actually intended on getting after the clarification but I didn't want to inconvenience the kitchen. The sangria was good.

author: Matthew Gudenius
review_text:
Nice little unpretentious, unassuming little spot with good food! Popped in here because we were craving Peruvian food and waiting for a concert across the street at The Knockout.

The prices are a little high (like most places these days) and we weren't super hungry, so we shared a ceviche de pescado (I believe it was red snapper) and some fried plantains. Both were quite good, and the server was friendly, and brought us additional bread and plantain chips. It was a nice and relaxed, casual experience with fresh food and no nonsense.

author: Rodrigo Sanchez
review_text: Horrible! I ordered the tallarines verdes with "meat" and they gave me some mcdonald's looking meat. The food had absolutely no peruvian taste. Also, they WILL try to steal some money with tips or taxes. The lady at the front changed our price from $80 to $65 because we noticed they over charged us. If you come to this place you will waste your trip. No vengan!!!!!!!!!!!!!

author: Jairo Sanchez
review_text: We dined at this peruvian restaurant as a family with the hopes it would reflect the culinary excellence my country of origin provides for this wonderful city. Unfortunately, the experience left much to be desired. The so called food, lacked the authenticity and the flavors and freshness we were expecting as peruvian people with much background in this culinarily realm. Several dishes were bland and underwhelming. To make matters worse, we noticed discrepancies in our bill, a 25% CHARGE ON TAXES... unjustifiable, treachery at its finest, especially for the regulars that come around this establishment. We value supporting peruvian establishments, but this was a straightforward let down. I genuinely hope they take feedback from my comment here today, and improve their ethics, quality, and their integrity of their billing practices specifically.

author: Jonathan Villeda
review_text: The service was friendly and attentive, but unfortunately the food didn’t live up to expectations. The ceviche wasn’t fresh, and overall the dishes were disappointing and overpriced. Not likely to return.

author: Blasco Sanchez Neira
review_text: Do not come. They scam and include $10 dollar tip under the “taxes” section. They systematically do this and I confirmed this by their attitude when I exposed them. The food is BELOW average. Avoid them at all cost.

author: Jacqueline Le Brane
review_text: The food is fantastic. The sangria they are fabulous!! A bit pricey but worth it. Great service and atmosphere.

author: Rosalinda Cremeans
review_text: I brought my neighbor there to eat and we ordered the Gambas AL Ajillo (shrimp sautéed with garlic sauce) and we ordered the Milanesa de Pollo ( breaded chicken steak served with rice so good! I had gone there two times in one week! Love that place.

author: Fernanda Permenter
review_text: My Father and I enjoyed eating here all the time together.  He's in heaven now, I miss coming here, so I've decided it's time to come back,  enjoy a meal, and remember my Father by eating a delicious Ceviche. Muchas Gracias,  I love you Papi.🌻🐝

author: Vanessa
review_text: I love the fish ceviche, it’s my favorite. I’ve been coming here since they opened. Best authentic Peruvian food in SF!

author: Ana Sanakina
review_text: Amazing authentic Peruvian cuisine with friendly and caring service. We got Papa Rellena and Lomo Saltado and both were excellent. Can’t wait to go back!

author: Jacob L
review_text: Best Lomo Saltado in SF! Food is always fresh and the purple corn drink is so GOOD!

author: Ron Vega
review_text: Their food was so fresh and delicious. Such a chill atmosphere.

author: Braulio Bethancourt
review_text: One of the few Peruvian local spots from back in the day. Thank you for being around!

author: Vanessa Cheung
review_text:
Excellent food with fast service. Granted we were the only party since we arrived before they closed. There was a kiosk to order but you can also use the QR code.

Pho broth was ok, Bun Bo Hue broth could've been better. Portions were huge though. The dumplings and spring rolls were surprisingly delicious.

author: Sabrina Cheng
review_text: We got there right before the rush, which was good because the food came out slowly after that. Overall,  a nice place to eat a hot bowl of pho, especially before a show. I had the basic beef pho, which included beef balls, flank, and some other beef.  The broth was a bit bland for me. My hubby and son ate the spicy beef pho and they both liked it.  Large portions. Spring rolls were fresh, as was the egg rolls. The fish sauce for the eggrolls was a bit bland, but the peanut sauce for the spring rolls were yummy.

author: Ryan Ochsner
review_text:
The pho here is phenomenal — easily some of the best in SF. Which is exactly why this review is so frustrating.

The operations are a mess. Their Google hours are wrong, their own website hours are wrong, and delivery apps constantly show them as “open” when they’re fully closed. I’ve now had multiple orders accepted, waited 45–60 minutes, and then had them canceled because… surprise! They weren’t actually open. At that point, every other restaurant is closed too. It’s maddening.

I’ve also gotten calls about out-of-stock items where the person on the phone didn’t speak English, so we literally couldn’t communicate. Not judging anyone for language, but when your hours are already unreliable, that extra layer of chaos does not help.

This place has incredible food, but the basic operations are so unreliable it’s almost impossible to be a returning customer. People want to give you money — you’re making it needlessly hard.

Please fix your hours and your order process. You’re going to lose loyal customers over issues that are 100% preventable.

author: Claudia Sanchez
review_text: Wha Da Pho?? Super delicious steak sandwich! Tender and juicy meat, soft bread, and sweet dressing! I really enjoyed it, great service, clean, and nothing beats the prices! Thank you!

author: Tom Kennedy
review_text:
Be careful that you’re not being ripped off by the server.
I dropped into What Da Pho on a quiet Friday mid-afternoon for a pho (10/10/2025). I was the only customer. For this time of day the restaurant offers a discount; Half price. That’s a good deal. Except, when it came to paying for my discount pho.
The discounted price appeared on the display and it was then changed by the server to the full price.
I enquired why it changed to the full price and the sever told me the the discount price was a mistake.
I had the sense forethought to take a screenshot of the discount offered at the time I placed my order and showed it to the server. The server, knowing that he’d been caught lying, glumly corrected the total without offering an apology.
My guess is that that the server thought a tourist wouldn’t question his deception. To the server: think about the choices you make in life. Best of luck.
For everybody else: Beware.

author: c chan
review_text: Ordered a beef pho during lunch.  The quality is amazing and there are 3 types of beef (brisket, beef balls and flank).  The portion is big but the price is super affordable.  I work around the corner and I can’t believe I didn’t discover this little gem earlier.  Definitely will come back and try other dishes.

author: AJ F
review_text: Vietnamese with their own twist—steak banh mi steals the show .Pho was OK.

author: Jimmy Tran
review_text: Got the combo pho and it was great! The portions were huge and at an amazing price. The service was incredibly fast and the owner was really nice!

author: Alibi McJohnson
review_text: I had a great experience today. I ordered fried rice and it took longer than expected; I had time so I wasn’t worried. They brought me some fried chicken free of charge to make up for the wait (that I wasn’t even complaining about). Great service and a very welcome touch from management

author: Dylan Warnock
review_text: This is the worst pho I’ve had in San Francisco. The food was bland, and the veggies were visibly wilted, as if they weren’t fresh. The Thai tea was watery with very little flavor—definitely disappointing. The staff didn’t make much of an effort to be welcoming. While they weren’t outright rude, they seemed a bit disinterested, and the service felt rushed and impersonal. It would have been nice to feel more warmth or engagement, especially in a dining experience that already left a lot to be desired.

author: Daniela Wild
review_text: Veggie pho, soft crab spring rolls and beef stew pho were fantastic!

author: Michelle Zhang
review_text: I was impressed by the portion size and the quality of the pho!! I got some shumai as well, and it was also soft and tender! Will come back!

author: Angela Spafford
review_text: Best chicken bánh mì in the Mission! The bread is cooked perfectly. We came for lunch and will be back often.

author: David Borel
review_text: Frozen dumplings and dried noodles prepared well, but served without the right sauces. The banh mi and iced coffee was very good, though. There were a lot of different stereotypes in the decor, but it was a pleasant space overall. Most concerningly, we heard productive coughing and unmasked sniffling coming from the kitchen.

author: Alfredo Pereira
review_text: I stopped by for lunch and had the beef pho and pork banh mi. The flavors are on par with some of the best Vietnamese spots in the city, but at a more affordable price. The interior is clean and inviting, and the service was quick. If you're in the area (Mission) and craving authentic Vietnamese food, look no further—this is the spot!

author: E. Garcia
review_text: I’ve been trying to come here and every time I come it’s closed. New business hours are posted on window but apparently those aren’t accurate either. Don’t waste your time like I have multiple times.

author: Luis Gzz
review_text: We really enjoyed and recommend the rib eye pho. The grilled tofu spring rolls were also good. The service was also very good. Great addition to the neighborhood and will definitely return!

author: A G
review_text:
Someone in the kitchen was smoking. The pictures make this place seem cute but it’s just a dressed up cheapo place. The server never said a word to us and the guy in the kitchen was smoking. I was so distracted by the unclean vibe that it really detracted from what could be a good enough meal

Bao was clearly frozen. All of this stuff is just heated up cheap packaged food

author: Henry Tran
review_text:
Food: Southern-ish style pho. It's good food if you're looking for some casual eats, but it doesn't taste like pho! However, the Chinese food is GOOD. 3 stars for Pho, 5 stars for Chinese food.

Service: Caters to introverts. You order from a QR code.

Atmosphere: It's clean, but it's giving 2010's chipotle. Feels dead and sterile.

author: BNL BYN
review_text:
Popped in for lunch. Food was alright. Got the beef pho. Broth was watery and felt too “healthy”. Prob what the neighborhood folks want but not me.

The service was amazing! Server was very personable

author: Elena Wilcox
review_text: Came before the concert at Chase Center. Had mussels, fish and chips, cocktails and wine. The food was average and atmosphere ok if you not sitting at water front seats. Thank you

author: Brooke Greer
review_text: Excellent location and view. Outstanding service all the way around. I only wish they had mermaid merch to match their logo & branding ;). Food was great, a couple people said the dishes could be elevated, but that is more of a casual place so it was perfect.  Great place to bring huge groups or small groups, especially if you're going to an event nearby. On the waterfront!

author: Sten Sun
review_text:
It was my first visit here and I had a perfect experience.
Oyster of the day were the best I’ve had, I ordered them twice because it was very fresh.
Of course other plates are excellent as well.
It’s a 15 min Uber ride from the city center, so if you want to have a leisurely meal, make sure to come here.

author: Scarlet Newman
review_text: It was a sunny Saturday  and we decided to seek out a spot for an afternoon lunch with a water view. We decided on Mission Rock and were happy to find parking pretty easily and got seated upstairs. So far so good. My friend tried a mimosa made with grapefruit juice while I stuck with water. We ordered the ceviche to share. I had the mussels and fries and my friend had a burger with fries. The mimosa was only average as it was difficult to discern the flavors of the grapefruit juice or the bubbly, which I believe was Prosecco. The ceviche was sadly served with either fried flour tortillas or wonton strips. They were so stale it was hard to tell. The ceviche itself lacked citrus and could’ve used a bit more salt. Unfortunately, it was very difficult to get the attention of the server to ask for more lime. Inexplicably, they serve the mussels and fries in the same dish. So my request for crispy fries was overwritten by the fact that they were soaking in the mussel cooking sauce. The mussels themselves were OK although I had to discard three or four. The burger looked really delicious, but my eating partner was underwhelmed with the flavor of the overcooked beef and the size of the patty. The fries were served in a cone shaped dish and were nestled in a sheet of paper. We both laughed when we realized that the paper was an old menu that had been cut up. Not very appetizing to think that the food you are eating has been sitting on an old menu that who knows how many people have touched.

author: Rajesh Ramchandani
review_text: Great place near the waterfront. Beautiful views and peaceful atmosphere. Went to try out cocktails which turned out to be mediocre. The bar looks great but for some reason the drinks are a little disappointing. Pina colada was purely coconut milk topped with extremely sweet cream. We returned it and they were more than willing to exchange it for Margaritas, which turned out it be much decent. The Old Fashioned drink is renamed here as New Fashioned and was overly sweet. It lacked the main ingredient of bourbon and was purely low cost Germain liqueur. The glass it was served in seemed unhygienic. French fries were great, well made and crispy almost to perfection. Didn't wanted to order anything more since we lost our appetite. The place is great but unfortunately the drinks were disappointing today. SF chronicle and other food blogshighly  recommend this place for happy hour but I doubt if they have been here to try it out themselves. I am sure the food here is great but will give it a try so time soon.

author: Jason Xie
review_text:
Mission Rock Resort is a fantastic spot that combines incredible food with stunning views. The oysters are absolutely amazing – fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. They’re a must-try for any seafood lover. The rest of the menu is just as impressive, with dishes that are well-crafted and delicious.

What truly elevates the experience is the view. Overlooking the water, it’s the perfect setting for a relaxing meal or a special occasion. The ambiance is laid-back yet classy, making it ideal for both casual outings and more formal gatherings.

If you’re looking for great food and a beautiful waterfront dining experience, Mission Rock Resort is the place to go. Highly recommended!

author: Craig Villamor
review_text: This is a great spot right near Chase Center. Service was quick and friendly. I had fish and chips and they say that the fish is local rock fish. I will say it was VERY fresh and tasted great. My wife had a Caesar with chicken that was tender and well seasoned. Great atmosphere for lunch or brunch. View of the very industrial waterfront is pretty cool if you’re into that sort of thing. A little on the pricey side would be my main complaint but not outrageous for SF. Street parking was ample at the time we visited (Saturday afternoon with no big events going on).

author: Thanachit M
review_text: They provide excellent offerings during their happy hour, including cocktails and oysters. The staff members were courteous and friendly. The view from the establishment is truly remarkable. It is a suitable location for romantic dates, group gatherings, or even solo dining experiences.

author: Marcy Nordberg
review_text:
Company event and the service was top knotch. We had the outdoor patio deck with beautiful bay views.
Food was very good and our bar tender Noah took exceptional care of us.
I highly recommend Mission resort- call Daniella ASAP to book your next event or just have a team happy hour. 🥂

author: Jim Painter
review_text:
We have been here a few of times for lunch, when in the area. We usually order a fish plate. It is always good and fresh. And a nice presentation.
We usually sit upstairs on the deck. Overlooking the bay.
On our last visit we were a little late during the lunch rush. It looked like there was some event and most everyone sat outside. We were one of the few seated inside.  Our waitress was very friendly and tried her best to serve us, as well as many tables outside.
We still plan to return next time We are in the area.

author: Frank Mario Castellon
review_text: Kimmy and I enjoyed dinner on the 2nd floor patio. Great view of dry docks and bay. Server brought water bowl for kimmy and made her feel welcome. Excellent of surf and turf dishes as well as full bar. Highly recommend for you and your furry friend. Kimmy gives 2 paws 🐾 up.

author: Madison Maloney
review_text: Very good atmosphere. Drinks were good. Food was good. Happy hour was worth it! Drinks were good, oysters were ok but for the HH price was worth it

author: Ty Anderson
review_text: I heavily debated between 3 star and 4 star. Ended up downgrading to 3 star because of a "surcharge" on the bill. I'm visiting Cali and was shocked to see this is a hot debate topic. Freakin' put it in the price of the food. A little hard to find parking outside. A decent atmosphere on the water. The service was slow - maybe because there was a large party downstairs? Food was hit and miss. We got sourdough bread. Crust was a little hard but the guts of the bread was very good. New England claim chowder was OK (you are not in New England). Oysters pretty good. Fish/chips was good. Drinks not bad. We shared the fish and chips (1 dinner plate), had 3 mixed drinks, the oysters (6), chowder, and bread -> total bill including the surcharge and tip came to $149 even.

author: Ed VanTil
review_text: The hanger steak I had was super tough, which has not been my experience that that cut. The atmosphere was quiet, but very big, and not a lot of people. My lady said it's not of a happy hour place, before and after baseball/basketball games. It was just ok.

author: ROMMEL RIVERA
review_text: Great place for seafood, salads and little appetizers plates.  They offer great alcoholic and non alcoholic drinks. Beautiful place to have lunch. The staff is very helpful and kind. Can't go wrong with this place

author: AmyJune Hineline
review_text:
This place is huge. We walked in and they told us there was no seating downstairs. OK. We wait a minute. I ask "Can we sit upstairs." Wow, we had to ask.

We got upstairs and sat at the bar. Server is nice and chatty. We order drinks.

Menu is big and plates are very overpriced, maybe due to proximity of Chase Center.
We decide on an app of Mac and Cheese. it was served hot and on a skillet. Cool. Tasted medicochre at best... food we could have gotten at any restaurant that orders from sysco foods.

author: Binshuang Li
review_text: The view is absolutely spectacular, making this a prime spot for a meal. The food is decent and satisfying. Unfortunately, the dining experience was significantly marred by the inconsistent service. We encountered a few issues that were frankly unacceptable. For example, despite being the first group at lunch to order clam chowder, we were told there weren't enough bowls for our party. Furthermore, one of the waiters seemed to be in a very bad mood: they were yanking menus from the table and even spilled food while clearing a used dish.

author: Jennifer Dever
review_text: I have not been here since the Chase Center has been completed- but I am happy to say it’s as good as ever! I had the dungeness crab sandwich for lunch and although it is pricey it’s worth it! The amount of crab on the toasted brioche was good, and the sauce is on the side. Perfect. It also came with a generous sized salad and fries. Worth it. Of course you can’t beat the location sitting bay-side. Good stuff!

author: Rashi
review_text: Service may be a little slow but the atmosphere, the picturesque location, and the quality of food was just amazing. Have a good quality of unique oysters. There fresh, warm sourdough bread that they provide to have inside also is great. Yes you have to pay for it. All the quality of crab and seafood and caviar just spectacular. The best part is that it is walking distance to the Chase center, so if you plan ahead you'll have a wonderful night!!

author: Brett Austin
review_text: What an amazing place with an amazing view and amazing staff!  Have visited multiple times and each time the food and service have been perfect.  We enjoyed early dinner before shows at Chase Center and there was plenty of seating. On one visit I had the Mission Rock Cioppino and my partner had the Jumbo Prawn Mac & Cheese, both had amazing flavor w/nice portions.  On our last visit we had the burrata, grilled fish tacos and crab salad…perfect as well.  The wine was outstanding w/nice pours, as was the Mai Tai. Lastly, the Espresso Martini…was crazy good!  A must try!   Parking can be horrendous and expensive…depending on when you visit, so definitely look for local events at Chase Center (the restaurant is pretty very close)…so that you enjoy the area and your visit to Mission Rock Resort.  One more note, there’s almost a grab and go section on the first floor of the restaurant, so check that out if you’re pressed for time.  I can’t review that section…since we didn’t utilize the service, but it looked like it was nicely organized.

author: Lilly B
review_text:
I stopped by this café and it was absolutely worth it. I ordered the Madagascar vanilla latte, which was really nice — smooth, comforting, and perfectly balanced without being overly sweet. I also tried the plain croissant, and it honestly ended up being one of the best croissants I’ve ever had. It was incredibly buttery and flaky, with light, airy layers and just the right crisp on the outside.

There was a bit of a line, so you might have to wait, but once you get your order, it totally makes sense why it’s popular. If you’re into great coffee and truly amazing pastries, this place is a must-stop.

author: Lydia Liem
review_text: This bakery has my heart! Their croissants are flaky, yummy, and absolutely worth the splurge. You can taste the love in every layer. And the coffee was just as delightful. Not the cheapest spot, but definitely the one that leaves you smiling.

author: FoodWanderer
review_text: I’ve never been to France but my assumption is that their croissants taste like a French croissant would. I got their popular chocolate croissant and it was amazing. Crispy and flaky in the outside and nice and buttery on the inside. The cocoa cloud was awesome too. Nice and chocolatey but not too sweet. The place lives up to his name.

author: Lydia Cheng
review_text: This is hands down the best bakery in the LA area. The pastries are a bit on the pricier side but they’re some of the best I’ve ever had. The chocolate almond croissant is a must order. It comes with three dark chocolate batons inside. They have a pretty good rotation of seasonal danishes as well. We loved the choco-latte!

author: Shawn Sheng
review_text: Every single time I walk by this place there seems to always be a line, especially on Saturday mornings. Even 15 minutes before they open, a queue already starts to form. For good reason too, the chocolate croissants here are super famous and perhaps the best in the area. Every pastry they have is absolutely fantastic and perfectly made. The staff are very friendly, and they have both indoor and outdoor seating.

author: Jena Hong
review_text:
This place is great!!! The baked goods are on the pricier side, but they’ve been made with a lot of care. Definitely a go to place if you enjoy croissants with A LOT of layers. I like their chai latte and chocolate bars as well.

There tends to be a long line in the afternoon and there are only a few tables available so you may have to wait.

author: Eiríkr L
review_text: My absolute favorite croissant shop. Everything is crispy and flaky with rich buttery flavor. My favorites are the plain croissant, almond chocolate croissant, monkey bread, and kouign amann. Be prepared to wait because there’s usually a line, no matter what time you go.

author: Andrew G
review_text: This place is great. Amazing quality in the baked goods and coffee. Not cheap, but that’s ok. You do get what you pay for. I had cappuccino and chocolate almond croissant and it came to $13.05.  I changed my mind on the stars. All is still true and it’s good, but when they let the dude in with the big dog that was sniffing everything poking around hairy and drinking out of a cup that he gave him, I just thought that’s too much.

author: Sammi L.
review_text: I visited this place around noon on a weekday. I was eager to try their renowned croissants, particularly the almond and chocolate flavors. They are incredibly delicious, and each croissant costs around $8. The drinking chocolate was also quite good, and I particularly enjoyed the hot chocolate on a rainy, cold day. I highly recommend the croissants; they are truly exceptional!!

author: Dumnoi
review_text: Following our breakfast in Pasadena, we noticed a long queue at a nearby spot, prompting us to stop and explore. It ended up being the highlight of our day! Every pastry and baked treat we sampled was absolutely delightful, particularly the chocolate and almond croissant. It was wonderfully flaky, with just the right amount of butter, and the filling was scrumptious, featuring high-quality chocolate and almond paste. The lemon berry danish was equally impressive, boasting a perfectly balanced sweet and tangy lemon curd. I can’t help but wish I lived closer so I could visit and taste everything on the menu!

author: Sue
review_text: Probably one of the best chocolate croissants I’ve ever had! Incredibly flaky and the chocolate inside is incredibly smooth and rich. Decent latte as well.

author: David Crow
review_text: The line was already building just as they opened. We were in there fourth. Everything croissant wise was stellar. Cookies were also delicious. The coffee drinks were not as dialed in but still decent. I was so excited to dig in to our baked goods that I skipped the photos. Bottom line is you won’t be disappointed with anything made here.

author: Veronica Parakhin
review_text: This is my go-to cafe for pastries, and their croissants are the best I’ve ever had! I think I’ve tried every pastry they offer and, while all incredible, the almond honey and raspberry pistachio are my personal favorites — I really wish the pistachio was offered year-round! Skip the chocolate chip cookie (neither chewy, nor crispy) and monkey bread (quite dense), though. The line can get very long (especially Friday 10-12, Saturday 11-12), but I always wait for the great coffee and pastries.

author: Anna Danielian
review_text: I don t understand how this place does not have 5 star rating all across the board. Yes, there are lines even at 10:30 am on Friday and the place is cramped but because it’s fast paced there is always a good chance of landing a table. You don’t come here to hang out. You come here to taste their AMAZING pastries!!! I am a big connoisseur of French pastries and have a handful of my favorite bakeries but this one is the best. I wish they opened a location in Hollywood or Silverlake.

author: Yunong Shi
review_text:
This cafe buzzes with activity, creating a vibrant atmosphere. I like its open workstation, allowing you to watch the staff as they stir a big pot of strawberry syrup and craft croissants.
I ordered a croissant and a cortado. The croissant was exceptional—perfectly crispy on the outside while maintaining a fluffy interior. It was a delight to have each bite. However, the cortado didn’t hit the mark for me; it was both sour and bitter, which might have been due to an off day with the espresso machine calibration.

author: Sherry
review_text:
These are THE best croissants I've had in LA by a LANDSLIDE and it's 100% worth the wait. They're only open from 8:30 to 3 and they always sell out. We got there at 10:30 and there was already a line, but don't worry, the line moves fast.

But oh my god, the layers on the lemon berry danish, SO good, but the infamous chocolate croissant was even better, a beautiful texture and the FLAKIEST crunch.

Pro tip, you HAVE to try their savory options like the spinach feta croissant.

These were sooo worth the hype!

Thanks for reading! ^-^

author: Hashim A
review_text:
The smell of the bakery as soon as I got in made me melt, pushed me to over order, and go over my budget.
There was a line at 8:15 before they even open, I was waiting in my car watching the line getting longer, so I just got up and joined.
Unfortunately they did not have the raspberry pistachio today.
I ordered the creamy, hot chocolate, chocolate, croissant, and almond honey.
The creamy hot chocolate was okay, but not that special I have tried better.
The croissants really good.

author: Nicolás Tolnay
review_text:
FLAKES EVERYWHERE
I remember when I found an article that stated the best Pain au Chocolat of Los Angeles, and It is true. Also, it said that the owner spent 2 years perfecting his croissant recipe.
Ever since I been obsessed with this place.
They use french butter, and you can see them laminating their doughs through the day.
They make their own chocolate, and sell bars and baking chips as well.
Excellent drinks are made here, consistently good.
The earlier I go the better it gets, that warm turkey and cheese croissant, right out of the oven, is pure gold.
Different shapes and flavors, always innovating.
WOW!!!

author: Courtney Henderson
review_text: It’s rare to find a place that does both coffee and pastries this well. I actually drive here from Monrovia because there’s not too many shops like this. The almond croissants and honey almond danish are hands-down the best I’ve ever had, and honestly, every pastry I’ve tried has been amazing. The Coco Cloud Latte is a favorite too. You can taste the quality in everything they make. Expect a line and yes the prices are a little higher, but it’s worth every bit. Service-wise (aside from the line) there’s a guy at the front who is super awesome and friendly. Rest of the crew is a young staff. You can tell there’s real care and craft behind everything here. It’s become one of those places I always look forward to visiting.

author: Eric C Huang
review_text:
Literally the best chocolate croissant I’ve ever had. As someone who doesn’t usually go for chocolate croissants (and have had many mediocre ones), this one truly is quite something. They also make them on the spot, so fresh! (In fact, the croissants even survived pretty much about 12 hours when I brought them for my friends up in Northern California)

Their hot chocolate “drinking chocolate” is also super creamy and decadent but not too heavy nor sweet! Feels like a warm cozy hug 🫂

author: Monica Anzurez
review_text: My son was excited for five nights at freddy's meal cupcake 🧁,  turns out they didn't pack it in our to go order =/ called the store number, and had no answer!

author: Aishik Ash
review_text: Always busy. Their NFC/debit/credit card machine seems to stop working quite often. Sometimes you're waiting in the drive thru for 20+ minutes, and you're told it's cash only only when you're about to order. Employees are surprisingly courteous. Use the app or the website to not overpay.

author: 3rd Eye
review_text: Another establishment that doesn't listen make sure you let the person at the window know what kind of card you using they kept telling me my foodstamp card declined because they kept charging it as credit food was good though so I guess that's a plus

author: Courtney Williams
review_text: I ordered $100+ and the lady was spooning patient with me.. My order was on point.. thanknyou

author: Deirdre Brown
review_text: Missing service as always. No question for the food. Our only problem here is the poor service. If ever you plan to go here expect for an hour or more waiting time, whether you order  a lot or few.

author: zainul Campbell
review_text: This is a neighborhood staple! Open really late (last posted time was 4am) location is just off the 110, convenient for anyone local. I do recommend you keep your doors locked and staying vigilant and off your phone

author: Daniel Garcia
review_text: My friends and I ate here last night for a quick casual dinner and the three of us all ended up with food poisoning today. This is the only meal we’ve shared together this weekend, and we all work up with similar gastro symptoms that I’ll spare the details around so I’m pretty certain it was Popeyes. The food was good and hot, service was fast although not particularly friendly, but expected for a DTLA fast food spot. But the food poisoning is a bit unacceptable even for a seedy fast food stop. I’d think twice before stopping by this location again.

author: Ramona Walker
review_text: Food is too expensive, customer service is terrible, not a place you want to visit.

author: Arthur Smocks
review_text: Well, I was pleasantly surprised.  Jovita and the team provided excellent service.  This popeyes is usually one we avoid, but tonight, I felt like we were special customers on a TV show aimed to give impeccable service. They succeeded. The entire team working on Saturday from about 6pm-8 pm listened, had food hot and fresh, managed the restrooms appropriately, and seemed to keep the irritants away. I will definitely consider returning soon. Keep up the great work.

author: Dante
review_text: I ordered a meal and 2 strawberry biscuits. They charged me for them both but only gave me 1...

author: Mahogany robinson
review_text: I went here today and when I opened the potato’s I took a bite and when I looked closer it was a black hair in it this is totally unacceptable and very nasty

author: thebrightyoungpeople
review_text: First time going there and they were not accepting cash. Ordered a chicken sandwich with mac n cheese. Chicken was a little bit greasy. The portion for mac n cheese was real small but tasted great. Chik fil A taste better but they're closed on Sundays.

author: Idea ATM23
review_text: Dirty tables, only one bathroom, staff can't hear you through thick glass, worse though was being out of blackened ranch, unforgivable 🤬😭

author: juan barrera
review_text:
Customers are not being treated with respect or acknowledge
They are being treated disrespectful.

author: Dani Pancho
review_text:
I paid for a family meal 10 piece 2 large sides and 5 biscuits. But when I got home I was missing the biscuits. Not cool.  My order#; 2458. I used the drive thru. I paid cash for an incomplete meal. I called and no answered.
Today is 08/18/2024 at 9:05 PM.

author: Edgar moreno
review_text: Every time I come here they give you the wrong  order. It never fails. I order the chicken strips and they are old and stiff like they are done last night. The service also not great. I stopped  coming to this Popeyes.

author: Ewanda Jackson
review_text:
Terrible across the board. I even got cold food and they acted like it was no big deal.
Pure slop.

author: Jay_Are
review_text: Proly the slowest Popeyes I've been too. But I can't blame them, people give them attitude, cus them out. I think it should close for the safety of the staff.

author: Juana De luna
review_text: The drive thru guy at this place is top notch and I made sure I told him about it too so patient a d helpful even tho I had a coupon he never complained always very polite and nice

author: The Man
review_text: The food was cold. Waited in the drive-thru line for literally an hour. I ordered a simple 2 piece combo. It was 1:20am. Went there because it was the only one open at the time. They need to hire more workers at night. They worker was kind, but she needs help. Not cool having her by herself with the cook.

author: Jessie Reis
review_text: Eating in this Denny's is not great and that's putting it nicely. The table service is non-existent and the server I had was an older Hispanic woman who was very rude and inattentive. The food was also very lack luster, it's something you could make at home yourself for far less money and it would probably taste better. Unlike other Denny's this one is a miss, hopefully they do better soon.

author: Tyler Huson
review_text: It’s a relaxing, clean diner with kind staff and good food! Easy access to and from the interstate!

author: Terri Martin
review_text: Was seated quickly and had my food quickly.  My server was a lovely lady. She made fresh coffee for me.

author: Guillermo Bravo
review_text: I usually give a good /fair rating to any Dennys in general, but today was one of the worst experiences, waitress was not welcoming nor nice, plates were greasy, food was charred, servings were not enough, specially the oreo shake and seating was not cleaned properly, found greasy floor under table and silverware too! very disappointed

author: Kelly Stout (DizzyedUpGirl)
review_text: My car was broken down in the parking lot and Mauricio really took care of me while I waited for a tow. The cheesecake was delicious and the bathroom was clean.

author: Хетик Царгасов
review_text: A disgusting organization. They couldn't unload one car for two hours. No one comes. No one cares. They don't value other people's time. I don't recommend anyone to use them.

author: Jan Dailey
review_text: Stopped in for breakfast on our holiday vacation. Our server was amazing, and the food was delicious. Even though it was a holiday weekend, the staff was working together beautifully. Happy Holiday!

author: Greg Henry
review_text:
Great Lasagna super HOT! Server was on her own but handled it like a PROFESSIONAL!!!
Bathroom needs something me upkeep but otherwise Great stop for food off the 5Hwy.

author: Miguel Lopez
review_text: This place takes the cake for the worst Dennys around they messed up my order took to long to bring the food restaurant was empty and only one server it's a complete joken

author: David
review_text:
--food is on point
--always nice and friendly
--I also pop in sometimes, always let's me use the restroom- love it

author: Milana Bulo4ka
review_text: I just love this place!! The server was so nice, and I just loved the lasagna 🤤😀

author: WILLIE MONTOYA
review_text:
I’ve come here a few times. The first time was amazing. An asian lady helped us and went above and beyond. The last 2 times there’s been some 2 Hispanic ladies, vey bad service. Feels like they don’t care for customers. They a while to get us menus and I don’t like the way they talk to us. There tone is very aggressive. They are loud with their comments. Today they were taking about a customer not leaving tip. How they shouldn’t dine if they have no $ for tip. I’m sure it was their bad service that got them $0 tip. Food is always good. Environment can be better. Customer service needs to improve. Where’s the Asian lady and Asian cook, we miss them.
I don’t think I will tip some arrogant ladies.

author: Roxsan Solis
review_text: Went to eat here right before the holidays. It was around 7pm on a Sunday. The place was dead. Our server was the worst, the manager seemed nice, but he only greeted us. The food was bland. The only thing we enjoyed were the hashbrowns. Never again. Waste of $80.

author: Lilly G.
review_text: I normally am not a fan to do a bad reviews but I had one of the worst service experiences here. The lady who served me and my brother was not welcoming at all. I came for samplers, drinks and dessert to stall time. I love Denny’s so this was disappointing. This was also my second time coming to this location and I will not be coming back. The server did not ask us if we wanted refills or check on us at all after she gave us our food. I am a decent tipper and normally tip 20% and up, but this server I declined tipping due to her only tending to the customers in back of us the entire time. She came back to just hand me my check did not ask me if I wanted more. A refill and dessert offer would have been great. The only person who said thank you was me the entire time. Very disappointed and very unwelcoming experience. I hope the service improves. I don’t expect a 5 star treatment just wanted to be treated as the people in back of me with great service.

author: LW
review_text: This location has always been our go to after concerts and LAX. It's right off the freeway and out of the chaos. We were welcomed and seated quickly. It was really warm.  Only one waiter, he gave us our drinks. Our iced tea tasted old. Once we got out food he never checked on us. Our food was great. No complaints.  A waitress arrived but our waiter was still to busy to check on us. We had to ask for our check and he said he'd get it but did not.  Watched someone else ask for theirs and he brought it over. We just got up and walked to the register.  He was ready for us by then.

author: 23dilcia
review_text:
I visited this establishment Encinitas (Sylmar)  today because my best friend recommended it, saying the staff was kind and welcoming. Unfortunately, it seems we came at the wrong time. We had a very unpleasant experience with Mauricio Solís, who was extremely rude.
I got a very bad impression of this place, by the way the place was kind of empty with only 2 tables and us … why he was acting like that 😣.

When we politely asked for more coffee and a clean fork, he didn’t acknowledge us, threw the fork on the table, and walked away. Later, when my friend asked another staff member for his name, he quickly came over to our table in a confrontational manner, stated his name, and walked off again with the same rude attitude.

I was truly shocked by such unprofessional behavior, especially so early in the morning. We were hoping for a pleasant visit, but this left a very bad impression. I wanted to bring this to your attention in case it’s something that needs to be addressed.

author: Ksu Ou
review_text:
I really like these servers!They are so nice and they make delicious food!!) 😋
But the chicken is a little bit dry but if u take the souse (that I don't really like) this will be perfect!)

author: B FPV (Jay)
review_text:
I love this Denny's.
On my global travel I ended up at the hotel next door. The breakfast here was super nice, the wifi was fast and free, and the staff were really friendly.
I highly recommend this place.

author: Alondra Robertson
review_text: They messed up on my order and had to send it back to the kitchen. Main entrée was decent,  hashbrowns over cooked hard on top! The server had an aggressive attitude service change after the manager came out.  Sat in the booth area drink area was extremely dirty. Someone spilled coffee over 5 different employees, walked by, and none bothered to clean it up. Ice been maintained open only ONE server closed it the whole time I was there. NO server used a scooper for the ice all scooped up ice with cup in hand.

author: Elaine Mari
review_text: This Dennys is a huge disappointment. Ordering food thru online application and they never have it ready on time. They always forget something, and when you ask for a refund, they don't give it to you because they say that they can't due to you ordering thru application. The girls at the counter all the time don't have manners and just stand their chewing their gum half the time. They don't answer the phone if you call. The manager is never around here, so what is the point of even complaining. Don't bother coming here service sucks when you eat in too.
